tours.name: Culebra Island Aquafari (with Ferry Tickets)
tours.description:
Experience the beauty of Culebra Island on this full-day snorkeling adventure from Puerto Rico’s east coast.

Explore the vibrant waters of the Luis Peña Marine Reserve, one of the Caribbean’s most protected and thriving marine ecosystems. Snorkel among colorful tropical fish, coral formations, and keep an eye out for sea turtles gliding through the reef.

After your snorkeling experience, relax at the iconic Flamenco Beach, famous for its soft white sand and turquoise waters. Spend time swimming, exploring, or enjoying lunch from the local beach kiosks while soaking in the incredible scenery.

This guided adventure includes ferry transportation, snorkeling gear, and expert guides, giving you everything you need for a memorable day exploring one of Puerto Rico’s most islands.

At Caribe Bliss we offer you the best all inclusive snorkel and beach tour experience to Icacos Island off the coast of Fajardo. Arrive 30 minutes prior to departure time for check in and be greeted by our crew and Captain who will brief you and the rest of our guests on all our safety protocols. Briefly after check-in we will depart our Marina and head over to an offshore reef (approximately 20 minute ride) along the beautiful coast of Fajardo. Upon arrival, dive off and enjoy the diverse marine life around the reef while snorkeling for about an hour. First timers need not worry, the captain will give a quick lesson to those who have never done it before or just wish to brush up on your snorkeling skills. If snorkeling is not your thing just relax on board and get pampered by our crew with tropical drinks while listening to some island music. After snorkeling we will head over to the beach to enjoy the rest of the tour time where our crew will serve a refreshing pre-packed lunch with complimentary tropical drinks for you to enjoy.

tours.description:
About

You’ll be riding one of our top-of-the-line GTX Sea-Doo jet skis, featuring a sleek design, powerful engine, and smooth handling. The GTX offers a high-performance ride that is both thrilling and comfortable, with spacious seating for up to two passengers—perfect for sharing the fun with a family member or close friend.

Our 30min Los Pozos tour departs from El Combate, taking you just a step away from La Bahia Boquerón. This tour not only offers an exciting jet ski adventure but also a chance to observe marine life. As you speed across the water, you'll arrive at the serene Los Pozos beach, where crystal-clear waters set the perfect backdrop for spotting ocean creatures. Keep an eye out for starfish scattered along the seabed, and if you’re lucky, you might even catch a glimpse of a stingray gliding gracefully through the water. This tour blends the thrill of jet skiing with the beauty of encountering marine life in its natural habitat!

Yacht chartering in Icacos and Palomino, Puerto Rico, offers a luxurious experience amidst the Caribbean setting.

A yacht tour in this region provides exclusivity and comfort, with options ranging from small, intimate vessels to larger luxury yachts equipped with crew and amenities such as gourmet dining and water toys.

Whether you're looking for a romantic getaway, a family adventure, or a memorable day with friends, exploring Icacos and Palomino by yacht ensures a personalized Caribbean experience.

Icacos:
Located just off the eastern coast of Puerto Rico, Icacos is a small uninhabited island known for its pristine white sand beaches and crystal-clear turquoise waters.

A yacht charter here typically includes opportunities for snorkeling, swimming, and sunbathing on secluded beaches. The island is surrounded by vibrant coral reefs teeming with marine life, making it a perfect spot for underwater exploration.

Palomino:
Similarly beautiful, Palomino Island is located near the town of Fajardo on the eastern coast of Puerto Rico. It offers a more developed setting with upscale amenities such as beachside bars, water sports rentals, and even horseback riding.

tours.name: Night Kayak - City Lights Tour
tours.description:
Experience San Juan like never before on our signature City Lights Night Kayak Tour in the heart of the city. As the sun sets and the skyline begins to glow, your adventure begins with a fun check-in where you’ll get your glow on with glow paint and glow sticks—setting the tone for a night on the water.

After a quick and easy Kayak 101 on land, you’ll launch into the calm waters of the lagoon alongside our expert guides. Paddle alongside the mangroves and across the shimmering lagoon while taking in views of the San Juan skyline. Along the way, your guide will share fascinating insights about the estuary, local wildlife, and the history of Puerto Rico.

We’ll pause during the tour for a complimentary photo, capturing the magic of your nighttime kayak adventure. Your guide will also share insider tips on the best nearby beaches, restaurants, and bars to explore during your stay.

tours.name: Nomadic Northwest: Caves, Beaches; Sinkholes, Karstic Mogotes
tours.description:
All Ages • 8 Hours • Every Saturday • Please Call or Email for Additional Dates

Duration

8 Hours

About

The most rewarding area of the island, owing to the magnificent ranges of karstic mogotes, or limestone hillocks, whose likes are only found in a handful of places in the world. Lovely caves and sinkholes are many in this karstic region.
Let's nomadize the Northwest region- the most rewarding area of the island in our full day trip. We'll meet at the famous Lemy bakery in Levittown for authentic breakfast (included). After a 30min. drive in a luxury SUV we'll hike to a unique secret spring that comes out of the earth through the limestone. The forest and the swamp are part of the Tortuguero reserve - the only freshwater lagoon in Puerto Rico. You'll learn about unique flora and fauna and get to soak in the crystal-clear water with medicinal properties. Next, to one of the most photographed beach in Puerto Rico- beautiful natural cove with the iconic half-moon opening. Then off to the sacred Indian Cave, where Taino Indian women were coming to give birth and to conduct ceremonies and rituals in privacy. Woman traditionally ask for love, fertility and happy marriage on this site. We'll continue for a bite to the Food Network Channel favorite "ceti" fritters shack- seasonal authentic Puerto Rican delicacy. On the way back we'll drive along one of the most spectacular drives in Puerto Rico- coastal 681 road with palm lined beaches, bars and iconic Columbus monument.

First, we head to the Central Mountain town of Ciales as we drive through windy roads to the Tres Picachos Rainforest Reserve and Las Delicias waterfall. About

Enjoy a day in "Charco La Barrigona". A beautiful swimming area along the Mameyes River in Río Grande, located in the outskirts of the " El Yunque National Forest."

After a delicious lunch break of local Puerto Rican cuisine you can enjoy the beautiful Luquillo Beach where the view will be more than worth the trip. Then get ready for a night Kayaking adventure to the Island’s amazing Bioluminescent “Laguna Grande” where you will experience the rare phenomenon of glowing, sparkling water, existing in only 4 other places on earth!

One of the most spectacular sights on a night trip in Caribbean waters is to witness hundreds of tiny star-like bioluminescent plankton scintillating like a starry sky as you move through the dark water.
Wave your paddle through the water in front of you, and be mesmerized by the tiny glowing specs of plankton or Dinoflagellates which are tiny unicellular marine plankton also known as fire plants.

Based in Palmas Del Mar, Curate Fishing Charters offers amazing fishing adventures year round. Captain Alberto quit his 9-5 job to pursue the dream of being a full time fishing guide. He has fished and spearfished all his life in almost all of the main destinations over the world including, Florida Keys, Panama, Australia, Mexico, Costa Rica, Guatemala and Dominican republic to name a few.

Captain Alberto takes techniques learned from his trips and learns to apply them to future quests. Each trip, he collects data on water temperature, moon phases, chlorophyll concentration, times the tide changes, and fish migration patterns. After years of collecting this information, the odds of being in the right place and the right time increase drastically.

You’ll be fishing on a 26’ center console that accommodates up to 4 guests, ages 10+.

tours.name: Spaniard Splendor & African Spirit: Private 5HR Historic Old San Juan Tour and African-Taino Food Tasting Experience at Piñones
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s rich history and vibrant culture in 4 hours. Tour iconic landmarks, learn about Puerto Rico’s past and present, then relax in Piñones with black heritage insights and delicious street food.

tours.name: Northern Coastal Adventure: Private exotic beaches hopping, hiking and waterfalls full day journey
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden gems: black sand beaches, lush waterfalls, ancient petroglyphs, and scenic rainforests. Enjoy fewer crowds, stunning views, and a deep dive into the island’s natural and cultural wonders in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: Colonial Wonders and Serene Rainforest: Private 5-Hr Old San Juan and El Yunque's Angelito Trail Experience
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s historic landmarks and lush El Yunque rainforest in one seamless 6-hour tour. Drive in comfort, snap memorable photos, and enjoy a light hike with a refreshing creek bath—perfect for a memorable Puerto Rico adventure.

tours.name: El Morro Fort Tour
tours.company: Flavors of San Juan Food and Culture Tours
tours.description: Explore El Morro’s legendary walls, pirate tales, and historic secrets on a guided walk through Old San Juan’s oldest sites, revealing Puerto Rico’s key role in Caribbean history and military defense.

tours.name: Tropical Rainforest Magic and Wonders: Private Full Day Rainforest Adventure including Creeks, Ponds, Waterfalls & Cliff Diving
tours.description: Embark on a full-day adventure through Puerto Rico's stunning Toro Negro Tropical Rainforest, featuring breathtaking waterfalls like Las Delicias and Chorro de Doña Juana. Explore ancient Taino petroglyphs at La Piedra Escrita, savor authentic local cuisine, and immerse yourself in the island's rich history and natural beauty.

tours.name: Theo Culebra Experience
tours.description: Float in crystal-clear waters, sip tropical drinks, and soak up the sun on Puerto Rico’s stunning Icacos Island. Snorkel, relax, and enjoy breathtaking sunsets in a truly unforgettable beach escape.

tours.name: Full Day Charter Culebra • 30'  Whaler
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 7.5-hour adventure at the Luis Peña Natural Reserve, where you'll snorkel with sea turtles and relax on one of Puerto Rico's finest beaches. Enjoy personalized service, a delicious BBQ lunch, refreshing drinks, and the beauty of crystal-clear waters and vibrant reefs. Your paradise awaits!

tours.name: Coastal Reef Boat Ride
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 30-minute coastal reef boat tour in Puerto Rico, where adventure meets relaxation. Experience vibrant coral reefs, glide over gentle waves, and explore three unique beaches, each with its own charm. Perfect for all ages, this mini-adventure promises stunning views and unforgettable memories. Join us for an exciting escape!

tours.name: Aguadilla Horseback Ride At The Beach
tours.description: Saddle up for a scenic horseback ride along Aguadilla Beach, where salty breezes and crashing waves create an unforgettable adventure. Perfect for all skill levels, with dolphin sightings and expert guides ensuring fun and safety.

tours.name: Afternoon Beach Horseback Ride at the Beach
tours.description: Ride along Aguadilla Beach’s stunning shoreline, feeling the ocean breeze and warm sunset glow. Perfect for all skill levels, this relaxed 90-minute adventure offers peaceful views and friendly guides for a memorable escape.

tours.name: Sunset at Icacos Island
tours.description: Sail into a stunning Icacos sunset on a private boat, with crystal waters, drinks, snacks, and floating fun. Perfect for friends, family, or a romantic escape—unwind and create unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Private El Yunque Rainforest Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure in El Yunque Rainforest, the only tropical rainforest in the U.S. Experience a thrilling hike through diverse landscapes, swim in natural pools, and enjoy exhilarating water slides. This unique outing combines breathtaking scenery with educational insights, making it a must-do for nature lovers visiting Puerto Rico.

tours.name: Private Mermaid Tour- San Juan
tours.description: Transform into a mermaid or merman in a guided swim, surrounded by vibrant fish and marine life. Capture stunning photos in your tail, creating unforgettable memories in San Juan’s crystal-clear waters.

tours.name: Old San Juan Bike Guided Tour
tours.description: Cycle from tranquil Condado Lagoon through scenic bridges and beaches to explore historic Old San Juan’s top sights. Perfect for families and couples, enjoy breathtaking views and a smooth ride in just 1.5 hours.

tours.name: Bike Rental
tours.description: Cycle through Condado’s scenic lagoon, cross the Dos Hermanos bridge, and explore historic Old San Juan. Enjoy breathtaking views, family fun, or a romantic ride on lightweight, comfortable bikes designed for adventure.

tours.name: 2-Hour Rainforest UTV Adventure
tours.description: Race through Puerto Rico’s lush rainforest in a powerful UTV, then cool off with a river swim. Perfect for families or groups, with guided options and stunning views at every turn. An adventure you won’t forget.

tours.name: 1-Hour Rainforest UTV Adventure
tours.description: Race through Puerto Rico’s lush ranch on a thrilling 4x4 UTV tour. Enjoy stunning views, a river swim, and the chance to relax or drive your own vehicle—perfect for families and adventure seekers alike.

tours.name: Campamento VIP
tours.description: Kids aged 7-16 can enjoy a fun-filled, no-experience-needed aquatic camp at Condado Lagoon. Choose your dates—day, week, or month—and dive into paddleboarding, kayaking, snorkeling, and more!

tours.name: Full Day Private Boat Tour Fajardo Local Keys
tours.description: Escape the crowds on a private boat to pristine Icacos or Palomino Islands. Swim, snorkel, or relax on white-sand beaches, with personalized service, snacks, and the freedom to enjoy your perfect Caribbean day.

tours.name: Old San Juan, Santurce & Loíza Day Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Puerto Rico, exploring the historic streets of Old San Juan, the vibrant murals of Santurce, and the rich Afro-Puerto Rican culture in Loíza. Savor authentic street food, uncover local legends, and unwind at the serene Vacía Talega Beach, making unforgettable memories along the way.

tours.name: Paddleboard or Kayak and Snorkeling Tour
tours.description: Paddle or kayak through Condado’s stunning lagoon, home to rare manatees, while exploring historic sites, swimming in clear beaches, and snorkeling in pristine waters—an unforgettable adventure in San Juan.

tours.name: THE WATERFALL ADVENTURE
tours.description: Uncover hidden waterfalls and cool tide pools on a scenic jungle hike in Puerto Rico. No experience needed—just a love for nature, adventure, and making memories in lush surroundings with expert guides.

tours.name: Historic Tours
tours.description: Embark on a captivating guided tour through San Juan's rich history in just 60-70 minutes. Explore iconic landmarks like the Casa de Espana, the Capitol, and the majestic Castillo de San Cristobal. Experience the vibrant culture and stunning architecture that make this journey unforgettable.

tours.name: Añasco-Bunny Fever Adventure Experience
tours.description: Embark on a captivating adventure through Puerto Rico’s west coast, exploring hidden waterfalls, breathtaking viewpoints, and a secret beach. Experience local culture at the iconic Bunny Spot, made famous by Bad Bunny. This unique tour combines nature, off-road excitement, and memorable photo opportunities for an unforgettable island experience.

tours.name: GoRide Coastal & Cultural San Juan GPS Moped Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling GoCar adventure through San Juan, where vibrant colonial streets and historic forts await. With a GPS-guided storyteller, explore stunning coastlines, scenic beaches, and local landmarks at your own pace. Capture unforgettable moments while immersing yourself in Puerto Rico’s rich culture and breathtaking views.

tours.name: El Yunque: EZ Going Bus Tour (Wheelchair-Accessible)
tours.description: Explore El Yunque’s lush trails, waterfalls, and scenic viewpoints with a guided, accessible tour. Enjoy panoramic vistas, learn about Puerto Rico’s ecology, and relax in nature’s beauty—perfect for all ages and abilities.

tours.name: Jungle Cascade Canyon
tours.description: Venture into Puerto Rico’s private rainforest for an adrenaline-filled day of swimming, waterfall slides, cliff jumps, and rope swings. Enjoy stunning natural pools and local stories in a wild, untouched paradise away from crowds.

tours.name: CRUISE & FLY EXPERIENCE
tours.description: Sail into sunset on a luxury catamaran with chef-made snacks, then enjoy a private transfer to a suspended four-course FlyDining dinner above San Juan’s skyline—an unforgettable blend of ocean beauty and gourmet elegance.

tours.name: MORNING OR AFTERNOON SNORKELING GLANCE
tours.description: Float above vibrant reefs and lounge on powdery sands at Icacos Island. Snorkel with gear, sip tropical drinks, and unwind in crystal-clear waters—perfect for families seeking a relaxing Puerto Rican escape.

tours.name: Jet Ski Freestyle
tours.description: Race across Puerto Rico’s clear waters on a brand-new Yamaha Wave Runner. Feel the wind, enjoy 30 minutes of high-speed fun, and bring a friend for free—all with safety and freedom in a stunning beach setting.

tours.name: San Juan Bay Paddle Board Rental
tours.description: Paddle through calm waters of Condado Lagoon, marvel at city skyline views, spot sea turtles and tropical fish, and enjoy stunning sunsets. Perfect for all skill levels, this relaxing adventure offers unforgettable scenery and marine encounters.

tours.name: San Juan Bay Kayak Rental
tours.description: Paddle through Condado Lagoon’s calm waters, spotting sea turtles and tropical fish with city skyline views overhead. Perfect for all ages and skill levels, this self-guided adventure offers stunning scenery and marine life close-up.

tours.name: San Juan Bay LED Night Kayak Tour
tours.description: Glide through calm, transparent waters in a glowing kayak, marvel at vibrant marine life, and enjoy stunning city views under starry skies. Perfect for all skill levels, this magical night tour creates unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Backwater Boat Tours Puerto Rico
tours.description: Experience the beauty of San Juan's waterways aboard a comfortable 24' Fun Deck. Enjoy personalized cruises for fishing, sunset views, or beach trips, all led by a certified captain. With included equipment and amenities, relax with friends and family while creating unforgettable memories in a stunning natural setting.

tours.name: Ponce Walking Tour
tours.description: Stroll through Ponce’s historic streets, uncovering its rich history, vibrant art, and delicious food. Feel the city’s lively spirit and learn why it’s called the “Pearl of the South” in just two unforgettable hours.

tours.name: From Leaf to Cigar: Puerto Rican Cigar Rolling Experience
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the rich history of Puerto Rican tobacco while learning to craft your own artisan cigar under the guidance of a master roller. Enjoy a curated tasting of local rum, take home a custom cigar bundle, and explore our farm's cigar shop and bar for an authentic cultural experience.

tours.name: Evening Horseback Riding Tour in Aguadilla Beach
tours.description: Ride through Aguadilla’s lush forests and stunning coastlines on a 90-minute guided horseback adventure, visiting beaches, scenic viewpoints, and ancient ruins for an unforgettable tropical escape.

tours.name: Vieques  All Inclusive Snorkeling Excursion
tours.description: Sail to secluded islands for vibrant reef snorkeling, swim with sea turtles, relax on pristine beaches, and enjoy drinks, snacks, and fun onboard activities—an unforgettable day of marine adventure and leisure.

tours.name: San Juan Bay Clear Kayak Tour
tours.description: Glide through calm waters in a transparent kayak, marveling at vibrant marine life beneath you. Perfect for all skill levels, this immersive adventure combines relaxation, stunning views, and educational insights into Puerto Rico’s underwater world.

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay and Rum Tour at la Parguera from San Juan
tours.description: Swim in Puerto Rico’s glowing bioluminescent bay, relax in healing hot springs, and enjoy a tasty local dinner. An unforgettable adventure blending nature’s magic with Caribbean beauty.

tours.name: Mukaro Tour
tours.description: Tackle rugged trails, explore stunning caves, swim through waterfalls, and enjoy mountain views on this 3-4 hour river and cave adventure—perfect for active explorers seeking thrill and nature’s wonders.

tours.name: Butterfly Tour at Rio Tanama
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 4-hour adventure at Rio Tanama, featuring thrilling rappelling from 120 feet into pristine waters. Explore stunning karst caves, trek through rivers, and conquer waterfalls. This unique experience combines hiking, caving, and canyoning, offering unforgettable moments for those aged 14 and up.

tours.name: San Juan Mini Boats adventure
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 1.5-hour adventure in San Juan, where you become the captain of your own 13' inflatable boat. Explore the stunning harbor, historic landmarks, and the picturesque town of Cataño, all while savoring Puerto Rico's renowned flavors and experiencing the vibrant local wildlife along the way.

tours.name: The Monster Zipline
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a lifetime at Toro Verde Adventure Park as you soar on The Monster, the largest zipline in the Americas. With a breathtaking 2.5km cable and speeds reaching 152.8 km/h, this adventure promises an unforgettable adrenaline rush that will leave you exhilarated and craving more.

tours.name: 7 Ziplines + The Monster Ticket
tours.description: Soar over Puerto Rico’s lush landscapes on the longest zipline in America, then thrill through seven more ziplines. Feel the wind, conquer fears, and create unforgettable memories in a 4-hour adventure.

tours.name: Vieques Historical and Cultural Tour
tours.description: Explore Vieques in 2.5 hours with a vibrant tour of historic sites, scenic views, beaches, and local culture. Visit forts, lighthouses, murals, and beaches, while learning about the island’s rich heritage and natural beauty.

tours.name: Condado Lagoon Day Water Bike Tour – Chiliboats
tours.description: Pedal a stable, comfortable catamaran-style waterbike through calm Condado Lagoon waters, enjoying stunning city views, spotting wildlife, and exploring San Juan’s historic sites in a relaxing, safe adventure suitable for all skill levels.

tours.name: La Parguera Bioluminescent Bay Water Bike Tour – Chiliboats
tours.description: Glide on a stable, comfortable waterbike through La Parguera’s Bioluminescent Bay and witness glowing waters in a natural, eco-friendly adventure suitable for all fitness levels. Create unforgettable memories under the stars.

tours.name: Experiencia en bicicleta acuática por la Laguna de Condado
tours.description: Glide over calm waters in a safe, easy-to-handle aqua bike, spotting sea turtles, manatees, and colorful fish in a protected reef. Relax, connect with nature, and enjoy 45 minutes of peaceful adventure in Condado.

tours.name: Opulent Old San Juan Cultural Sightseeing Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s rich history, vibrant art, and flavorful culture in 2.5 hours. Taste local coffee, rum, finger foods, and artisanal cocktails while meeting residents and discovering 32 iconic landmarks.

tours.name: San Salvador Rainforest Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 5-hour adventure through Puerto Rico's lush rainforest, exploring stunning waterfalls and climbing 600 feet to hidden falls. Experience the thrill of rappelling down a 65-foot waterfall, swimming in natural pools, and savoring a delicious local lunch with the community, blending nature and culture in an unforgettable journey.

tours.name: Puerto Rican Folklore Bomba Class with Live Music
tours.description: Join a lively Puerto Rican Bomba dance class at sunset on the beach, where drums and movement create a vibrant cultural exchange. No experience needed—just bring your energy and enjoy authentic music and dance.

tours.name: Sunset Salsa Beach Class
tours.description: Dance under Puerto Rico’s sunset at Playa El Último Trolley, learning salsa, merengue, and bachata on the beach. Perfect for all ages, with stunning views, rhythmic moves, and a fun, family-friendly vibe.

tours.name: Salsa Class and Night Out Hangout Experience
tours.description: Dance on the beach at sunset, learn Salsa from pros, then groove at lively local clubs. Feel the rhythm, make new friends, and immerse yourself in Puerto Rico’s vibrant salsa scene for an unforgettable night out.

tours.name: El Yunque Waterfalls Romantic Stay
tours.description: Experience a romantic getaway in a deluxe accommodation with breathtaking waterfall views from your balcony. Enjoy intimate evenings on your private terrace, relax in a luxurious bathtub, and embrace the tranquility of nature. This unique retreat offers comfort and seclusion, perfect for creating unforgettable memories together.

tours.name: All-Inclusive: Mako 29ft Boat Tour Eco-Tour Nautical
tours.description: Set sail on a 4-hour adventure exploring Puerto Rico’s stunning coast. Snorkel vibrant reefs, spot marine life, enjoy snacks, music, and relax on a spacious boat with all comforts included. An unforgettable ocean escape awaits.

tours.name: All inclusive with BBQ Visit up to 3 Islands (Mako Boat 29 feet)
tours.description: Sail through Fajardo Bay on a luxurious 29-ft Mako boat with shaded comfort, stunning views, snorkeling with marine life, and a delicious BBQ. Relax, explore islands, and enjoy drinks, music, and beach fun all day long.

tours.name: Sunset Boat Ride (Mako Boat 29 feet)
tours.description: Watch a stunning Puerto Rican sunset from a sleek 29-foot boat with comfy seats, snorkeling, music, drinks, and a friendly crew—creating an unforgettable 2.5-hour ocean escape.

tours.name: Ultimate San Juan Discovery Private Full Day Experience from Ponce
tours.description: Experience the rich history and vibrant culture of Puerto Rico on this full-day tour. Explore Old San Juan's iconic landmarks, immerse yourself in Santurce's street art, savor rum at the renowned Barrilito Distillery, and discover the African heritage in Piñones, culminating with relaxation at La Pocita Beach.

tours.name: Visit Local Bars at Art District
tours.description: Sip local beers, groove to live music, and enjoy lively games across three vibrant Santurce bars. Dive into the heart of the city’s culture, community, and nightlife in an unforgettable three-hour adventure.

tours.name: Salinas, South of PR Deck Boat
tours.description: Sail southern Puerto Rico’s calm waters on a private 27ft catamaran, spotting dolphins and manatees, visiting stunning beaches and cays, enjoying music, and customizing your perfect day of relaxation, snorkeling, and seaside dining.

tours.name: Coffee and Waterfalls Tour in Ciales
tours.description: Experience the heart of Puerto Rico’s coffee culture on an exclusive tour through stunning landscapes and family-owned farms. Meet passionate local farmers, savor exceptional brews, and uncover the rich history and sustainability of Puerto Rican coffee. This immersive journey promises unforgettable flavors and breathtaking views at every turn.

tours.name: Off-Road ATV Adventure
tours.description: Feel the wind and thrill of off-road ATV riding through scenic trails at Grand Eco-Park. Learn about sustainable farming, enjoy scenic stops, and share an eco-friendly adventure perfect for all ages and experience levels.

tours.name: Beach Tour - Discover 4 iconics beaches of the Northeastern Coast
tours.description: Relax on Puerto Rico’s northeast coast with shallow pools, scenic drives, and stunning beaches. Swim, take photos, and enjoy rainforest views in a family-friendly adventure full of natural beauty.

tours.name: Rainforest Hayride
tours.description: Ride through El Yunque’s lush foothills in an open wagon, spot vibrant wildlife, and cool off in the Mameyes River’s crystal waters—an unforgettable adventure along Puerto Rico’s stunning east coast.

tours.name: Atlantico Guided Jet Ski Tour
tours.description: Race along Puerto Rico’s coast on a 2025 Yamaha jet ski, exploring reefs and natural spots. Feel the wind, swim in crystal waters, and enjoy a safe, adrenaline-packed hour with stunning scenery and group fun.

tours.name: Boat & Jet Ski Combo Package
tours.description: Feel the rush of 30-minute jet skiing then unwind on a scenic 1-hour boat tour through mangroves and beaches, guided by a Coast Guard-certified captain. An exciting, relaxing adventure in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest & Waterfalls & Transportation
tours.description: Dive into Puerto Rico’s rainforest with rock slides, cliff jumps, and rope swings. Hike lush trails, swim in crystal waters, and enjoy local food—an adventure packed with thrills and unforgettable moments.

tours.name: The Perfect Tour of Puerto Rico
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s vibrant culture in just 4 hours: visit historic Old San Juan, relax on tropical beaches, enjoy local food and street art, and discover colorful neighborhoods—all with a guided tour and tasty surprises.

tours.name: Drive-Around City Tour | Old San Juan, Isla Verde & Piñones
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s vibrant culture with a sunset tour of Piñones’s coastal kiosks, scenic Isla Verde, and historic Old San Juan’s colorful streets, landmarks, and lively plazas.

tours.name: Birthday on the Sea (Premium)
tours.description: Celebrate your birthday with an unforgettable 3-hour adventure! Enjoy a private room, a giant inflatable paddleboard, and essential equipment while indulging in pizza and sodas. With lifeguard escorts ensuring safety, gather up to 12 friends for a memorable day filled with fun and laughter on the water!

tours.name: Night Dive
tours.description: Dive into the dark waters of Crashboat Beach and witness bioluminescent creatures, glowing coral, and nocturnal marine life. Guided by experts, this peaceful yet thrilling night adventure reveals an underwater world alive after sunset.

tours.name: Power Catamaran Full Day Island Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-hour adventure to the stunning crystal-clear waters of Icacos and Palomino islands aboard the Wave Walker. Enjoy delicious snacks, lunch, and refreshing drinks while utilizing floaters and snorkeling equipment, making this a perfect getaway for those seeking relaxation and exploration in paradise.

tours.name: Power Catamaran Half Day Island Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 4-hour adventure to the stunning crystal-clear waters of Icacos and Palomino islands aboard the Wave Walker. Enjoy complimentary snacks, sodas, local beer, and snorkeling gear while soaking in the beauty of the ocean. This experience promises relaxation and exploration in a breathtaking setting.

tours.name: Scenic Sightseeing Guided Boat Tour
tours.description: Race along Puerto Rico’s coast at top speed, then drift through tranquil mangroves and coral reefs. Customize your private 90-minute adventure with music, drinks, and photos—perfect for families, couples, or friends seeking a VIP escape.

tours.name: INTRO SESSION | Group Surf Lessons
tours.description: Catch waves in Puerto Rico’s beginner-friendly surf lessons, guided by expert instructors. Feel the thrill of riding soft-top boards, boost your confidence, and enjoy island adventures like snorkeling and hiking—all in one unforgettable hour.

tours.name: Chinchorreo at Ruta del Lechón
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Cayey, Puerto Rico, where you'll savor the legendary lechón on the Pork Highway, explore the vibrant Plaza Ramón Frade, and immerse yourself in local music at Casa de la Música. This unique tour blends culinary delights, rich history, and cultural experiences in one exciting day.

tours.name: Charco Azul & Arenales Caves Tour
tours.description: Journey into the wild with a private 6-hour tour of Charco Azul and Arenales Caves. Swim, explore caves, and hike canyons, all with comfort, snacks, and water included—an adventure for nature lovers seeking thrill and serenity.

tours.name: Geology Workshop for Kids
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s geology firsthand with a lively, hands-on workshop. Identify rocks, fossils, and learn how the island was formed through fun activities and expert guidance in a natural outdoor setting.

tours.name: Floating Deck, Charcuterie Board and Prosseco
tours.description: Relax on a stable, private floating deck in Condado Lagoon with gourmet snacks, chilled Prosecco, and stunning views—no swimming needed. Perfect for a stylish, worry-free romantic escape.

tours.name: 2026 Kids Summer Camp
tours.description: Kids explore rock climbing, nature, and teamwork in a safe, fun environment. They build confidence, skills, and responsibility while discovering fossils, playing games, and enjoying outdoor adventures over five days.

tours.name: Surf board Rental
tours.description: Ride the waves with our easy-to-paddle 8ft soft-top surfboards at La Pared Beach. Perfect for confident surfers seeking fun, stability, and endless Caribbean stoke—grab your board and make every wave count.

tours.name: Vieques + BioBay Tours
tours.description: Sail to Vieques for a day of sun, snorkeling, and relaxing on pristine beaches. Afterward, marvel at the glowing waters on the famous bioluminescent bay tour—an unforgettable adventure from start to finish.

tours.name: Charco El Hippie: Hidden Waterfalls & Taíno Petroglyphs
tours.description: Explore hidden waterfalls, ancient Taíno petroglyphs, and lush caves in Puerto Rico’s jungle. Swim in crystal pools, hike through dense forest, and end your day at a lively seaside boardwalk with fresh seafood. An authentic adventure away from crowds.

tours.name: Culebra Snorkeling and Beach Trip
tours.description: Set sail on a high-speed catamaran to Culebra’s stunning beaches, enjoy snorkeling, a delicious deli lunch, refreshing drinks, and easy water access. Perfect for ages 4 and up—an unforgettable island escape awaits.

tours.name: Deep Sea Fishing Charter (Half Day)
tours.description: Set sail on The Legend for a thrilling 4-hour deep-sea fishing adventure in Blue Marlin Alley, targeting marlin, sailfish, tuna, and more. Enjoy luxury, expert service, and prime offshore waters just minutes from San Juan.

tours.name: Paddleboard Rental
tours.description: Rent a premium paddleboard and glide across Condado Lagoon at your own pace. Spot tropical fish and manatees in calm waters, with all gear and a quick safety lesson included. Explore freely, anytime from 10 AM to sunset.

tours.name: Private Boat Charter
tours.description: Sail away on a private boat to Puerto Rico’s east coast, snorkeling vibrant reefs, lounging on white beaches, and soaking up the sun. Enjoy snacks, drinks, and pure Caribbean beauty—your perfect escape awaits.

tours.name: Clear Bottom Kayaking & Snorkel Reef Exploration
tours.description: Paddle through crystal-clear waters in a clear-bottom kayak, taking in vibrant marine life beneath you. Then snorkel colorful reefs and tropical fish for an unforgettable Caribbean adventure.

tours.name: Waterslides in the Rainforest
tours.description: Slide down lush rainforest rocks, then savor authentic Caribbean flavors at Luquillo Kiosks. A perfect blend of adventure, scenic beauty, and local culture awaits on this exciting river tour.

tours.name: Sunset Salsa Beach Class in San Juan, Puerto Rico
tours.description: Dance barefoot on the beach at sunset, feeling the rhythm and passion of salsa. No experience needed—just bring your energy and let the ocean’s glow inspire your moves in this romantic, immersive class.

tours.name: Mixology Rum Class
tours.description: Uncover the legends behind Puerto Rico’s iconic drinks, then learn fun bar tricks to impress friends. No experience needed—just shake, stir, and become a pro in this lively, hands-on cocktail class.

tours.name: El Yunque Educational Rainforest Walk (Easy & Family-Friendly)
tours.description: Explore El Yunque with a top expert, uncovering rainforest secrets, stunning waterfalls, and panoramic views. Enjoy a family-friendly, educational adventure that brings Puerto Rico’s nature and history to life.

tours.name: Beginner Scuba Dive Tour Adventure | Rincon
tours.description: Begin your underwater adventure with personalized coaching, mastering breathing and skills in shallow water before exploring vibrant reefs teeming with colorful fish—perfect for first-time divers and non-swimmers.

tours.name: Half-Day Rainforest tour
tours.description: Hike through El Yunque’s lush rainforest, swim in crystal-clear river pools, and snap photos at iconic waterfalls and viewpoints. An adventurous half-day immersed in Puerto Rico’s natural beauty awaits.

tours.name: 7 Zipline Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of ziplining at Toro Verde Adventure Park in Puerto Rico! Soar across seven exhilarating ziplines while enjoying breathtaking views of the lush mountains. This four-hour adventure promises an unforgettable rush, perfect for those seeking excitement and natural beauty in one thrilling package. Don't miss out!

tours.name: Private Loíza Heritage Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Puerto Rico’s rich heritage in Loiza! Enjoy a scenic coastal drive, explore local art with Samuel Lind, and immerse yourself in a private bomba dance class on the beach. Conclude your adventure with delicious local fritters, making for an unforgettable cultural experience.

tours.name: Private Surf Lessons
tours.description: Get personalized surf lessons at La Pared Beach, perfect for beginners and intermediates. Small groups or one-on-one coaching help you catch waves quickly with expert tips and safety in a fun, exclusive setting.

tours.name: Large Group (Two vessels Mako boat & Spider boat)
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 4-hour adventure to the stunning islands of Icacos or Palomino with friends! Enjoy snorkeling, relaxing on floating mats, and savoring snacks onboard. With comfortable boats for up to 12 people, free Wi-Fi, and showers, this trip promises a perfect blend of excitement and relaxation.

tours.name: After School Program
tours.description: The Climbing After School program offers an engaging environment for children aged 5 to 18 to explore rock climbing. Tailored to individual interests and skill levels, participants learn safety, coordination, and problem-solving while enjoying the outdoors. With small instructor-to-child ratios, each session fosters personal growth and a love for climbing.

tours.name: Public Icacos Luxury Sailing Catamaran Twilight Beach and Sunset Sail
tours.description: Sail from Renaissance Villa Marina to secluded Icacos Cay, then cruise into a stunning Caribbean sunset. Sip tropical cocktails, enjoy gourmet bites, and soak in breathtaking views of El Yunque and the Virgin Islands.

tours.name: Culebra Ferry Tickets & Round-Trip Transport from San Juan
tours.description: Enjoy a hassle-free day on Culebra Island with round-trip transport, ferry tickets, and flexible activities. Relax on Flamenco Beach, snorkel vibrant reefs, or explore secluded beaches—your perfect Caribbean escape awaits.

tours.name: Zipline & Yunque Rainforest Combo
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Puerto Rico's El Yunque rainforest with an exhilarating adventure that includes a scenic hike, refreshing swims in natural pools, and an unforgettable zipline journey above the treetops. Discover the vibrant ecosystem and breathtaking views while guided by experts, making this an adventure you won't forget!

tours.name: Sunset Biobay Kayak, Swim, and Boat Tour
tours.description: Experience the stunning beauty of Parguera's cays with a sunset swim in crystal-clear waters, followed by an enchanting exploration of the bioluminescent bay. This family-friendly adventure promises unforgettable memories, combining relaxation and wonder in a safe environment for all ages. Dive into a magical journey that captivates the senses!

tours.name: Sunset Public Sail
tours.description: Watch a stunning sunset from Rincón’s waters aboard the Katarina. Sail past surf spots, enjoy music, cocktails, and snacks as the sky turns vibrant colors—an unforgettable, relaxing evening in paradise.

tours.name: Private: Boat Day Charter
tours.description: Embark on a private La Parguera Boat Charter for an unforgettable 4-hour adventure! Island hop between stunning sandy spots like Caracoles and Mata La Gata, with opportunities for snorkeling and relaxation. Enjoy personalized recommendations from your captain and discover hidden gems that most visitors overlook, ensuring a unique and memorable experience.

tours.name: Kids and Family Old San Juan Science and History Fun Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s rich history and science through a lively 2.5-hour family tour. Discover landmarks, enjoy fun experiments, decode secrets, and savor local treats—all while engaging minds of all ages.

tours.name: City Glow Under the Moonlight – Guided Night Kayak Tour
tours.description: Glide silently through Condado Lagoon at night, guided by moonlight and natural sounds. Spot fish, crabs, and maybe a manatee as you connect with San Juan’s peaceful, protected waters in a calming, eco-friendly kayak adventure.

tours.name: Nature Kayak Tour at Condado Lagoon
tours.description: Glide through Condado Lagoon’s vibrant waters on a clear-bottom kayak, spotting sea turtles, manatees, and colorful marine life. Enjoy a 45-minute eco-adventure filled with nature, history, and stunning underwater views.

tours.name: Roca Norte Sport Rock Climbing Course
tours.description: Join the Roca Norte Sport Rock Climbing Course for an exhilarating three-day adventure! Learn essential skills like lead climbing, belaying, and rappelling, all while receiving expert guidance. Enjoy a month of free practice access and gear rental, ensuring you build confidence and competence in the thrilling world of rock climbing.

tours.name: Marine Ecology Experience
tours.description: Explore marine life in a full-day adventure with three dives, including a mesmerizing black light night dive. Learn how ocean creatures interact, see stunning fluorescence, and deepen your connection to the underwater world.

tours.name: 3 in 1 Combo Tour
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s highlights in one day: stroll historic Old San Juan, hike lush El Yunque waterfalls, and unwind at scenic Luquillo Beach with local bites and lively vibes. An unforgettable island adventure awaits.

tours.name: TRANSPORTATION - ROUNDTRIP
tours.description: Enjoy seamless travel with direct driver texts, secure vehicles, and a week-long lost-and-found. Stay informed and in control, ensuring a safe, smooth ride tailored to your location and needs.

tours.name: Scenic Off-Road UTV Adventure
tours.description: Zoom across Vieques’ rugged trails in a fun off-road buggy, spotting wild horses, hidden beaches, and stunning ocean views. Guided by locals, this family-friendly adventure blends adrenaline, nature, and Caribbean magic.

tours.name: Water Birthday Splash
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable birthday celebration in La Parguera, Puerto Rico! Step aboard a private pontoon boat for a day of water sports, laughter, and sunshine with your loved ones. This unique adventure transforms the sea into your playground, ensuring every moment is filled with joy and lasting memories.

tours.name: Sport Fishing Charter Puerto Rico
tours.description: Set sail from San Juan Bay for a personalized offshore fishing adventure. Troll for mahi mahi, tuna, or marlin with expert guides, all gear included, in a safe, relaxed environment perfect for families and friends.

tours.name: Rental Paddleboard or Kayak
tours.description: Paddle across the calm waters of Condado Lagoon, feeling the breeze and soaking in Puerto Rico’s vibrant scenery during a fun 2-hour SUP adventure with gear, safety, and convenience included.

tours.name: Eco Isleño Private Power Catamaran
tours.description: Sail private waters of Puerto Rico with your family, snorkel in crystal-clear seas, relax on stunning beaches, and enjoy a delicious buffet. Perfect for all ages, with equipment and floating devices included.

tours.name: Half Day Charter
tours.description: Set sail on a personalized half-day adventure to Icacos, Tortuga Reef, and Palomino Island. Snorkel, swim, and relax in crystal waters with drinks, snacks, and stunning island scenery all included.

tours.name: Icacos/Palomino Island Half Day Tour
tours.description: Sail to pristine beaches, snorkel vibrant reefs, and enjoy drinks and snacks onboard. Opt for the Seabob underwater scooter for an adrenaline rush, all guided by experienced local captains in Puerto Rico’s stunning east islands.

tours.name: Icacos All Day Tour
tours.description: Sail along Puerto Rico’s east islands with expert guides, enjoy snorkeling, beach stops, and onboard drinks. Upgrade with a James Bond-style Seabob for thrilling underwater adventures.

tours.name: Tanama Cave Tubing Adventure
tours.description: Float through Tanama’s stunning limestone caves and pristine springs on the longest cave tubing adventure. Trek, explore caves, and relax in crystal-clear waters in a remote, untouched rainforest setting.

tours.name: Private Surf Lesson
tours.description: Dive into the thrilling world of surfing with MOKU Surf School! Each class begins with an engaging lesson on surf culture and water safety, followed by hands-on instruction in the waves. Enjoy top-notch equipment, a safe space for your belongings, and exclusive discounts at the surf shop for an unforgettable beach day.

tours.name: Semi-Private Surf Lesson
tours.description: Dive into the thrilling world of surfing with MOKU Surf School! Enjoy a comprehensive 60 or 90-minute class that begins with essential surf culture and safety lessons, followed by hands-on practice in the waves. All equipment is provided, plus perks like discounts and beach amenities for a memorable day.

tours.name: Group Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with MOKU Surf School! Begin with a 15-minute lesson on surf culture and safety, then hit the waves for hands-on instruction. Enjoy provided equipment, beach amenities, and a discount at the surf shop, making this an unforgettable day of fun and learning by the ocean.

tours.name: Half Day Private Boat Tour Icacos 6 People
tours.description: Set sail on a private boat from Fajardo to Puerto Rico’s stunning cays. Snorkel, swim, relax on pristine beaches, enjoy music, drinks, and light snacks—perfect for a full day of adventure and relaxation on the water.

tours.name: 2 Private Boat For 12 people
tours.description: Sail to crystal-clear Icacos and Palomino islands on a private boat. Snorkel, relax on beaches, enjoy music, snacks, and drinks—all in a fun, family-friendly atmosphere for a memorable Puerto Rican adventure.

tours.name: Rincón Scenic and Culture Tour
tours.description: Explore Rincon’s stunning coast, from panoramic viewpoints to legendary surf beaches. Stroll charming streets, soak in local culture, and enjoy breathtaking ocean vistas—all in a relaxed 2-hour tour with a friendly guide.

tours.name: Tropicaleo Drinking Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s vibrant nightlife with a local guide, visiting four hidden bars to enjoy craft cocktails, artisanal beers, and local bites. Immerse yourself in culture, history, and authentic Puerto Rican flavors in just 2 hours.

tours.name: El Yunque National Rainforest Hiking
tours.description: Climb observation towers, marvel at La Coca Waterfall, and stroll through lush rainforest with a knowledgeable guide. Enjoy scenic views, a river stop, and a short hike into vibrant tropical nature.

tours.name: Spa del Jíbaro Half Day Hiking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking journey through lush forests, where you'll swim in natural pools, glide down water slides, and marvel at stunning waterfalls. Discover ancient petroglyphs along the way, all while enjoying a moderate adventure that leaves you feeling relaxed and rejuvenated. This unforgettable experience awaits!

tours.name: The Indigenous Eye: Cueva del Indio & Charco Azul Canyon Quest
tours.description: Join a full-day tour exploring Puerto Rico’s rich culture and wild beauty. Swim in crystal-clear pools, hike through lush forests, explore ancient caves with petroglyphs, and enjoy stunning ocean cliff views—all with expert storytelling.

tours.name: Adventure Charter
tours.description: Discover the vibrant mangrove ecosystem near a reef snorkel, with stunning views, upside-down jellyfish, and eco-friendly impact. Enjoy snacks, gear, and an educational adventure in Vieques’ protected waters.

tours.name: A Taste of Puerto Rico: Sangria, Rum, and Local Cuisine
tours.description: Savor Puerto Rico’s vibrant flavors with tastings of handcrafted sangrías and artisanal rum, explore local culture, and indulge in iconic dishes—all just 30 minutes from San Juan in charming Caguas.

tours.name: Two-Tanks Dives Crash boat
tours.company: The Black Anchor Scuba Diving & Snorkeling
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s colorful reefs and marine life with guided shore dives at Crash Boat Beach. Enjoy personalized attention from our SSI certified Divemaster as you uncover underwater wonders.

tours.name: Fish ID Specialty Course Plus One Dive
tours.company: The Black Anchor Scuba Diving & Snorkeling
tours.description: Embark on an underwater adventure with the SSI Fish Identification Specialty course at Crash Boat Beach! Learn to recognize diverse fish families through an engaging online course, then experience the vibrant marine life firsthand during guided dives. Transform your diving experience and discover the beauty of Puerto Rico's underwater ecosystem!

tours.name: SSI Advance Adventure
tours.company: The Black Anchor Scuba Diving & Snorkeling
tours.description: Transform your diving experience in Puerto Rico with the SSI Advanced Adventure Diver Course! Over two thrilling days, complete five specialty dives at the stunning Crash Boat Beach. Enjoy personalized training, expert instructors, and the chance to earn your official certification while exploring vibrant underwater landscapes. Dive deeper and live louder!

tours.name: HangOut 360
tours.description: Celebrate on a private lagoon platform with friends, swimming, relaxing, and exploring with kayaks or paddleboards. Add a floating picnic or special touches for an unforgettable water party.

tours.name: Rum Tasting Tour
tours.description: Uncover the secrets of fine Caribbean rum with a guided tasting that sharpens your senses. Savor rich aromas, complex flavors, and silky textures—transform your appreciation of this spirited delight.

tours.name: Center of the Island : Pork and Black sand of Caribbean Sea
tours.description: Journey through Puerto Rico’s mountains and coast in a comfortable van, savor fresh local flavors, enjoy stunning views, and immerse yourself in music, nature, and authentic culture at a relaxed pace.

tours.name: Private 1:1 Lessons
tours.description: Catch waves at La Pared with personalized coaching, perfect for beginners or improving surfers. Feel the ocean, build confidence, and ride more waves in a fun, safe, and tailored private lesson.

tours.name: Piñones Beach & Mangrove Safari: Private 2026 UTV Adventure (2H)
tours.description: Race along rugged beaches and hidden mangrove trails in a climate-controlled Can-Am. Enjoy high-speed coastal runs, stunning photo stops, and authentic Afro-Caribbean vibes—all with your playlist and zero sweat.

tours.name: Private Island Adventure Boat Tour
tours.description: Experience a memorable day on Cayo Enrique Island, just a short 12-minute boat ride from the coast. Enjoy kayaking and snorkeling in crystal-clear waters within the stunning Natural Reserve of La Parguera. This unique adventure offers a perfect blend of family fun and natural beauty, all while ensuring a safe, distanced environment.

tours.name: El Yunque National Forest Half Day Tour
tours.description: Explore El Yunque’s lush rainforest with waterfalls, vibrant flowers, and panoramic views from a tower. Enjoy a relaxed half-day tour full of nature, history, and unforgettable scenery in Puerto Rico’s tropical gem.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Small Group Tour from San Juan
tours.description: Explore El Yunque rainforest with waterfalls, natural slides, rope swings, and stunning views. Enjoy a scenic drive, guided hike, river swims, and unforgettable jungle adventures—all from San Juan.

tours.name: Ciales Experience: Hidden Gems of the Central Mountains
tours.description: Escape to Puerto Rico’s lush mountains for waterfalls, scenic drives, and hidden swimming holes. Enjoy nature, stunning views, and local coffee on this easy, unforgettable day trip for all ages.

tours.name: Full day Tour
tours.description: Embark on a private boat adventure from Fajardo to the breathtaking Icacos and Palomino cays. Enjoy a day filled with snorkeling, swimming in crystal-clear waters, and relaxing under the sun with friends or family. With music, snacks, and drinks included, it's the perfect way to create unforgettable memories in Puerto Rico.

tours.name: Cave and Waterfall Adventure
tours.description: Climb into Cueva Ventana for stunning island views, then unwind at Tanamá River Waterfall with a refreshing swim amid lush scenery. A perfect blend of breathtaking vistas and peaceful nature in Arecibo.

tours.name: River Slide Extravaganza
tours.company: ACR Logistics Inc, dba ACR Tours
tours.description: Slide down natural waterslides in El Yunque, then relax on the beach with a hands-on mojito class and authentic Puerto Rican lunch. Finish at Luquillo Kioskos for local flavors and vibrant culture.

tours.name: El Yunque Adventure+Beach Time & Shopping w/ Transport Included
tours.description: Escape to Puerto Rico’s lush El Yunque rainforest with waterfalls and natural pools, then unwind on Luquillo Beach’s soft sands and vibrant kiosks. A perfect day of adventure and relaxation in paradise.

tours.name: Historical Old San Juan Walking Tour
tours.description: Stroll through Old San Juan’s colorful streets, uncovering centuries of history, pirate tales, and vibrant culture. Enjoy stunning ocean views, local stories, and hidden gems that bring this Caribbean treasure to life.

tours.name: Horseback Riding Tour in Aguadilla Beach
tours.description: Saddle up for a one-hour horseback ride through lush tropical trails and stunning coastal views in Aguadilla. Perfect for all skill levels, with friendly guides sharing local stories in a peaceful, small-group setting.

tours.name: Old San Juan Historical Walking Tour (Private)
tours.description: Discover the rich Spaniard Colonial legacy of Old San Juan on a captivating 5-hour journey. Explore the imposing Castillo San Felipe del Morro and Castillo San Cristobal, while immersing yourself in Puerto Rico's unique historical and cultural heritage. Experience the charm of this fortified city like never before.

tours.name: Private Charter Tour
tours.description: Experience a perfect day of sun and sea with a private tour tailored for your group. Choose from stunning destinations like Cayo Caracoles, Rabo de la Gata, or Cayo Enriquen, and soak in the good vibes while exploring beautiful coastal landscapes. Create unforgettable memories together in paradise.

tours.name: Night Life Tour
tours.description: Experience the vibrant nightlife of Old San Juan like never before in stylish golf carts! Explore historic sites, enjoy bar hopping at over 20 venues, and dance the night away at La Placita de Santurce. This adults-only adventure promises unforgettable memories and a unique way to see the city!

tours.name: Scuba Dogs Snorkeling with Fish & Turtles from Shore — San Juan, Puerto Rico
tours.description: Glide through Caribbean waters to colorful reefs, spot graceful sea turtles, and swim in calm, clear seas. Perfect for all ages, with expert guides ensuring a safe, fun underwater adventure for everyone.

tours.name: Culebra Island Snorkeling & Beach Sail Getaways
tours.description: Sail or cruise to Culebra’s stunning beaches and vibrant reefs, snorkel among tropical fish and sea turtles, relax on pristine sands, and enjoy a delicious lunch and drinks—all in a laid-back, crowd-free adventure.

tours.name: Discover Scuba Tours — San Juan, Puerto Rico
tours.description: Float weightlessly among colorful fish and coral on your first scuba dive. No experience needed—just curiosity. Guided by friendly instructors, explore vibrant underwater worlds in a safe, fun, and unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: 2-Hour El Yunque Rainforest Horseback Riding Tour
tours.description: Glide through Puerto Rico’s lush foothills on a guided horseback ride, passing vibrant flora, wildlife, and a peaceful river stop. Perfect for all ages, this scenic adventure blends nature, relaxation, and stunning views.

tours.name: Viques Boat Tour
tours.description: Sail to Vieques and unwind on Punta Arenas Beach’s white sands. Swim, snorkel, or relax in crystal waters while soaking up Caribbean sunshine—an ideal escape to refresh and explore island paradise.

tours.name: Ponce and Waterfalls - South and Montains
tours.description: Uncover Ponce's vibrant culture and stunning architecture, then cool off at Salto Collores waterfall. Enjoy panoramic city views, historic landmarks, and a refreshing dip in lush tropical scenery.

tours.name: Deep Sea Fishing Charter (3/4 Day)
tours.description: Set sail on The Legend, a luxury 48 ft. yacht, just 25 minutes from San Juan to deep waters teeming with mahi, tuna, sailfish, and blue marlin. Enjoy expert service, live bait, and a half-day of thrilling sport fishing.

tours.name: Cueva Ventana Journey (CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE)
tours.description: Climb into Cueva Ventana for stunning views of Rio Grande de Arecibo from a limestone cave. Guided tours reveal Taíno culture, lush wildlife, and breathtaking scenery—perfect for adventure seekers aged 5 and up.

tours.name: Lift eFoil Discovery Lesson
tours.description: Soar above San Juan Bay on an eFoil, guided by expert instructors. Perfect for beginners or pros, this thrilling yet calming ride combines top gear with personalized coaching in a stunning tropical setting.

tours.name: The Beast Zipline
tours.description: Experience the thrill of soaring like Superman on a nearly mile-long zip line, reaching speeds of up to 60 mph! This unforgettable adventure at Toro Verde Adventure Park promises an adrenaline rush. Remember to arrive early and capture the moment with a helmet cam for an epic memory!

tours.name: Old San Juan City WALKING TOUR
tours.description: All ages! • 2 Hours • Come enjoy our amazing experience!

tours.name: "El Yunque” Waterfall, Waterslide, and Hiking Tour
tours.description: Join a personalized El Yunque rainforest tour with local guides, featuring waterfalls, cliff jumps, and lush scenery. Enjoy a small-group adventure, traditional food, and door-to-door service for an unforgettable day in nature.

tours.name: Palomino or Icacos: Boat Day Trip with Transportation from San Juan to Fajardo
tours.description: Set sail on a small-group boat trip to Puerto Rico’s pristine Icacos or Palomino islands. Swim, snorkel, relax on floating mats, enjoy island vibes, and soak up stunning turquoise waters in a full-day adventure from San Juan.

tours.name: EcoFarm Walking Tour
tours.description: Discover the vibrant world of sustainable farming at Finca Neo Jibairo! Engage with nature as you explore agroecology, learn about Puerto Rican tobacco's cultural significance, and enjoy local products. With expert guidance, this immersive experience connects you to the land, its heritage, and the beauty of sustainable practices.

tours.name: Vieques 24-hr Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 24-hour adventure on Vieques Island! Enjoy local cuisine, beach time with provided gear, and a mesmerizing bioluminescent bay tour. Experience horseback riding on a black sand beach and unwind under the stars at Casita Azul. This unique getaway promises unforgettable memories and stunning natural beauty.

tours.name: Vieques Beach Adventure
tours.description: Experience the best of Vieques Island in a thrilling 9-hour tour! Enjoy beach time with provided gear, savor a delicious lunch, visit stunning black sand beaches with optional horseback riding, and indulge in dinner at your favorite restaurant. Cap off the day with a magical bioluminescent bay tour.

tours.name: GoCar Puerto Rico: Heritage & Shores Tour
tours.description: Embark on an 8-hour GoCar adventure through San Juan, exploring vibrant colonial streets, historic forts, and stunning coastlines. With a GPS-guided car as your storyteller, discover Puerto Rico's rich culture, savor local cuisine, and shop at unique boutiques. Customize your journey for an unforgettable day of exploration and relaxation.

tours.name: 🌿 El Yunque National Forest – Half‑Day Guided Experience
tours.description: Venture into El Yunque’s lush rainforest, walk among towering trees, spot vibrant wildlife, and enjoy breathtaking views from Yokahú Tower. Small groups, expert guides, and unforgettable scenery await.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Easy Going Bus Tour
tours.description: Relax in El Yunque’s lush rainforest with easy, accessible walks, stunning waterfalls, and panoramic mountain views. Perfect for all mobility levels, this guided tour combines comfort, nature, and Puerto Rican beauty in one unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Icacos Island Sail Getaways: Half-Day of pure Caribbean Paradise
tours.description: Sail to Icacos Island for a half-day of turquoise waters, vibrant coral reefs, and white sands. Snorkel colorful marine life, relax on the beach, and enjoy refreshing drinks in a tropical paradise.

tours.name: Luxury Catamaran Sail Getaways
tours.description: Sail to Icacos on a spacious catamaran, snorkel vibrant reefs, and relax on pristine beaches. Enjoy a flavorful Puerto Rican lunch, water slides, sea swings, and tropical drinks in a fun, laid-back Caribbean vibe.

tours.name: MEGA Private Old and New San Juan Tour – 4 Hours of Pure Discovery with private transportation and pick up
tours.description: Explore San Juan’s rich history and lively modern scene in just four hours. Walk ancient streets, visit forts, sample local rum and sweets, and uncover hidden gems—all tailored for an unforgettable private adventure.

tours.name: Vamos pa’ la isla tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating full-day journey through Puerto Rico’s vibrant south-southwest. Discover rich history at iconic sites like Ponce's Parque de Bombas, explore colorful murals in Yauco, and relax at the stunning Playa Buyé. This immersive tour blends culture, art, and breathtaking landscapes for an unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Summer Camp for Teenagers
tours.description: Join Puerto Rico’s only teen rock climbing camp! Learn safety, knots, geology, and cultural roots through hands-on activities, climbing, and nature exploration in a fun, educational environment.

tours.name: Scouting Badges: Geology and Rock Climbing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of rock climbing and the wonders of geology at Roca Norte! Engage in hands-on workshops led by expert guides, ensuring safety and personalized attention. Perfect for groups, these sessions offer a unique opportunity to earn scouting patches while exploring the stunning landscapes of Puerto Rico.

tours.name: Glow Crystal Kayak
tours.description: Glide through illuminated Condado Lagoon in glowing crystal kayaks at night. Feel the water’s shimmer, enjoy stunning views, and create unforgettable family memories on this guided, sensory-filled adventure.

tours.name: Birds of Old San Juan
tours.description: Embark on a captivating walking tour through Old San Juan, where vibrant history meets urban birdwatching. Discover colorful streets, learn about local bird species and their ecological roles, and appreciate the importance of green spaces. With binoculars and a field guide in hand, this unique experience promises unforgettable memories in Puerto Rico's capital.

tours.name: ATV Tour in Aguadilla
tours.description: Zoom along Aguadilla’s rugged coast on a guided ATV tour, soaking in stunning ocean vistas and wild landscapes. Feel the thrill of off-road trails while exploring one of Puerto Rico’s most beautiful coastal spots.

tours.name: Rod and Reel Puerto Rico
tours.description: Hook into the thrill of deep-sea fishing in the Mona Passage, chasing tuna, mahi-mahi, and marlin. Whether half or full day, feel the rush as expert guides lead you to prime spots for unforgettable catches.

tours.name: Bio-Bay Night Kayak Tour at Fajardo, Puerto Rico
tours.description: Paddle through Puerto Rico’s glowing bio-bay at night, where millions of tiny organisms light up with every stroke. Glide past mangroves and listen to fascinating stories in a magical, serene setting perfect for all ages.

tours.name: Porta Atlantico - Cueva Del Indio and Arecibo Beach Hop
tours.description: Join a guided adventure in Puerto Rico with lunch at Pig Route, sunset boat ride to Caracoles Island, and glowing plankton viewing. Perfect for groups seeking a personalized, seamless island experience.

tours.name: Tarpon & Snooks Spinning Tackle Trip
tours.description: Join a thrilling Puerto Rico tarpon fishing trip with expert guides, live or artificial bait, top gear, and multiple boat options. Feel the fight of these powerful, acrobatic fish in a stunning tropical setting.

tours.name: Harbor Sunset Cruise (Old San Juan)
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Old San Juan on a private sunset cruise aboard a 48 ft power boat. Relax as you savor delicious hors d'oeuvres and enjoy stunning views of historic landmarks, including El Morro and the Bacardi Distillery, while the sun sets over Puerto Rico's largest harbor.

tours.name: Afternoon Sail
tours.description: Sail San Juan Bay for 1.5 hours of relaxing or thrilling views of Old San Juan and Cataño. Enjoy complimentary rum punch and local beer, with calm waters or open ocean options. Perfect for all ages—no shoes allowed onboard.

tours.name: Rainforest and Zipline Combo Tour
tours.description: Fly over Puerto Rico’s lush rainforest on 11 ziplines, then stroll through nature, relax in a stunning natural pool, and browse local souvenirs at Luquillo Beach. An adventure packed with thrill and beauty.

tours.name: Mother’s Day Offer: Kayak or SUP Rental & Snorkeling Equipment
tours.description: Paddle or kayak in calm Caribbean waters, snorkel vibrant marine life, and explore Puerto Rico’s coastline at your own pace. Perfect for beginners and couples, this fun, eco-friendly adventure offers scenic views and underwater discovery.

tours.name: Taino Section Añasco River
tours.description: Enjoy a thrilling 4-hour family adventure on the Añasco River, tackling exciting rapids, exploring lush scenery, and uncovering Taino history. All gear and safety measures included—lunch break and fun guaranteed.

tours.name: Zipline + The Beast Transportation Combo
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 8-hour adventure that combines the thrill of ziplining with the excitement of The Beast, one of the world's longest zip-lines. Soar through the skies on seven ziplines, reaching speeds of up to 60MPH, all while enjoying convenient roundtrip transportation from San Juan.

tours.name: Zipline + The Monster Transportation Combo
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 8-hour adventure with the Zipline + The Monster Transportation Combo! Experience the thrill of soaring through the sky on 7 ziplines, including America's longest, The Monster, reaching speeds of up to 95 mph. Enjoy breathtaking views and convenient roundtrip transportation from San Juan for an unforgettable day!

tours.name: 7 Ziplines + The Beast Ticket
tours.description: Soar across seven twin zip lines and race down The Beast, one of the world's longest single-run ziplines, reaching speeds up to 60 MPH. Feel the wind and adrenaline in this 4-hour adventure—book your thrill now!

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan to the East Side (Ceiba, Fajardo, Guayama, Coamo, Cayey)
tours.description: Skip the taxi line with a professional driver waiting inside baggage claim. Enjoy personalized, reliable airport transfers with flight tracking, friendly service, and flexible scheduling—your hassle-free ride awaits.

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan, Ponce or Guánica
tours.description: 1 hour 30 minutes • All ages

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan, Aguadilla or Rincón (West Side)
tours.description: 3 hours • All ages

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan and Dorado City, Vega Baja, Toa Baja
tours.description: Skip the taxi line at SJU with a professional driver waiting inside baggage claim. Enjoy personalized, reliable service, flight tracking, and friendly support—making your airport transfer smooth and stress-free.

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan, Río Grande, Loíza or Luquillo
tours.description: 45 minutes approx.

tours.name: San Juan Done Right! - Driving Tour
tours.description: Explore San Juan’s rich history and vibrant neighborhoods on a 4-hour guided driving tour. Visit iconic forts, historic sites, art districts, and luxurious areas, ending in Old San Juan for sunset or dinner. Comfortable shoes recommended.

tours.name: 2-hour Sightseeing at Old San Juan Experience!
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s rich history and stunning views on a guided 2- or 4-hour tour from San Juan. Visit forts, explore old town attractions, and relax at Piñones’s beaches and local eateries. An unforgettable cultural adventure.

tours.name: Private Beach Sunset Tour
tours.description: Enjoy a private 90-minute ride along secluded beaches and quiet dirt roads in Vieques. Swim in crystal-clear waters, pass ancient trees, and capture unforgettable photos of your adventure.

tours.name: Light Tackle Fishing
tours.description: Join a guided fishing trip using live or artificial bait, tailored to your skill level. Enjoy full tackle, drinks, and expert guidance on a fully insured boat—perfect for all ages and groups up to five.

tours.name: Zipline + Toro Bike Transportation Combo
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 8-hour adventure with the unique Zipline & Toro Bike Combo. Soar across seven thrilling zipline cables and pedal on the world's longest cable bike circuit, offering breathtaking views of the north coast. Perfect for families, this unforgettable excursion combines excitement and stunning landscapes in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: SCUBA Diving 2 Tank Adventure for Certified Divers with PADI Instructor- Private
tours.description: Join Captain Scotty and Ruthie for a personalized 2-tank scuba adventure on stunning reefs. Enjoy expert guidance, calm teaching, and a relaxing day of diving or snorkeling, topped with delicious food and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Private Family Friendly Snorkeling Adventure in Puerto Rico
tours.description: Snorkel a vibrant coral reef with expert guides, learn about sea life, and spot turtles, rays, and sharks. Enjoy a homemade meal on the boat, plus video highlights of your unforgettable underwater adventure.

tours.name: Snorkel In Culebra Island with Turtles
tours.description: Swim among sea turtles in crystal-clear Tamarindo Beach waters, guided by bilingual experts. Snorkel gear, photos, and marine facts make this 1.5-hour adventure unforgettable—reserve early for limited spots.

tours.name: Discover Scuba Diving for 1st Time Divers
tours.description: Join a beginner-friendly scuba dive with Ruthie, a calm PADI instructor, and explore vibrant coral reefs. Overcome water fears, learn basic skills, and enjoy a full day of underwater adventure, education, and delicious food.

tours.name: Ruta Ancestral
tours.description: Explore the Caonillas River’s waterfalls, rocks with ancient petroglyphs like the "Danzante," and lush wildlife in a 4-hour adventure full of thrills, history, and indigenous culture—guided and safe for ages 12 and up.

tours.name: Ruta al Cañon Blanco
tours.description: Explore the stunning Blanco Canyon in a 3-hour adventure, marvel at rock formations like a sofa, and swim in crystal-clear pools. All gear and a guide included—just bring your sense of adventure!

tours.name: Private Half Day East Coast Keys & Snorkel Adventure (Most Popular🔥)
tours.description: Embark on a private beach day tour to the stunning waters of Icacos, Palomino, and Palominito, where you can snorkel among vibrant marine life and capture breathtaking photos. With a licensed captain, snorkeling gear, and refreshments included, this unforgettable adventure offers a taste of paradise and a touch of cinematic history.

tours.name: Private Culebra Island Day Trip, Snorkel & Town (Favorite🔥)
tours.description: Embark on an 8-hour adventure to Culebra Island, where you'll explore charming town streets and pristine beaches. Snorkel among vibrant reefs and swim with sea turtles at Tamarindo Beach. Enjoy a private boat experience complete with refreshments and snorkeling gear, making this trip truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Puerto Rico Nurse Sharks Seafari
tours.description: Embark on a 3.5-hour Eco Snorkel Tour in Santa Isabel, Puerto Rico, guided by a Marine Biologist. Dive into crystal-clear waters to swim with sharks, turtles, and rays, transforming your view of the ocean. No prior experience is needed, making this an unforgettable adventure for all!

tours.name: Puerto Rico Nurse Sharks Seafari Private Tour
tours.description: Swim alongside sharks, turtles, and rays in Puerto Rico’s clear waters with a marine biologist. No experience needed—just bring your gear and curiosity for a memorable, educational ocean adventure.

tours.name: Day in The Cay (Sandbar)
tours.description: Embark on a 4-hour adventure to Caracoles Cay or a favorite sandbar in La Parguera. Enjoy swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing in crystal-clear waters, complemented by snacks and cocktails. On your return, admire the vibrant "Casetas of La Parguera" before exploring the town's fresh seafood and local cuisine.

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan, Bayamón or Caguas
tours.description: All ages

tours.name: Bertram 74 foot Private Yacht
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking islands of Icacos and Palomino on a private boat ride with family or friends. Enjoy an unforgettable adventure complete with a captain, floats, snacks, and drinks. Relax and soak up the sun while creating lasting memories in the stunning waters of Puerto Rico.

tours.name: El Yunque National Forest: The Road 191 Corridor - Half Day
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 4-hour journey through El Yunque National Forest, Puerto Rico's only tropical rainforest. Discover stunning La Coca Waterfall, ascend the Yokahú Observation Tower for breathtaking views, and enjoy a refreshing river swim. This unique tour combines adventure, nature, and unforgettable memories for all ages.

tours.name: Snorkel Gear Rental
tours.description: Experience the thrill of snorkeling at Tamarindo Beach with top-quality gear and safety equipment. Enjoy a full day of adventure from 7:30 am to 2 pm, exploring the vibrant underwater world of Culebra Island at your own pace, guided by essential safety information for a memorable aquatic journey.

tours.name: Private Boat Tour Fajardo Local Keys
tours.description: Enjoy a 5-hour boat trip to stunning local cayos like Icacos or Palomino, with a private captain, music, snacks, paddleboarding, and snorkeling. Relax on floating mats or swim in crystal-clear waters—an eco-friendly adventure!

tours.name: CULEBRA ISLAND
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable day with friends or family aboard a 30FT Grady-White Marlin, exploring stunning local cays like Icacos and Palomino. Enjoy a private captain, delicious snacks, and snorkeling gear while soaking up the sun. Experience the beauty of nature and create lasting memories in a serene setting.

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan and Humacao
tours.description: All ages

tours.name: Full Day Cave Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 9-hour adventure across Puerto Rico's stunning north coast! Explore breathtaking karst landscapes, delve into impressive caves with expert guides, and unwind at picturesque waterfalls. Capture unforgettable moments while immersing yourself in the island's rich history and natural beauty, making this experience truly unique and memorable.

tours.name: Aqua Bikes Rental
tours.description: Glide effortlessly across calm lagoon waters on our stable water bikes, spotting vibrant marine life up close. Perfect for all skill levels, this eco-friendly adventure offers a fun, relaxing way to explore the natural beauty of Condado Lagoon.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Guided Tour
tours.description: Explore El Yunque’s lush trails, swim in clear rivers, and enjoy breathtaking views. With guided stops at waterfalls, a tower, and a bridge, this 4-hour adventure offers nature’s wonders just a trip away.

tours.name: Transfers from/to San Juan, Adjuntas or Utuado
tours.description: Experience seamless travel from SJU Airport with a professional driver waiting just for you. Enjoy personalized service, real-time flight tracking, and convenient communication. Your driver will greet you inside Baggage Claim, ensuring a stress-free start to your journey. Elevate your arrival with this unique and friendly transportation service!

tours.name: Elegant Yacht Fajardo or Culebra Island
tours.description: Up to 12 people

tours.name: Puerto Rico Bluewater Spearfishing Daytrips
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable fishing adventure off the coast of Rincón, where the Atlantic's deep waters teem with pelagic fish. Experience thrilling catches like Wahoo and Tuna while enjoying expert guidance, stunning photos, and delicious snacks. Multi-day trips offer the best chance for fair seas and clear waters.

tours.name: Puerto Rico Snorkeling Adventures
tours.description: Experience the enchanting beauty of Puerto Rico's west coast on a full-day adventure. Discover hidden bays, serene beaches, and 18th-century shipwrecks while snorkeling in pristine waters. Enjoy a freshly prepared seafood lunch and capture memories with included photos and videos, all tailored to the day's unique conditions.

tours.name: EL YUNQUE RAINFOREST TOUR
