tours.description: Experience the thrill of the El Yunque Rainforest Tour, where you’ll hike through lush landscapes, glide down natural slides, and leap into refreshing pools from towering rocks. With breathtaking scenery and delightful snacks along the way, this adventure promises unforgettable moments in nature's paradise.

tours.name: Sunset Private Boat on an Island
tours.description: Embark on a private boat sunset experience on a secluded island in Puerto Rico. Perfect for romantic moments or gatherings with friends and family, this unique adventure includes a licensed captain, refreshing drinks, and a delightful fruit platter. Enjoy breathtaking views and create unforgettable memories in a serene setting.

tours.name: 1/2 Day Private Charter (4 Hours)
tours.description: Sail with friends for 4.5 hours on a spacious boat, enjoying beach stops, water toys, Bluetooth music, and stunning sea views. Relax on trampolines, sip drinks, and soak up the sun in an exclusive, lively setting.

tours.name: Private Boat To Icacos island & Palomino 7 People Max
tours.description: Set sail on a private boat from Fajardo to Puerto Rico’s stunning Icacos and Palomino cays. Swim, snorkel, relax, and enjoy drinks and music all day—perfect for creating unforgettable island memories.

tours.name: Sunset Sail (2.5 Hours)
tours.description: Sail into Vieques' stunning sunset on Cordelia, where fiery skies meet tranquil waters. Enjoy cold drinks, music, and cozy seating on this shared 2-hour voyage—perfect for romance or friends. Book your sunset escape now!

tours.name: 3/4 Day Private Charter (6 Hours)
tours.description: Sail for 6.5 hours on a spacious boat with friends, enjoying water toys, scenic views, and relaxing spots like trampolines and bean bags. Swim, play, and soak up the sun in an exclusive, fun-filled adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque Waterfalls Forest Tiny House
tours.description: Relax in a cozy tiny house surrounded by lush forest views. Cook, unwind, and connect with nature in this peaceful retreat featuring a fully-equipped kitchen, comfy bed, outdoor shower, and scenic windows.

tours.name: El Yunque Glamping Experience Nights
tours.description: Experience the enchanting Rainforest Glamping, where modern comforts meet the wild beauty of nature. Stay in cozy tents with queen-sized beds and enjoy amenities like a small kitchen and outdoor dining. Disconnect from the hustle and immerse yourself in the serene sounds of the rainforest for an unforgettable getaway.

tours.name: El Yunque Glamping Experience with River View Nights
tours.description: Experience the enchanting Rainforest Glamping, where modern comforts meet nature's embrace. Stay in cozy tents with queen beds and enjoy amenities like a small kitchen and outdoor dining. Disconnect from the hustle and immerse yourself in the serene sounds of the rainforest for an unforgettable getaway. Book your adventure today!

tours.name: Cruiser 36
tours.description: Experience the beauty of Icacos and Palomino islands aboard the luxurious 38 Cruiser Yacht. With a spacious cabin, kitchen, and air conditioning, this 4 to 6-hour voyage promises comfort and relaxation. Enjoy the sea breeze, music, and unforgettable moments with family and friends in a stunning setting.

tours.name: Rainforest Cave Tubing Adventure
tours.description: Explore underground caves, tube down rivers, hike rugged trails, and jump into waterfalls on a thrilling 4-5 hour adventure. Perfect for adrenaline seekers ready to feel like a real Jurassic explorer.

tours.name: Fairline 65' Luxurious Sport Yacht Rental
tours.description: Sail into six hours of fun with a crew, snacks, drinks, music, and floating toys. Relax on deck or splash around—your perfect day on the water awaits with everything included for a memorable escape.

tours.name: Cruiser 36' Yacht Rental
tours.description: Sail into six hours of fun with a crewed yacht, music, tasty snacks, refreshing drinks, and relaxing floats. Perfect for making unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Sunseeker Yacht Rental
tours.description: Set sail for six hours of fun with a captain, snacks, drinks, music, and relaxing floats. Enjoy the sea, good company, and endless sunshine on this all-inclusive yacht adventure.

tours.name: El Conquistador Mini Boat Aquafari
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the Miniboat AQUAFARI Tour at El Conquistador Resort! Navigate the stunning islands of Palomino, Icacos, and Lobos in your own miniboat. Enjoy snorkeling among vibrant coral reefs, breathtaking views, and refreshing beverages, all while creating unforgettable memories in the beautiful Caribbean waters.

tours.name: Culebrita Boat Day Trip - For Guest Already on Culebra
tours.description: Sail to Culebrita, a snorkeler’s paradise with crystal-clear waters, white beaches, and hidden lighthouse ruins. Enjoy snorkeling, paddleboarding, and relaxing in the sun—an unforgettable day on Puerto Rico’s stunning island.

tours.name: San Juan Bay Sightseeing Cruise (New)
tours.description: Embark on a memorable private boat ride in San Juan's stunning bay, complete with a licensed captain and a lively music system. Enjoy a small charcuterie board and sip on champagne or white wine as you soak in the history and beauty of the area. An experience not to be missed!

tours.name: Puerto Rico Rock Climbing Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating rock climbing adventure in Puerto Rico's stunning karst belt region. Suitable for all skill levels, this guided experience combines breathtaking views, cultural insights, and thrilling climbs. Enjoy top-quality gear, refreshing snacks, and a scenic drive, leaving you with unforgettable memories and a deeper appreciation for the island's beauty.

tours.name: Culebra All-inclusive Boat & Snorkeling Adventure
tours.description: Sail to Culebra on a 46-foot boat for a full day of snorkeling in crystal-clear waters, white beaches, and vibrant sea life. Enjoy guided adventures, beach time, food, drinks, and hassle-free transport from San Juan.

tours.name: SSI Open Water Diver Course
tours.company: The Black Anchor Scuba Diving & Snorkeling
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey with the SSI Open Water Diver course at the stunning Crash Boat Beach. Led by experienced, SSI-certified instructors from the woman-owned Black Anchor dive school, you'll gain the skills to dive safely and confidently while connecting with a passionate community that shares your love for the ocean.

tours.name: EL CRIOLLO PRIVATE BEACH RIDE
tours.description: Glide along Vieques' stunning coastlines on gentle Paso Fino horses, surrounded by wildlife and island charm. Feel the breeze, hear the waves, and connect with nature on this unforgettable guided ride.

tours.name: Legacy Rum Tour
tours.description: Uncover the story behind the world's top-awarded rum in Puerto Rico. Dive into its origins, explore its iconic status, and join the Legacy Family for an unforgettable journey into premium craftsmanship.

tours.name: Scuba Dogs Gear Rental – Full Snorkeling Equipment
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s vibrant underwater world with top-quality gear, flexible rentals, and safety support—perfect for snorkelers and divers of all levels ready to dive in and make a splash.

tours.name: Seakindly Day Pass
tours.description: Enjoy a day at SeaKindly dock with access to showers, water entry, and scenic waterfront views. Bring your own gear and relax, coming and going as you please until closing. Perfect for independent riders.

tours.name: Snorkeling
tours.description: Explore vibrant coral reefs and abundant sea life just offshore from Fajardo. Snorkel or dive in calm Caribbean waters, with options for beginners and certified divers. All gear and guides included for a memorable adventure.

tours.name: Private Driving Tour of San Juan Highlights
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour private tour of San Juan, the second-oldest European settlement in the Americas. Discover historic Old San Juan, iconic forts, and the renowned El Convento Hotel. Experience vibrant districts like Santurce and El Condado, blending rich culture, stunning architecture, and beautiful beaches for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: San Juan Drive Around Food Tour™
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s vibrant neighborhoods on a 4-hour guided tour, tasting local foods, enjoying street art, and learning about Afro-Caribbean heritage. Support small businesses while soaking in the island’s rich culture and flavors.

tours.name: Surf and Waterfall adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with a professional instructor who tailors the lesson to your skill level and needs. Enjoy a fun-filled hour of paddling and balancing as you learn essential safety procedures and techniques to catch waves. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure on the water with friends and family!

tours.name: La Parguera Sunset PRIVATE Boat Tour
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking sunset at Mata la Gata on a private 2-hour boat tour. Relax on the water or take a refreshing swim in crystal-clear waves as the sun sets over Puerto Rico. This unique adventure combines stunning views with the tranquility of the sea, creating unforgettable memories.

tours.name: The Story of Old San Juan
tours.description: Stroll through Old San Juan’s vibrant streets, marvel at historic walls, colorful homes, and ancient fortifications, and uncover the secrets of this well-preserved 16th-century Spanish colonial gem.

tours.name: Night Tales in Old San Juan
tours.description: Step back into Spanish colonial history with a private 2-hour tour of Old San Juan’s legendary fortress city, where stories of battles and empire come alive through vivid tales and historic sights.

tours.name: Fajardo Keys: Palomino or Icacos • Full Day
tours.description: Set sail to stunning Icacos, Palomino, or Piñero beaches, only accessible by boat. Swim, snorkel with sea turtles, relax on calm waters, and enjoy a tasty lunch with ocean views on a luxury boat.

tours.name: Fajardo Keys: Palomino or Icacos • Half Day
tours.description: Sail to stunning Icacos, Palomino, or Piñero Keys on a private 4-hour boat trip. Swim, snorkel with sea turtles, relax on palm-shaded beaches, or enjoy lunch and drinks with vibrant ocean views. An unforgettable escape.

tours.name: Culebra Island - Full Day
tours.description: Embark on a luxurious day aboard a 36-foot yacht, exploring the stunning beaches of Culebra without the crowds. Enjoy a private getaway tailored to families, friends, or special occasions, all in a pet-friendly environment. Experience the beauty of exclusive spots at your own pace, creating unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Cueva Ventana Guided Cave Tour
tours.description: Step into Cueva Ventana’s rugged depths, where biologists reveal bats, snakes, and rare plants. Feel the thrill of exploring a natural cave rich in history and wildlife, walking steep stairs and uneven paths. This 75-minute adventure offers a fascinating glimpse into Puerto Rico’s ancient Taino culture and vibrant ecosystem.

tours.name: Round Trip Transportation From San Juan to the Culebra or Vieques Ferry
tours.description: Skip pricey taxis with our reliable shuttle from San Juan to Ceiba ferry. Enjoy stress-free, budget-friendly transport, timely pickups, and a smooth start and end to your island adventure to Culebra or Vieques.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest & Waterfalls - No Transportation
tours.description: Dive into Puerto Rico’s rainforest with rock slides, cliff jumps, and rope swings. Feel the thrill, soak in lush scenery, and enjoy local food—an adventure that creates unforgettable memories in just 6 hours.

tours.name: La Paseadora del Río Espíritu Santo Original Boat Tour
tours.description: Float along the Espiritu Santo River on a tranquil pontoon tour, spotting iguanas, turtles, and waterfowl among lush mangroves. Enjoy scenic views of El Yunque and the Atlantic, with relaxing refreshments and expert insights.

tours.name: Party Boat Tour
tours.description: Glide through lush mangroves and spot wildlife on a peaceful river cruise, then unwind on a pristine beach for hours of sun and surf. A perfect mix of nature’s beauty and pure relaxation awaits you.

tours.name: Finish Your SSI Referral
tours.company: The Black Anchor Scuba Diving & Snorkeling
tours.description: Complete your open water dives in stunning Puerto Rico at Crash Boat Beach, where calm, warm waters await. At The Black Anchor, we focus on empowering you to become a confident diver for life. Finish strong and dive proud as you earn your certification in this unforgettable setting.

tours.name: Private 3-Hour Sunset Charter
tours.description: Embark on a serene 3-hour sunset charter with Signature Dives, exploring Puerto Rico's stunning remote islands. Choose between scuba diving vibrant reefs or snorkeling in calm waters, followed by a tranquil beach stop. Capture unforgettable moments with underwater scooters and enjoy the perfect backdrop of golden-hour skies.

tours.name: Exclusive 5-Hour Culebra Charter
tours.description: Set sail on a 5-hour private boat to Culebra and Culebrita, where vibrant reefs, calm waters, and white-sand beaches await. Snorkel, dive, or relax in a personalized, unforgettable ocean adventure.

tours.name: San Cristóbal Castle & Old San Juan Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s vibrant streets, historic forts, and colorful neighborhoods on a guided tour. Enjoy stunning views, colonial architecture, and rich history—an unforgettable journey through Puerto Rico’s past.

tours.name: Sunseeker Predator 82'
tours.description: Experience luxury on the Predator 82 as you explore the stunning islands of Icacos, Palomino, Vieques, or Culebra. Accommodating up to twelve guests, this yacht features a bright saloon, spacious cockpit with a wet bar, and inviting sun decks, making it perfect for relaxation and entertainment on the water.

tours.name: Ferretti 70'
tours.description: Experience the ultimate luxury aboard the Predator 82 or Ferretti 70' as you explore the stunning islands of Icacos, Palomino, Vieques, or Culebra. With spacious interiors, elegant teak decking, and top-notch amenities, enjoy sunbathing, dining, and easy water access for an unforgettable day on the water.

tours.name: Sea Ray 65'
tours.description: Experience the ultimate luxury on the Predator 82 or Sea Ray 65' as you explore the stunning islands of Icacos, Palomino, Vieques, or Culebra. With spacious interiors, top-notch amenities, and exceptional outdoor spaces, these yachts promise unforgettable moments of relaxation and entertainment on the open water.

tours.name: Intrepid 47'
tours.description: Experience the ultimate luxury on the Predator 82 or Intrepid 47' as you explore the stunning islands of Icacos, Palomino, Vieques, or Culebra. With spacious interiors, top-notch amenities, and inviting outdoor spaces, these vessels promise unforgettable moments of relaxation and adventure on the sparkling waters.

tours.name: Lift eFoil Checkride
tours.description: Prove your skills on the water with a safety check ride, demonstrating control and confidence. Once approved, ride solo along Puerto Rico’s coast, mastering balance, turns, and speed in calm waters.

tours.name: NIGHT TRANSPORTATION - ONE WAY
tours.description: Enjoy seamless, safe transport with direct driver texts, monitored vehicles, and helpful lost-and-found service. Stay informed and in control for a smooth, worry-free ride wherever you go.

tours.name: Mountain Bike Rental
tours.description: Ride through San Juan’s vibrant streets and scenic coastlines at your own pace. With flexible rentals, secure locks, and helmets on request, enjoy an active adventure perfect for solo, couples, or families.

tours.name: Banana Boat Ride
tours.description: Hold on tight as you race across the water on a banana boat, feeling the wind and spray in just 20 thrilling minutes. Perfect for adventure seekers aged 7 and up.

tours.name: Semi-Private Ponce Historical City Tour
tours.description: Explore Ponce’s rich history with a guided walk through its charming plazas, historic buildings, and the iconic Serrallés Castle. Enjoy local sights, architecture, and a taste of Puerto Rico’s cultural heart in just one day.

tours.name: Old San Juan Walking Tour
tours.description: Stroll through colorful streets of Old San Juan, marvel at historic forts, and soak in ocean views. A lively 2-hour tour reveals centuries of Caribbean charm, ending with tips to explore more or enjoy local flavors.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest  Hiking Tour
tours.description: Hike through Puerto Rico’s lush El Yunque Rainforest, reach stunning viewpoints, see La Coca Falls, enjoy authentic local food, swim in scenic Río Mameyes, and relax in nature’s beauty on this full-day adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque-Luquillo Beach and Bioluminescent Bay
tours.description: Starting at $159 | 10 Hours | Up to 8 People

tours.name: PADI Divemaster Course
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-day journey to become a PADI Divemaster with Sea Ventures in Puerto Rico. Experience personalized training in small groups, guided by globally experienced instructors. Enjoy comprehensive coursework, hands-on workshops, and free equipment rental, ensuring you gain the skills and confidence to thrive in the diving world.

tours.name: Full Day to Culebra
tours.description: Sail a private 36-foot boat to Culebra’s stunning beaches, snorkel with vibrant tropical fish, relax on pristine shores, and enjoy a personalized island escape on crystal-clear waters—all just for your group.

tours.name: Private Charter from Palmas Del Mar to Vieques (Day Trip + Bio Bay)
tours.description: Set sail from Palmas Del Mar to Vieques for a day of snorkeling, swimming, and relaxing on a floating carpet. Enjoy unlimited rum punch, a BBQ lunch, and end with a magical glow in the bioluminescent bay.

tours.name: Ponce's Puerto Rico's Bucketlist Private 3 day Package
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable three-day adventure in Puerto Rico, exploring the rich history of Old San Juan, the vibrant street art of Santurce, and the lush Toro Negro Tropical Rainforest. Experience breathtaking waterfalls, relax on pristine beaches, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, and witness stunning sunsets, all while immersing yourself in local culture and heritage.

tours.name: UTV - VIP Tour
tours.description: Hop into a rugged UTV and cruise through lush forests to reach Cueva Ventana, Puerto Rico’s stunning natural wonder. Explore the ancient cave with expert guides, marvel at bats and rare plants, and learn about Taino history—all in an exciting 1-hour, 15-minute adventure filled with sights, sounds, and stories.

tours.name: INDIAN CAVE & LA PLANTA WATERFALLS ADVENTURE
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden gems with petroglyphs, stunning rock arches, and waterfalls. Hike through wild landscapes, swim in crystal-clear springs, and enjoy an authentic, peaceful escape into nature’s beauty.

tours.name: Independent Segway C80 Rental
tours.description: Zip through San Juan on a sleek eMoped with smart locks, powerful motor, and smooth suspension. Cruise coastal roads or hidden streets comfortably, even if you're new to riding. Explore independently and effortlessly.

tours.name: Black Sand Beach Tour
tours.description: Gallop through lush trails and splash in the black sand beach, guided by friendly horses and experts. Perfect for all levels, this scenic ride ends with ocean fun and unforgettable views in Vieques.

tours.name: SSI Certification
tours.description: Dive into the ocean from day one, mastering essential skills with expert instructors. Explore vibrant underwater landscapes, gain a recognized certification, and unlock a lifetime of global diving adventures.

tours.name: SSI Advanced Open Water Certification
tours.description: Earn your Advanced Open Water Diver cert by choosing 4 SSI specialties like Night or Deep Diving. Dive vibrant Puerto Rico waters, boost your skills, and explore top sites—all with expert guidance in a flexible, fun environment.

tours.name: Harvest & Heritage Tour (Late August - January)
tours.description: Stroll through lush coffee plantations with stunning mountain views, learn the journey from bean to cup, and enjoy unlimited fresh coffee samples. Immerse yourself in nature and coffee craftsmanship in one unforgettable tour.

tours.name: Private La Paseadora del Río Espíritu Santo Boat Tour
tours.description: Enjoy a private boat tour on the Espiritu Santo River, exploring lush wildlife and stunning views of El Yunque and the Atlantic at your own pace. An intimate, personalized nature escape just for you.

tours.name: 5 Hour Day Tour
tours.description: Sail aboard the Oh Gee catamaran for scenic beaches and vibrant snorkeling. Relish a buffet lunch, fresh fruits, and soft drinks as you explore underwater wonders and relax on pristine shores.

tours.name: Sunset Tours
tours.description: Sail into sunset on the Oh Gee catamaran, soaking in stunning water views while nibbling on a charcuterie board and sipping refreshing drinks as the sky turns golden.

tours.name: Private Charter
tours.description: Embark on a memorable adventure aboard the Oh Gee, featuring flexible departure times. Dive into two stunning snorkeling spots, relax on the beach, and savor a delicious buffet lunch. With refreshing drinks, fresh fruits, and fun activities like paddle boarding, this experience promises personalized enjoyment on the water.

tours.name: Non Member Solo Practice
tours.description: Refine your e-Foil skills solo on calm waters, gaining confidence and control. Enjoy an hour of freedom to practice, improve, and master your ride with support nearby, all against Puerto Rico’s stunning coastline.

tours.name: Beach Hopping Tour/Playas Tour
tours.description: Explore up to 9 beaches in a flexible day, from calm bays to black sands. Customize your visit—stay longer at a few or hop quickly between many. Optional gear and snacks available for a perfect beach adventure.

tours.name: Natural River Slide + Beach and El Portal del Yunque Full Day Tour
tours.description: Stroll through Puerto Rico’s lush rainforest, learn about its wildlife, then unwind on the stunning Luquillo Beach with turquoise waters and white sand. Perfect for nature lovers and sun seekers alike.

tours.name: River Caving Experience
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour adventure at Arenales Cave Systems, a hidden gem in Puerto Rico. Hike to the river's edge, explore unique caves, and swim in crystal-clear waters surrounded by lush vegetation. Experience stunning rock formations and learn about the natural habitat while floating through enchanting underground tunnels.

tours.name: Puerto Rican Moonshine Tasting
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Puerto Rican moonshine, or Pitorro! Enjoy a captivating narrative of its rich history while tasting a variety of tropical fruit-infused flavors and premium cream liqueurs. Each experience offers unique combinations, including artisanal pastries, making it a memorable journey through Puerto Rican culture.

tours.name: Off the beaten path @ Yunque Rainforest (Full Day)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of El Yunque Rainforest, the only tropical rainforest in the U.S. on this adventurous small-group tour. Hike through stunning landscapes, discover hidden waterfalls, and enjoy natural water slides. With opportunities for cliff jumping and rope swings, this unforgettable journey immerses you in the beauty of Puerto Rico's wilderness.

tours.name: Thirty Minute Jet Ski Rentals
tours.description: Experience a thrilling 30-minute ride around the Kioskos of Luquillo beach, with breathtaking views of the Yunque Rainforest. This unique adventure offers the chance to share the excitement with a passenger, making it a memorable outing for friends or family. Enjoy the perfect blend of fun and stunning scenery!

tours.name: One Hour Jet Ski Rentals
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating hour exploring the vibrant Kioskos of Luquillo beach, all while taking in breathtaking views of the Yunque Rainforest. This unique adventure offers the perfect blend of fun and natural beauty, making it a memorable outing for you and a passenger.

tours.name: Aventoura Scooter Rentals – Explore Puerto Rico Your Way
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s stunning west coast on a scooter—visit beaches, charming towns, and hidden coves at your own pace. Enjoy ocean views, local eats, and unforgettable sunsets on two wheels.

tours.name: Catamaran Day Trip (Icacos Island)
tours.description: Sail on a 47’ catamaran to Icacos Island, snorkel reefs, relax on pristine beaches, enjoy tropical drinks, and indulge in a delicious buffet. Perfect for all ages, with music, sun, and unforgettable Caribbean adventures.

tours.name: Light Tackle Fishing Charters
tours.description: Hook into Puerto Rico’s top lagoons for thrilling tarpon and snook fishing. Enjoy scenic mangroves, birdlife, and expert gear on a 4-hour adventure from Cangrejos Marina—perfect for small groups seeking big catches.

tours.name: Deep Sea Fishing Charter (Full day)
tours.description: Sail into deep waters aboard The Legend for a full day of thrilling sport fishing, targeting marlins, sailfish, tuna, and more. Enjoy luxury, live bait, snacks, and the chance to reel in your biggest catch in Puerto Rico.

tours.name: Sunset Sail

tours.description: Embark on a private sunset sailing adventure along Fajardo’s coast, where you’ll enjoy breathtaking views and a serene atmosphere. With a dedicated crew, savor delicious food and drinks while gliding through crystal-clear waters. This unique experience promises unforgettable colors and intimate moments, making it the highlight of your Puerto Rican getaway.

tours.name: Half-Day Sail Experience
tours.description: Embark on a unique private sailing adventure in Puerto Rico, where you’ll soak up the sun, swim in warm Caribbean waters, and enjoy personalized service aboard your own yacht. With stunning island destinations, on-board amenities, and a relaxing atmosphere, this unforgettable experience is perfect for creating cherished memories with loved ones.

tours.name: JetSki Rental Aguadilla
tours.description: Race across the water on a sleek GTX Pro Jet Ski, with VIP service and chances to see dolphins and turtles. Perfect for solo or duo adventures, from quick thrills to full-day fun on the open sea.

tours.name: Full Day South, Caracoles Cay & Bio Bay Boat VIP Experience
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable 8.5-hour adventure that promises excitement and discovery. Engage in unique activities that will leave lasting memories, all while enjoying the thrill of exploration. Join us for a day filled with fun and new experiences that you won't want to miss!

tours.name: The Tasting Tour - Beers & Cigars - Made in PR
tours.description: Sip four craft beers at Ocean Lab, then explore a lush farm with over 26 crops, learn about organic farming, and enjoy a cigar and drink. A perfect blend of seaside fun and rural charm in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: Primavera Camp
tours.description: Join Puerto Rico’s only rock climbing camp to explore fossils, learn gear, and conquer boulders. Enjoy outdoor games, hikes, and hands-on geology in a fun, educational adventure connecting nature and culture.

tours.name: eFoil Coaching experienced only
tours.description: Elevate your eFoil skills with personalized coaching in San Juan’s calm waters. Ride side-by-side with an instructor, refine your control, and master turns for a confident, thrilling flight experience.

tours.name: Wing Foil Intro and First Lesson Combo
tours.description: Learn wing foiling in calm, flat waters at Pier 6. With personalized coaching, stable boards, and a floating platform, you'll build confidence and master the basics in just two hours. All gear included.

tours.name: Wing Foil Coaching From Ski
tours.description: Boost your wing foil skills with personalized, real-time coaching on San Juan Bay. Jet ski support keeps you riding longer, focusing on balance and control while we guide you step-by-step in safe, protected waters.

tours.name: Blue Doubloon
tours.description: Secure a one-hour dock slot at Seakindly for Blue Doubloon operations—perfect for quick pickups, drop-offs, or vessel access. Availability varies during scheduled hours.

tours.name: Day Sail
tours.description: Embark on a memorable day sail aboard SPREAD EAGLE II, departing from Fajardo to the stunning Icacos Island. Enjoy a buffet lunch, refreshing drinks, and the chance to snorkel among vibrant reefs teeming with colorful fish. Relax on pristine beaches or under the shade, soaking in the tranquil Caribbean atmosphere.

tours.name: Alegría Day Cruises
tours.description: Join a 3.5-hour luxury boat cruise around Vieques with snorkeling, kayaking, paddleboarding, and relaxing on deck. Enjoy light snacks, drinks, and all gear included—perfect for groups of 2 to 6.

tours.name: Day Sail Experience
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing along Fajardo's stunning coast on a private day tour. Glide over turquoise waters, explore idyllic offshore islands, and enjoy personalized service from a dedicated crew. This unforgettable adventure combines relaxation, romance, and fun, making it the perfect highlight of your Puerto Rican getaway.

tours.name: Sailing Basics & Lessons
tours.description: Embark on a private sailing adventure along Puerto Rico's stunning east coast! This immersive experience combines luxury and hands-on learning, allowing you to master sailing skills while enjoying breathtaking views. Celebrate your newfound abilities with swimming, snorkeling, and delicious snacks, all guided by friendly captains in a serene setting.

tours.name: Catamaran Yacht / Single Day
tours.description: Sail to pristine uninhabited islands near Puerto Rico, snorkel, paddleboard, enjoy music, and relax with snacks and WiFi. All luxury amenities included—just bring your smile and sense of adventure.

tours.name: Private Beginner Wing Lesson
tours.description: Learn to wing foil in just 2 hours with private instruction, safety gear, and personalized coaching. Feel the wind, stand on a paddleboard, and sail into your first ride—perfect for beginners and experienced riders alike.

tours.name: Catamaran Afternoon Trip (Icacos Island)
tours.description: Sail to Icacos Island on a spacious 47' catamaran, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, enjoy beach games, dance to lively music, and sip tropical drinks. Perfect for families, groups, or solo travelers seeking fun and relaxation.

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay Glassbottom Boat Tours
tours.description: Sail to La Parguera’s bioluminescent bay on a stable glassbottom catamaran, glowing dinoflagellates lighting up the water beneath you. Enjoy stargazing, coastal views, and a safe, unforgettable hour of natural wonder.

tours.name: Glassbottom Kayak Rental
tours.description: Paddle solo through crystal-clear waters in a glassbottom kayak, spotting colorful fish, coral, and wildlife like iguanas and manatees. Enjoy stunning mangrove scenery in a safe, self-guided Caribbean adventure.

tours.name: Rainforest Full Day Tour from San Juan
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s lush rainforest, walk through vibrant trails, then unwind on Luquillo Beach’s white sands and turquoise waters. Enjoy nature, local sights, and a relaxing beach break in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: Reef Fishing
tours.description: Join a guided fishing trip near reefs, targeting seabed species. All gear, bait, drinks, and a licensed captain are included. Perfect for all ages, with flexible durations—adventure awaits on calm waters.

tours.name: Lagoon & Bird Watching Tour
tours.description: Glide through San José, Torrecilla, and Piñones lagoons, spotting rare birds and vibrant mangroves. Perfect for relaxing, photography, and connecting with nature’s hidden waterways in just 2 hours.

tours.name: WELLCRAFT 30
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Icacos and Palomino Islands on a private boat ride with family or friends. Enjoy an unforgettable adventure complete with a knowledgeable captain, refreshing snacks, and drinks. Create lasting memories as you explore the stunning waters of Puerto Rico in style and comfort.

tours.name: Beach Day in Culebra -Departure 9am - Return 5:30PM
tours.description: Enjoy a full day on Culebra’s stunning beaches, snorkeling vibrant reefs, and relaxing on Flamenco Beach. Ferry rides, beach gear, and local transfers make it easy to unwind and explore this tropical paradise.

tours.name: MOKU After School Surf Program
tours.description: Join the Moku Surf Puerto Rico Surf Program at Jobos Beach for an unforgettable adventure! Designed for kids aged 8 to 13, this program combines surfing with essential ocean knowledge and teamwork. Participants will enhance their skills while enjoying a fun, respectful environment that promotes personal growth and cooperation.

tours.name: SSI - Referral Diver
tours.description: Finish your scuba certification in tropical waters, with most training done at home. Enjoy fun dives, stunning marine life, and free photos—making your vacation both exciting and stress-free.

tours.name: 2026 Jet Ski Rentals
tours.description: Race along Rincon’s coast on brand-new GTX 130 jet skis, spotting dolphins and turtles. Perfect for all skill levels, bring a friend for free, and enjoy stunning ocean views, beach toys, and more at Playa Lalas.

tours.name: Scuba Skills Update
tours.description: Revisit the underwater world with confidence through two guided dives and a hands-on skills review. Perfect for returning divers, this Puerto Rico course boosts safety, buoyancy, and fun—plus, enjoy free underwater photos.

tours.name: Desecheo Island
tours.description: Dive into Desecheo Island’s vibrant coral gardens and swim alongside tropical fish, sea turtles, rays, and nurse sharks. Enjoy two dives, underwater photos, snacks, and expert guidance in Puerto Rico’s marine paradise.

tours.name: Sunset Yoga Beach Class
tours.description: Unwind at sunset with a calming beach yoga session, where ocean breezes and vibrant skies create the perfect setting to relax, reflect, and reconnect with your body and mind.

tours.name: Pork Highway and Culinary Adventure in Guavate
tours.description: Savor juicy roasted pork along Guavate’s lively Pork Highway, dance to salsa beats, cruise scenic mountain roads, and relax by a peaceful mountain river—an authentic Puerto Rican cultural feast.

tours.name: CASA BACARDI - VIP FOUNDER'S EXPIRIENCE
tours.description: Step into BACARDÍ’s hidden warehouses, taste rare rums straight from the source, and learn secret techniques from experts. An exclusive behind-the-scenes tour that reveals the craft behind world-famous rum.

tours.name: Solo Practice Foil Club members ONLY
tours.description: Soar above the water on a premium eFoil, gliding solo for 60 minutes of pure freedom. Perfect for refining skills or relaxing alone, with exclusive club perks and top gear to elevate your experience.

tours.name: Mother’s Day Private Snorkeling Boat Tour
tours.description: Enjoy a 4-hour private boat tour along Puerto Rico’s East Coast with guided snorkeling over colorful reefs, relaxing beach time, floating mats, snacks, drinks, and music. Perfect for small groups and pet-friendly adventures.

tours.name: Jetski Rental
tours.description: Feel the thrill of jet skiing on our perfect beach with safety gear included. Ride solo or with a friend for 30 minutes of adrenaline, capturing every moment. Book now—adventure awaits anytime, subject to availability.

tours.name: Coastal Boat Cruise: Reefs, Mangroves & Island Beats
tours.description: Sail Puerto Rico’s coast in style on a private, luxury boat. Customize your vibe—party, relax, or explore hidden mangroves—while enjoying stunning scenery, great music, and professional photos. An exclusive adventure awaits.

tours.name: 2025 Rock Climbing Christmas Camp
tours.description: A fun 3-day climbing adventure for kids 4-10, boosting coordination, balance, and problem-solving. With expert guidance, children explore nature, build confidence, and reach personal goals in a safe, playful environment.

tours.name: Bar Hopping LGBTQ+ Experience – A Night Out in San Juan
tours.description: Join a lively LGBTQ+ night tour in San Juan, where locals guide you through welcoming bars and clubs. Dance to Caribbean beats, meet new friends, and celebrate freedom in an unforgettable, inclusive atmosphere.

tours.name: Coastal Cruise Bike Tour to Old San Juan
tours.description: Pedal through Puerto Rico’s vibrant streets and scenic coastlines on a guided bike tour. Explore historic Old San Juan, relax at beaches, and enjoy panoramic views—perfect for all ages seeking adventure and culture.

tours.name: ATV
tours.description: Race through El Yunque’s lush rainforest on a powerful ATV, splashing streams and climbing hills. Cool off in pristine Mameyes River pools and embrace the wild, unforgettable adventure in Puerto Rico’s vibrant wilderness.

tours.name: LLUVIA DE ESTRELLAS NIGHT RIDE
tours.description: Enjoy a peaceful, guided horseback ride through quiet countryside or coastlines, ending with a stargazing session under Vieques’ clear skies—perfect for intimate groups seeking serenity and natural beauty.

tours.name: Icacos Snorkeling & Beach tour
tours.description: Sail from Puerto Del Rey to pristine Icacos Island, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, relax on sandy beaches, and enjoy a delicious deli lunch. Perfect for all ages—adventure and relaxation await on this unforgettable island escape.

tours.name: Day Sail & Snorkel
tours.description: Sail Puerto Rico’s pristine waters on The Salty Dog, snorkel colorful reefs, relax on white beaches, enjoy tropical drinks, and savor a tasty lunch. Perfect for celebrating special moments in paradise.

tours.name: Discovery Dive
tours.description: Dive into warm, clear waters from the beach in Puerto Rico’s reefs and caves. Spot colorful fish, sea turtles, rays, and dolphins. Perfect for beginners or certified divers seeking adventure—no experience needed.

tours.name: SCUBA Diving - Certified Divers Only
tours.description: Explore vibrant reefs and hidden caves off northwest Puerto Rico’s coast. Perfect for beginners and pros, enjoy a safe, stunning underwater adventure with clear waters and unforgettable marine sights.

tours.name: SSI - Open Water Diver
tours.description: Explore the underwater world with personalized lessons and certifications from Open Water to Dive Master. Our expert guides make every dive safe, exciting, and unforgettable—your adventure begins here.

tours.name: Old San Juan Walking Tour (NT)
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s enchanting cobblestone streets, colorful facades, and historic landmarks. Walk through centuries-old architecture and vibrant culture, creating unforgettable memories in this lively, picturesque district.

tours.name: Tarzan Tour
tours.description: Conquer waterfalls, rappel 250 feet, explore caves, and float down wild rivers in a thrilling 4-hour adventure. Perfect for active explorers ready to challenge themselves amid stunning natural scenery.

tours.name: West Side Experience Puerto Rico
tours.description: Relax on Playa Buyé’s golden sands, explore Cabo Rojo’s lush wildlife refuge, and marvel at shimmering salt flats. End with charming villages and fresh local dishes—an unforgettable Puerto Rican coastal adventure.

tours.name: Combo Tour El Yunque and Snorkeling
tours.description: Explore El Yunque rainforest’s waterfalls and lush trails, then snorkel in clear waters to see vibrant marine life. A full-day adventure blending nature, wildlife, and underwater wonders in Puerto Rico.

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay Boat Tour at La Parguera
tours.description: Swim in glowing waters at La Parguera’s bioluminescent bay, where microorganisms light up your every move. Enjoy a scenic boat ride, dinner in a fishing village, and a magical night of play and wonder.

tours.name: Escape If You Can
tours.description: Conquer four suspension bridges and soar on two ziplines, including a thrilling 131-foot free fall. Feel the rush of adventure in this 3-hour high-altitude escape—bring your courage and closed shoes!

tours.name: Toro Pass
tours.description: 4 Hours • Ages 7+ • 3 tours on the same day!

tours.name: Old San Juan Kids Scavenger Hunt
tours.description: Kids can explore Old San Juan’s colorful streets, visit landmarks like El Morro and La Fortaleza, solve fun clues, learn local history, and earn a treasure chest—all in a 2.5-hour, family-friendly scavenger hunt.

tours.name: Escape to Nurture Body and Soul with Lunch in Guavate + Cold Spring & Hot Spring
tours.description: Escape into Puerto Rico’s countryside with a scenic drive, delicious pork route lunch, stunning sea views, refreshing freshwater pool, relaxing hot springs, and a sweet coffee or ice-cream stop—an unforgettable day for body and soul.

tours.name: Hike to The Clouds & Forest Bathing
tours.description: Explore El Yunque with a guided hike, forest bathing, and stunning vistas. Enjoy waterfalls, mountain views, and river swims, all while immersing in nature’s tranquility and breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: Flight Day Trip Culebra Island from San Juan • Silver
tours.description: Fly to Culebra for a full day of sun, snorkeling, and lounging at Flamenco Beach. Enjoy hassle-free transfers, stunning scenery, and a luxurious experience—perfect for making unforgettable island memories.

tours.name: Flight Day Trip Culebra Island from Ceiba • Silver
tours.description: Fly to Culebra for a full day of sun, snorkeling, and lounging on Flamenco Beach. Enjoy round-trip flights, transfers, and beach amenities—creating unforgettable Puerto Rican memories in just 10 hours.

tours.name: Aquafari Flight Tour Culebra Island from San Juan
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden treasures with a full-day kayak, snorkel, and beach adventure on Culebra. Swim with turtles, explore coral gardens, and relax on Flamenco Beach—all in one unforgettable trip.

tours.name: Aquafari Flight Tour Culebra Island from Ceiba
tours.description: Kayak through turquoise waters, snorkel with turtles at vibrant coral gardens, and relax on Flamenco Beach—all in a full-day adventure exploring Culebra’s stunning beaches and marine life.

tours.name: Aquafari Ferry Tour from San Juan
tours.description: Swim with turtles, snorkel vibrant coral gardens, and kayak through turquoise waters at Culebra’s stunning beaches. A full-day adventure of marine wonders, scenic shores, and unforgettable island exploration awaits.

tours.name: Cressi Scuba ServiceS
tours.description: Get your gear ready at the Cressi Service Center, where expert staff quickly tune, repair, and ensure your equipment performs perfectly for your next underwater adventure.

tours.name: Icacos Island Private Charter
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable private tour with Caribe Bliss, exploring the stunning Icacos or Palomino Island. Enjoy snorkeling among vibrant marine life, relax on a floating pad, or savor tropical drinks while soaking in breathtaking views. Indulge in a delicious beachside lunch before returning, creating lasting memories in paradise.

tours.name: Kids Mini Kayak
tours.description: Paddle through the lush Condado Lagoon, home to manatees and vibrant reefs. Rent double or kids kayaks, enjoy peaceful waters, and soak in nature’s beauty—perfect for family fun or active relaxation at San Juan’s doorstep.

tours.name: Toro Bikes
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the world's longest cable bike circuit at Toro Verde Adventure Park! Pedal along a zipline cable, navigating through stunning tree-shaped platforms while soaking in breathtaking views of Puerto Rico's north coast. Perfect for families, this unique adventure allows four riders to share the excitement simultaneously.

tours.name: Icacos All Inclusive Boat Experience
tours.description: Swim in crystal-clear waters, snorkel vibrant reefs, and relax on pristine beaches at Icacos Island. Enjoy tropical drinks, lively music, and top-notch service on this all-inclusive day of adventure and fun.

tours.name: Morning Snorkeling Private Sail
tours.description: Host unforgettable celebrations on a private boat, from proposals to corporate events. Enjoy personalized service, stunning views, and a memorable experience crafted just for your special occasion.

tours.name: Southwest Beach Hopping Day-trip
tours.description: Enjoy a full day exploring calm mangrove waters at La Jungla beach, visit historic ruins, savor fresh seafood at Tamarindo, and witness stunning sunset views—an unforgettable family coastal adventure.

tours.name: Lionfish Class and Hunt
tours.description: Learn to safely hunt and harvest invasive Lionfish on a guided reef trip. Practice shooting, then process your catch right at the beach—help protect reefs and enjoy a delicious, sustainable meal.

tours.name: 2022 Ford Transit XL 350 Wagon Medium Roof
tours.description: Experience seamless transportation with certified drivers and comfortable seating for up to 13 passengers. Enjoy private tours with licensed guides, or convenient airport transfers for up to 10 passengers. Each service includes modern amenities like USB ports and air conditioning, ensuring a memorable journey tailored to your needs.

tours.name: Old San Juan Walking Experience (Day or Night)
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour walking tour of Old San Juan, Puerto Rico's historic capital. Explore the enchanting streets of "La ciudad amurallada," uncovering hidden secrets and rich culture. With expert guides, delve into 500 years of history as you visit iconic landmarks in this beautifully preserved city.

tours.name: Culebra Snorkeling Adventure + Flamenco Beach - Ferry Day Trip from Ceiba
tours.description: Enjoy a full day in Culebra with guided snorkeling, swimming with turtles, and relaxing on Flamenco Beach’s white sands. All transfers and gear included—just bring your sense of adventure and explore Puerto Rico’s underwater paradise.

tours.name: Barrilito Rum Experience with Old San Juan Private Tour
tours.description: Experience the rich heritage of Puerto Rico at Ron del Barrilito, the island's oldest rum brand. Explore the historic Hacienda Santa Ana, witness the rum-making process, and enjoy a private tour of Old San Juan. This unique journey blends exquisite rum tasting with captivating history, making for an unforgettable day.

tours.name: Crashboat Beach & Tour of Aguadilla
tours.description: Relax at Crash Boat Beach’s turquoise waters, then explore Aguadilla’s charming streets and ocean views. Enjoy snorkeling, a piña colada, and stunning scenery in a fun 6-hour adventure.

tours.name: Ponce & Yauco Historical & Cultural Tour
tours.description: Explore Ponce’s stunning architecture, ocean views, and vibrant culture, then visit Yauco’s colorful streets and coffee legacy. A full day of history, scenic beauty, and local flavor awaits you.

tours.name: Sunset Walking Tour in Old San Juan
tours.description: Experience the enchanting beauty of Old San Juan during sunset on this guided walking tour. Marvel at historic landmarks like El Morro Castle and the Governor's Mansion, while local guides share captivating stories. Enjoy a leisurely pace, ample photo opportunities, and the vibrant atmosphere of the city as day turns to night.

tours.name: Inside El Morro Castle & Old San Juan Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating walking tour of Old San Juan, exploring iconic landmarks like El Morro Castle, the San Juan Cathedral, and the Governor's Mansion. Led by knowledgeable local guides, this 2.5-hour adventure offers a deep dive into Puerto Rico's rich history and culture, making it an unforgettable experience.

tours.name: (Private) El Yunque Rainforest Adventure
tours.description: Explore El Yunque’s lush rainforest with a 5.5-hour adventure: hike muddy trails, swim, slide, swing like Tarzan, and relax by waterfalls. Includes gear, but requires good fitness and caution.

tours.name: Snorkel Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of snorkeling in Puerto Rico's stunning Caribbean waters with Aquatica Underwater Adventures. This unique half-day tour takes you directly from the shore to vibrant reefs, where you’ll encounter colorful fish, coral, and sea turtles, all guided by certified professionals. Dive into an unforgettable underwater adventure!

tours.name: Discovery Scuba Diving Adventure
tours.description: Dive into an unforgettable Scuba Diving Discovery Adventure in Rincon, Puerto Rico! Perfect for beginners, this 2.5-hour experience offers guided exploration of vibrant reefs under the watchful eye of certified instructors. Enjoy the comfort of shore dives and embrace the thrill of breathing underwater without the need for certification.

tours.name: Octo Diving Adventure (Hookah Diving)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Octopus Diving in Rincon, Puerto Rico, where no prior experience is needed! This unique dive combines the ease of snorkeling with the adventure of scuba, using a hookah air system. Explore vibrant coral reefs and encounter stunning marine life with the guidance of an expert.

tours.name: Smoke & Soil: A Journey Through Tobacco Traditions
tours.description: Experience the rich heritage of tobacco farming at Finca Neo Jibairo in Puerto Rico. Choose between the immersive "Plantation Explorer" tour, showcasing the cultivation process, or the interactive "Rolling Maestro" tour, where you can roll your own cigar under expert guidance. Discover the artistry and culture behind Puerto Rican cigars.

tours.name: Cave Hopping Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-6 hour adventure exploring Puerto Rico's natural wonders! Discover the stunning Cueva del Indio, home to ancient petroglyphs, and hike to the picturesque Swallow Bird Cave. Experience breathtaking views, unique wildlife, and perfect photo spots, all guided by a knowledgeable tour leader.

tours.name: Customizable VIP Private Tour!
tours.description: Create your perfect island adventure with a flexible, personalized tour. Choose your route—coastal, mountain, or other—and enjoy a tailored experience. Bring extra for food, drinks, and extensions.

tours.name: Zipline and Cave Tubing
tours.description: Tackle rugged trails, zip over breathtaking views, explore hidden caves, jump into crystal waters, and ride rapids through stunning canyons. Perfect for true adventurers ready to embrace nature’s wild side.

tours.name: West coast beach hopping
tours.description: Explore three or four stunning beaches along Puerto Rico’s west coast, soaking up sun, swimming, and discovering local culture—all in a fun 5-hour tour with snacks, water, and photos included.

tours.name: Waterfall & Waterslide Rainforest Adventure + Luquillo Beach
tours.description: Dive into Puerto Rico’s wild side with natural waterslides, waterfalls, and caves at Las Paylas. Swim, slide, and explore in lush El Yunque, then relax at Luquillo Beach with local food, drinks, and vibrant culture.

tours.name: Old San Juan Private Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore the rich history of Old San Juan with a choice of captivating walking tours, each lasting up to three hours. Discover the city's iconic forts, indulge in a rum tasting, or learn about local coffee and cigars, all while enjoying stunning sunset views over San Juan Bay.

tours.name: The Rainforest's Natural Waterslide Private Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure in El Yunque Rainforest, where you’ll slide down natural waterslides and swim in refreshing waters. After the thrill, savor local delicacies at the famous Luquillo Kiosks. This unique experience combines nature, fun, and culture, making it a perfect day out for friends and family.

tours.name: La Parguera – Bio Bay Private Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure with a scenic boat ride to La Parguera's enchanting Bio-Bay, where you can swim in its mesmerizing glowing waters. Enjoy a guided tour through charming towns, savor local snacks, and shop for unique souvenirs, all while creating lasting memories with friends or family.

tours.name: Tres Clavos Rum Private Tour
tours.description: Ages 18+ • Up to 5 Hours • Physicality 4/10 • Starting at $550

tours.name: Buen Provecho Food Tour
tours.description: Stroll through Caguas for 3.5 hours, savoring vegan and traditional bites, drinks, and sweet desserts. Dive into local history and culture on a lively walk that awakens your senses and leaves you craving more.

tours.name: Barrilito (Heritage) & OSJ Drive Around Private Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Puerto Rico's rich rum history! Visit a renowned distillery, savor a cocktail crafted by a professional mixologist, and explore the barrel aging warehouse. Then, discover the iconic landmarks of Old San Juan, uncovering the stories that shaped this vibrant island.

tours.name: Puerto Rican Beers Private Tour
tours.description: Ages 18+ • Up to 4 Hours • Physicality 1/10 •  Starting at $345

tours.name: Barrilito (Rum Tasting) & OSJ Drive Around Private Tour

Enjoy easy hikes, cave explorations, and relax on unique beaches, all topped off with a delicious lunch at a local eatery or food truck park.

tours.name: Weekend Beach Hopping Afternoon Tour
tours.description: Snorkel in Aguadilla’s crystal-clear waters, explore hidden coastal gems, and get close to marine life and pelicans. Dive into nature’s wonders and make unforgettable seaside memories.

tours.name: Weekend Beach Hopping Morning Tour
tours.description: Swim through crystal-clear waters, meet playful pelicans, and explore Aguadilla’s hidden coastal gems. Dive into nature’s wonders and uncover the vibrant marine life that makes this shoreline unforgettable.

tours.description: Ride along golden sands at sunset, then swim with your horse in warm Caribbean waters. A magical blend of scenic beauty, gentle waves, and unforgettable bonding—perfect for anyone seeking a serene, once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

tours.description: Ride into Old San Juan with a friendly driver sharing lively stories of the island’s history. Explore colorful streets, forts, and cafes at your own pace, then relax knowing your return is all arranged.

tours.name: Private Sound Bath
tours.description: Unwind with a private sound bath amid nature or in your casita. Let soothing vibrations from singing bowls and resonant instruments melt tension, calm your mind, and restore your inner balance in a deeply relaxing, personalized session.

tours.name: Mixology & Old San Juan Shopping
tours.description: Join a lively tour to craft classic Mojitos and Piña Coladas, explore BACARDÍ’s history, learn bar tricks, and taste exclusive premium rum. Perfect for rum lovers ready for a fun, interactive experience.

tours.name: Rainforest National Park
tours.description: Climb Yokahú Tower for stunning rainforest views, swim in clear river waters, and explore El Yunque’s lush trails. Perfect for nature lovers seeking adventure, wildlife, and unforgettable scenery in a low-difficulty tour.

tours.name: Cueva Ventana Guided Cave Walking Tour
tours.description: Climb into Cueva Ventana for a 20-minute hike to a stunning cave with breathtaking views of Puerto Rico. Learn about Taíno culture, see ancient petroglyphs, and spot native bats and spiders in this eco-adventure.

tours.name: DPV Tour
tours.description: Soar over vibrant reefs with a high-tech DPV, guided by expert instructors. Effortlessly explore deeper, longer, and further—no energy needed. One dive, and you'll be hooked on this unforgettable underwater adventure.

tours.name: Sip & Savor Cocktail Tour™
tours.description: Embark on a delightful 2.5-hour walking tour through Old San Juan, where you'll explore four unique venues while savoring iconic Puerto Rican cocktails and rums. Experience expertly crafted drinks by world-class mixologists, making this tour a memorable journey into the island's vibrant drinking culture. Cheers to a flavorful adventure!

tours.name: Rum Tasting & Old San Juan Shopping
tours.description: Taste rare Caribbean rums, from classic to limited editions, then explore charming Old San Juan at your leisure. A perfect blend of indulgence and adventure in a vibrant historic setting.

tours.name: Longest Zipline Adventure Combo
tours.description: Soar through seven thrilling ziplines, then feel the rush of flying like a bird on the 1.4 km Beast Zipline at speeds up to 60 MPH. An adrenaline-packed adventure for thrill-seekers ready to conquer the sky.

tours.name: Southwest Day-trip Puerto Rico
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s southwest: relax on Playa Buyé’s coral reefs, visit charming villages, enjoy fresh seafood along Joyuda, and soak in local culture on a full-day adventure filled with scenic views and tasty bites.

tours.name: Cueva del Indio Day Trip
tours.description: Explore Cueva del Indio’s stunning coastal views, ancient Taíno petroglyphs, and vibrant Caribbean flavors in just 5 hours. Includes transport, snacks, and a delicious lunch stop by the Atlantic.

tours.name: Bull Maze
tours.description: Experience the thrill of The Bull Maze, an indoor obstacle course featuring 41 diverse challenges, from rope courses to rock climbing. Perfect for families, this exciting adventure allows you 45 minutes to conquer the maze. Test your skills and enjoy a memorable time together in a unique and exhilarating environment.

tours.name: Medical Equipment
tours.description: Choose from sturdy wheelchairs, nimble scooters, or a comfy beach chair to explore with ease. Find the perfect mobility aid to suit your needs and enjoy your day comfortably and confidently.

tours.name: (E.I.) Culebra Boat Day Trip
tours.description: Explore Culebra’s stunning reefs and relax on Flamenco Beach, one of the world’s top beaches. Snorkel with sea turtles and colorful fish, then enjoy delicious food and tropical drinks on a fun-filled island adventure.

tours.name: Tropical One- Private Chartered Boat, Island Hopping Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a customizable boat tour in Puerto Rico, exploring stunning islands and vibrant marine life. Enjoy snorkeling at a beautiful reef and relax on the soft sands of Palomino and Icacos. With food, drinks, and breathtaking views included, this unforgettable experience is perfect for friends, family, or a romantic getaway.

tours.name: Organic Coffee Plantation & Epic Waterfall Adventure
tours.description: Experience the rich heritage of Puerto Rican coffee in Yauco, where you'll visit an organic farm and learn about coffee processing. Then, embark on a thrilling trek to a stunning 40-foot waterfall, enjoying a refreshing swim and massage under the falls. Discover the island's culture and ecosystems in this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Bomba Dance Class with Live Music – Ocean Club Hotel, Condado
tours.description: Feel the pulse of Puerto Rico with a lively Bomba dance class by the ocean. Feel the drums, move to powerful rhythms, and connect with the island’s vibrant Afro-Puerto Rican heritage in a fun, welcoming setting.

tours.name: Barrilito (Mixology) & OSJ Drive Around Private Tour
tours.description: Ages 18+ • Up to 6 Hours • Physicality 1/10 • Starting at $540

tours.name: Private Buen Provecho Food Tour w/transportation
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3.5-hour walking tour in Caguas, Puerto Rico, where vibrant history meets culinary delight. Savor a variety of drinks and traditional or vegan appetizers, topped off with delectable desserts. With expert guidance and round-trip transportation included, this unique experience promises to tantalize your taste buds and enrich your understanding of local culture.

tours.name: Kayaking Stargazing and Constellation Experience
tours.description: Paddle through Vieques' turquoise waters in a clear-bottom kayak, revealing vibrant marine life beneath you. Dive into an unforgettable Caribbean adventure with stunning underwater views.

tours.name: EL COMANDANTE TRAIL
tours.description: Gallop through Vieques’ rugged trails to reach the stunning, volcanic Black Sand Beach. Feel the power of your horse, embrace untouched landscapes, and uncover the island’s wild beauty on this immersive, adrenaline-fueled ride.

tours.name: Private Horseback Riding Tour in Aguadilla
tours.description: Escape to coastal trails with a private horseback ride in Aguadilla, soaking in ocean views and capturing perfect photos. Perfect for couples, families, or small groups seeking a personalized, relaxed outdoor adventure.

tours.name: Iconic Solo Mini Photo Session
tours.description: Capture stunning adventure moments with a professional photo session at scenic spots during your ATV/UTV ride. Get edited photos sent to your email—perfect for solo explorers seeking unforgettable memories.

tours.name: SQUAD 3 - ATV/UTV
tours.description: Join three riders on an adventure through Hacienda Campo Rico’s stunning 2,300 acres. Capture epic moments at scenic spots, with professional photos and a fun mini session—an unforgettable memory for only $47.

tours.name: SQUAD 4 - ATV/UTV
tours.description: Join four riders on an unforgettable tour, capturing epic moments with a mounted camera and scenic photo stops. No phones, just pure adventure and memories to cherish forever. Book now!

tours.name: SQUAD 5 – Best Value - ATV/UTV
tours.description: Capture unforgettable moments on a group adventure at Hacienda Campo Rico, with photos at iconic spots and a personalized digital certificate—all in one fun, affordable package.

tours.name: Latin Zumba Beach Class in San Juan, Puerto Rico
tours.description: Dance to lively Latin beats on a scenic sidewalk overlooking Ocean Park Beach. No experience needed—just bring your energy and good vibes for a fun, cultural Zumba session in Puerto Rico’s tropical breeze.

tours.name: Puerto Rican Coffee Private Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating walking tour of Puerto Rico's only coffee plantation, where you'll explore the rich history and process of coffee-making. After the tour, savor a cup of 100% authentic Puerto Rican coffee while enjoying lunch at Yiya’s Restaurant, surrounded by stunning views and roaming peacocks.

tours.name: Reservaciones Cumpleaños 9:00am a 12:30pm
tours.description: Reserve your spot for a 3.5-hour VIP birthday celebration at Vip Adventures, with fun attractions for all ages. Final cost varies by group size—book now to secure your unforgettable party experience.

tours.name: A Day Sailing at La Parguera
tours.description: Sail through clear waters to a hidden cay, snorkel vibrant reefs, relax on a trampoline under warm sun, and enjoy fresh fruit and drinks. An unforgettable day of adventure, relaxation, and tropical beauty awaits.

tours.name: Yunque Rainforest Night Tour
tours.description: Journey through El Yunque’s lush trails at night, listening to the forest’s symphony, spotting coquí frogs, and exploring bioluminescent fungi. An enchanting adventure into nature’s vibrant nighttime world.

tours.name: Aqua Deck Luxury Floating Picnic — Private Lagoon Experience
tours.description: Float in luxury on a private deck in San Juan’s lagoon, savor gourmet charcuterie and prosecco, and enjoy stunning skyline views—all without getting wet. Perfect for romance, celebrations, or a special escape.

tours.name: Chairs and Umbrella Rentals
tours.description: Relax all day at Playa Doña Lala with comfy beach chairs and umbrellas. Soak up the sun, feel the ocean breeze, and enjoy a perfect day by the water—ideal for families, couples, and beach lovers.

tours.name: Single Pack - ATV/UTV
tours.description: Capture every thrill of your ATV/UTV ride with professional photos and videos at scenic stops. No phones, no distractions—just epic memories delivered straight to your email.

tours.name: Private Charter Request
tours.description: Experience the ultimate private getaway with a customizable charter to Vieques Island, Culebra Island, and the Fajardo keys. Whether you seek adventure through snorkeling and diving or a serene day on secluded beaches, this tailored journey promises unforgettable memories for birthdays, bachelorette parties, and special occasions.

tours.name: Afro-Puerto Rican Heritage Tour
tours.description: Uncover Puerto Rico’s Afro-Caribbean roots with a 5-hour tour of Loíza and Piñones. Explore scenic beaches, vibrant art, historic sites, and enjoy local frituras, ending with a breathtaking cliff view and refreshing swim.

tours.name: Explore Puerto Rico
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable helicopter tour that soars over the stunning landscapes of Puerto Rico. Glide above iconic sites like Old San Juan, El Morro fortress, and the Bacardi Rum Distillery, before heading towards the majestic mountains. This thrilling 25 to 30-minute adventure promises breathtaking views and lasting memories.

tours.name: Puerto Rico El Yunque Rainforest Hiking to Waterfall and Cliff Jumping Adventure
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden rainforest gem with a thrilling hike, swimming, jumping, and stunning waterfalls. Enjoy wildflowers, wildlife, and a local lunch—all in a 6-hour adventure full of unforgettable moments.

tours.name: Gastronomical Tour
tours.description: Savor Vieques' freshest seafood, from lobster to octopus, at four tasty stops. Indulge in signature dishes, local snacks, and craft rum, all in a flavorful 3-hour journey through authentic Puerto Rican flavors.

tours.name: Vieques Pass
tours.description: Explore Vieques in three days with scenic walks, boat tours, snorkeling, and local sights like beaches, restaurants, and historic sites. Enjoy flexible transportation, rentals, and guided adventures for a memorable island escape.

tours.name: Vieques Island Sightseeing Tour
tours.description: Explore a peaceful paradise with colorful houses, ancient trees, and roaming horses. Visit beaches, learn local history, and enjoy delicious seaside eats—all in a flexible 1.5-2 hour tour before your ferry or flight.

tours.name: All-Inclusive Camping!!!
tours.description: Sleep under the stars on a stunning mountain, enjoy cozy amenities, share a campfire, and take in breathtaking views of Puerto Rico’s southern coast. Relax, explore, and connect with nature in this unforgettable overnight adventure.

tours.name: Camping - Cerro las tetas!
tours.description: Sleep under the stars with stunning mountain views, enjoy peaceful nights, and relax in a safe, well-equipped camp near Puerto Rico’s south coast. Perfect for nature lovers seeking tranquility and breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: VIP Vieques Tour
tours.description: Explore nine stunning beaches at your own pace—full-day or weekend trips with a certified guide. Pack sunblock, hats, and swimsuits for unforgettable seaside adventures. Decide your plan before you go!

tours.name: Canyoning Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of canyoning in Orocovis, Puerto Rico, with seven exhilarating rappels, including a breathtaking 170-foot waterfall. Dive into deep pools and soak in stunning mountain views. After your adventure, savor a delicious local lunch made from fresh, farm-harvested ingredients, making this a truly unforgettable day.

tours.name: Power Boat Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable island-hopping adventure with our full and half-day tours, exploring stunning destinations like Cayó Lobos and Palomino Island. Enjoy local beers, refreshing drinks, and delicious snacks or a grilled lunch onboard, along with snorkeling gear and paddleboards for a perfect day of fun and relaxation.

tours.name: Charter to Isla Caja de Muertos
tours.description: Sail to Isla Caja de Muertos and snorkel in vibrant Caribbean waters. Explore historic lighthouses, legendary caves, and enjoy a relaxing day with lunch, drinks, and stunning ocean views on a comfortable boat.

tours.name: Explore Culebra Reserve – Half-Day Adventure!
tours.description: Embark on a 5-hour adventure with Captain Tony through Culebra’s stunning Reserve. Discover vibrant marine life while snorkeling at Carlos Rosario Beach, explore idyllic beaches, and enjoy complimentary drinks and snacks aboard a cozy catamaran. With a small group of just six, experience the beauty of Culebra like never before!

tours.name: Kayak
tours.description: Experience the thrill of canoeing as you glide across rivers or seas at high speeds! This one-hour adventure offers expert instructions and optional guided tours, ensuring a safe and exhilarating outing. Don your swimwear and sunscreen for an unforgettable day on the water, whether solo or with friends.

tours.name: Vieques Special Fun Tour; Historical, Cultural and Beaches
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable family adventure around Vieques Island, starting with a delightful breakfast and shopping in Isabel Segunda. Enjoy breathtaking views while touring the northern coast, then relax at stunning beaches like Caracas and Sun Bay. This itinerary promises exploration, fun, and memorable moments for everyone!

tours.name: Discover Culebrita – Snorkel, Hike & Explore!
tours.description: Embark on a 5-hour adventure to Culebrita Island with Captain Tony, exploring stunning coastlines and vibrant marine life. Visit the historic lighthouse, relax on pristine beaches, or enjoy natural Jacuzzies. With a small group and included snacks and drinks, this unique experience promises unforgettable memories in paradise.

tours.name: Sunset Cruise
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking sunsets of Culebra on a relaxing 2-hour boat ride. Unwind on pristine offshore beaches while enjoying complimentary soft drinks and alcohol. This unforgettable evening is the perfect way to conclude your day in paradise, with the option to capture the moment with professional photos.

tours.name: Private / Group Dance Classes
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the lively world of salsa dancing at our spacious indoor studio! Enjoy 1-hour classes led by skilled instructors, perfect for all skill levels. With full-length mirrors and a comfortable atmosphere, you'll learn, dance, and have fun while letting the music inspire your every move.

tours.name: Half day Charter to Culebra's outer islands
tours.description: 4 hours. Explore Culebra's surrounding kays. Lunch included.

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan and Orocovis
51' Sea Ray Private Yacht
tours.description: Set sail on a luxurious yacht to Culebra’s Flamenco Beach for snorkeling, sunbathing, and unforgettable Caribbean views. All gear, food, and drinks included—just bring your towel and enjoy paradise.

tours.name: 55' Sea Ray Yacht
tours.description: Sail crystal-clear waters to Fajardo Keys or Culebra, snorkel vibrant reefs, relax on pristine beaches, and soak up the Caribbean sun. All trips include food, drinks, gear, and friendly crew for an unforgettable escape.

tours.name: Couple Pass Transportation Combo
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 8-hour adventure with a couple's pass for two, featuring two thrilling combos of ziplining and other exciting activities. Enjoy roundtrip transportation from San Juan and a $25 restaurant coupon. Perfect for adrenaline seekers, this limited-time offer promises unforgettable memories and breathtaking views. Reserve your spot today!

tours.name: Family Package Transportation Combo
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating day with your family as you choose from a variety of thrilling combos, including ziplining and climbing adventures. Enjoy roundtrip transportation from San Juan, ensuring a hassle-free outing. Create unforgettable memories together while meeting safety requirements in a stunning outdoor setting. Reserve your adventure today!

tours.name: Unlocking Puerto Rico: A FREE Virtual Traveler's Orientation
tours.description: Join our virtual tour to Puerto Rico and uncover vibrant beaches, lush rainforests, rich culture, and thrilling adventures. Get personalized tips and plan your perfect island escape from the comfort of home.

tours.name: Mexican Sardine Run (December 2026)
tours.description: Swim amidst the breathtaking sardine run in Mexico, where predators hunt in a mesmerizing underwater ballet. Snorkel, learn about marine life, enjoy local cuisine, and capture unforgettable moments on this all-inclusive 6-day adventure.

tours.name: Maldives Freediving with Whale Sharks, Mantas and Tiger Sharks (August 2026)
tours.description: Dive into the Maldives’ vibrant waters, swimming alongside majestic whale sharks and graceful manta rays. Snorkel coral reefs, encounter tiger sharks safely, and immerse yourself in local culture. This all-inclusive 8-day adventure promises unforgettable marine encounters, stunning scenery, and lifelong memories in one of the world’s most breathtaking destinations.

tours.name: Bahamas Hammerhead and Tiger Sharks (March 2026)
tours.description: Swim with majestic sharks, including hammerheads and bull sharks, in the Bahamas' crystal-clear waters. Encounter dolphins, rays, and more on a 7-day underwater adventure filled with breathtaking marine life and cultural experiences.

tours.name: El Yunque National Forest & Luquillo Beach Combo
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable half-day adventure in El Yunque National Forest, where you'll explore stunning landscapes and swim in crystal-clear rivers. Guided by experts, this eco-adventure promises a unique blend of nature walks and refreshing dips, making it a perfect outing for outdoor enthusiasts and nature lovers alike.

tours.name: Transfer from/to San Juan and Arecibo
Elite Luxury Transfers and Tours
tours.description: Experience Puerto Rico in luxury with Oceania's van transfer service for up to 14 passengers. Enjoy bilingual chauffeurs, optional tour guides, and a fleet designed for comfort. Perfect for special occasions or business meetings, this service offers flexibility and transparent pricing, ensuring a memorable journey tailored to your needs.

tours.name: Old San Juan Rum & Sunset Experience
tours.description: Experience an enchanting evening in Old San Juan, where history meets flavor! Explore the majestic El Morro fortress, indulge in a Scryer Rum tasting, and witness breathtaking sunset views from La Perla. This captivating tour promises a blend of culture, history, and unforgettable moments that will leave you wanting more.

tours.name: Arecibo Beach & Cave Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable day in Arecibo, Puerto Rico, where stunning beaches, natural pools, and the enchanting Cueva del Indio await. Enjoy scenic views, a picnic lunch, and leisure time by the ocean, all while immersing yourself in the island's rich ecology and history. Book your adventure today!

tours.name: Rum Art and Biobay Magic: From san Juan
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s vibrant art, rich rum history, and stunning bioluminescent bay in one unforgettable day. Savor local flavors, marvel at colorful murals, and swim in glowing waters—an immersive adventure you’ll never forget.

tours.name: Old San Juan Hop-On, Hop-Off: Drag Show Brunch

Delight in a welcome glass of sparkling wine and savor three exquisite wines paired with artisanal chocolate bars, all while enjoying an immersive experience primarily conducted in Spanish.

tours.description: Indulge in a two-hour journey blending rich wines and handcrafted chocolates, guided by expert John Rosa. An immersive, sensory experience perfect for lovers of fine flavors and artisanal delights.

This full-day tour blends adventure, history, and flavor, ending with a convenient pier drop-off.

tours.name: Couple Memories - ATV/UTV
tours.description: Capture every thrill with your group’s action camera during the ride, then enjoy fun photo sessions at scenic spots like Mi Casa and the fountain. Memories delivered to your email in 3 days.

tours.name: Mofongo & Mojito Tour The Original!
tours.description: Immerse yourself in Puerto Rican culture with the Mofongo and Mojito culinary experience. Explore historical sites in Old San Juan, blending culinary delight with rich cultural heritage for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.description: Step into 500 years of history in Old San Juan’s charming streets, visiting iconic sites like Paseo de La Princesa, San Juan Cathedral, and the Governor’s Mansion on a 4-hour guided walk through Puerto Rico’s oldest city.

tours.description: Swim in Puerto Rico’s glowing bioluminescent bay, where microorganisms light up the water around you. Enjoy a scenic trip, rum tasting, local dinner, and an unforgettable night of shimmering waters and island charm.

tours.description: Glide through the world's brightest bioluminescent waters in Mosquito Bay, Vieques. Paddle, swim, and soak in glowing waters, then enjoy local snacks and drinks in a magical, record-breaking natural wonder.

tours.description: Enjoy a sunset tour of Rincón with authentic empanadas, stunning lighthouse views, and lively art festivals. Relax, explore local culture, shop, or dance the night away in this vibrant Caribbean town.

tours.description: Experience the convenience of having your rental delivered directly to your Airbnb, hotel, or home in Palmas Del Mar. With flexible rental options ranging from 1 to 10 days, this service ensures a seamless and enjoyable stay, allowing you to focus on making unforgettable memories in paradise.

tours.name: Sports Equipment

tours.description: Host your special event in our charming pavilion, gazebo, or park, offering a picturesque setting for unforgettable moments. With 4-5 hours of exclusive access, create lasting memories surrounded by nature's beauty, making your occasion truly unique and enjoyable. Experience the perfect backdrop for celebrations of all kinds.

tours.name: Sports Court Rental
tours.description: Experience the thrill of playing in a unique setting with both roofed and non-roofed court options. Whether you prefer the open air or a sheltered environment, enjoy a memorable 4-5 hour session that caters to your playing style and enhances your game. Perfect for all skill levels!

tours.description: TRIO Zipline, River Slide & Beach Tour

tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you kayak or paddleboard through stunning waterways, surrounded by breathtaking natural beauty. tours.description: Uncover BACARDÍ’s legendary story with a guided tour, enjoy a welcome cocktail, and taste exclusive premium rum. Dive into the passion, craftsmanship, and innovation behind this iconic brand’s global success.

tours.name: CASA BACARDI - RUM TASTING TOUR
tours.description: Uncover BACARDÍ’s rich history with a guided tour and exclusive tastings of award-winning rums. Savor notes of caramel, tropical fruits, and spices—perfect for enthusiasts and newcomers alike.

tours.description: Create iconic BACARDÍ cocktails with expert tips, enjoy lively music, and savor a welcome drink. Explore the distillery’s secrets, dance, and buy exclusive rum—an immersive, flavorful mixology adventure.

tours.name: Afternoon Snorkeling & Sunset Sail
tours.description: Sail into Puerto Rico’s stunning sunset, snorkel coral reefs, enjoy a delicious buffet, unlimited drinks, and celebrate special moments onboard. A 4-hour adventure with breathtaking views and unforgettable memories.

tours.description: Glide through the vibrant Condado lagoon in a LED kayak, spotting manatees and colorful reefs amid lush mangroves. An eco-adventure blending stunning views, wildlife, and natural beauty for all ages.
