tours.description: Ride through Puerto Rico’s lush forests and secluded beaches on a gentle horseback tour. No experience needed—just feel the breeze, see stunning scenery, and escape the crowds in this unforgettable adventure.

Challenge yourself in a safe environment and conquer new heights in just 30 minutes of exhilarating fun!

tours.name: Beach, Sip and DANCE with US
tours.description: Dance on the beach with personalized snacks and drinks, led by expert instructors. Choose gourmet or basic packages, enjoy lively salsa, and create unforgettable memories in Puerto Rico’s stunning seaside setting.

tours.name: Half Day Rainforest Tour from the East Coast
tours.description: Embark on a half-day adventure through Puerto Rico's breathtaking rainforest, where you'll explore vibrant flora and fauna on a guided hike. Enjoy a refreshing swim in a crystal-clear river pool, swing from a rope, and indulge in delicious local snacks, creating unforgettable memories in this tropical paradise.

tours.name: West Coast Epic Coastal Journey and Magic Sunset
tours.description: Embark on a unique adventure along Puerto Rico's west coast, exploring hidden gems from Aguadilla to Isabela and Rincón. Experience snorkeling with sea turtles, a scenic jungle trek, and savor local delicacies. Conclude your journey with breathtaking clifftop views of the ocean and a stunning sunset over Desecheo Island.

tours.name: The Cross Island Bike Tour
tours.description: Ages 21+ • Approx. 5 Hours • Up to 5 People

tours.name: Jetski Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as a modern captain at Luquillo Beach, surrounded by the breathtaking El Yunque National Park. Experience the thrill of Yamaha jet skiing with expert guides, ensuring safety and excitement. Capture stunning photos and create lasting memories in this unique aquatic escapade!

tours.name: Luxury Transfer
tours.company: ACR Logistics Inc, dba ACR Tours
tours.description: San Juan to Ceiba (Ceiba to San Juan)

tours.name: Sail Catamaran Day Trip (Traveler)
tours.description: Sail to Puerto Rico’s pristine island of Icacos, snorkel vibrant reefs, relax on white beaches, and enjoy tropical drinks. Perfect for families and solo travelers seeking sun, sea, and unforgettable scenery.

tours.name: November Rock Climbing Camp
tours.description: Join an unforgettable fall adventure where kids explore nature through rock climbing, bouldering, and engaging workshops on fossils and minerals. With a focus on fun and learning in a safe, inclusive environment, children set their own climbing goals while enjoying games, campfires, and creative activities.

tours.name: Coquito Sip, Salsa, Merengue and Bachata Beach Dance Class
tours.description: Sway to Latin beats on the beach, learning salsa, bachata, and merengue with friendly instructors. Sip creamy Coquito, enjoy tropical vibes, and dance your heart out in this lively, adults-only oceanfront experience.

tours.name: Sofrito Customized Experiences
tours.description: Dance through the vibrant streets of Old San Juan on a reggaeton tour, where lively beats and colorful sights create an unforgettable rhythm-filled adventure.

tours.name: Catching the Sunset Jetski Tour
tours.description: Glide over crystal waters on a high-performance jet ski as the sun sets over Puerto Rico’s coast. Choose between tranquil Boquerón Bay or dramatic Los Morillos Lighthouse for a breathtaking, unforgettable twilight adventure.

tours.name: Rock Climbing – Puerto Hermina
tours.description: Experience the thrill of rock climbing along Puerto Rico’s stunning northern coast with a private adventure at Puerto Hermina. Guided by experts, conquer 3 to 5 natural limestone routes while soaking in breathtaking ocean views. This half-day excursion promises excitement, skill-building, and relaxation in a beautiful Caribbean setting.

tours.name: Rum & Chocolates
tours.description: Savor three wines paired with rich, handcrafted chocolates in a guided tasting led by a specialist. Indulge your senses with artisanal flavors and expert insights in this exclusive, Spanish-led experience.

tours.name: Explore, Discover, Preserve
tours.description: Explore coral reefs, mangroves, and beaches in a 5-hour adventure of kayaking, snorkeling, and discovery. Learn about coastal conservation while immersing in Puerto Rico’s vibrant ecosystems.

tours.name: Amazing Coast Tour
tours.description: Experience Puerto Rico's rich history from the sky on this captivating helicopter tour. In just 15 to 18 minutes, you'll soar over stunning shorelines and iconic landmarks near Old San Juan, offering a unique perspective of the island's beauty and heritage. Perfect for history enthusiasts and adventure seekers alike!

tours.name: El Russo - Mini Catamaran
tours.description: Sail away on El Russo, a private mini catamaran for up to 6. Swim, snorkel, and relax on pristine beaches with your own captain. Enjoy snacks, drinks, and vibrant marine life in crystal-clear Caribbean waters.

tours.name: Sunset Bio-Bay Kayaying
tours.description: Paddle through Laguna Grande’s stunning Bio Bay at sunset, surrounded by mangroves and vibrant wildlife. Relax, reconnect with nature, and enjoy expert-guided, eco-friendly kayaking in a peaceful 2-hour adventure.

tours.name: Camping - Detrás de la teta
tours.description: Sleep under the stars with stunning mountain views, enjoy peaceful surroundings, a campfire, and fresh mountain air. Relax, rest, and soak in the breathtaking south coast scenery in a safe, quiet setting.

tours.name: Island Hopping and Snorkeling Tours - Full Day
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 6-hour Island Hopping tour, exploring stunning cays like Palomino and Icacos. Enjoy snorkeling at prime spots, bask in the sun on beautiful beaches, and savor a delicious onboard lunch. With customizable options and refreshing drinks included, this adventure promises unforgettable memories and relaxation.

tours.name: Rincón Whale Watching Trips
tours.description: Watch humpback whales breach and sing in their natural habitat. Snorkel alongside these gentle giants, listen to their songs, and enjoy a safe, family-friendly adventure in warm waters from January to April.

tours.name: PHOTO & VIDEO SESSION @IslandWavesRincon
tours.description: Capture unforgettable moments of your surfing or sailing adventure with a professional photo session at local beaches. Over two hours, enjoy stunning images and clips that showcase your skills, tailored to the day's perfect weather and water conditions. Create lasting memories of your time on the waves!

tours.name: 2-Person Efoil Lesson
tours.description: Escape the daily grind with a thrilling 60-minute efoil lesson for two! Learn essential skills like speed adjustments and turns while enjoying quality water time together. Capture unforgettable moments with an optional content package, making this unique adventure both exciting and memorable. Perfect for those seeking a refreshing experience!

tours.name: Colirrubia
tours.description: Discover the breathtaking beauty of Puerto Rico with Merluza, a local tourism company offering unforgettable island tours. Explore stunning destinations like Icacos, Palomino, and Cayo Piñero, while immersing yourself in the vibrant culture. Each trip promises a unique adventure, tailored by the crew to ensure a safe and enriching experience.

tours.name: Thanksgiving Day Puerto Rican Style
tours.description: Join a lively journey through Puerto Rico’s “roast pig road,” where vibrant music, flavorful local foods, and festive traditions come alive. Enjoy a stream-side lunch, watch a master cook prepare tender pork, dance to tropical beats, and explore charming shops—all in a joyful celebration of Puerto Rican culture.

tours.name: Tennis Lessons
tours.description: Play tennis on a legendary court designed by Hall of Famer Charlie Pasarell, surrounded by lush greenery and ocean breezes. Perfect for beginners or pros, each lesson becomes part of a storied tennis legacy.

tours.name: Family Pirate Treasure Hunt-Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable family Treasure Hunt in Old San Juan, where you'll assist a lost pirate friend of Cofresi. Solve riddles, uncover historical secrets, and savor local treats like fruit popsicles. Complete your adventure by flying a kite at El Morro Fortress, blending mystery and fun for all ages!

tours.name: Secrets of Espresso Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour journey through Old San Juan, where you'll savor the rich history of Puerto Rican coffee. Taste unique brews favored by the Pope, explore charming cobblestone streets, and visit ancient churches. This immersive experience blends culture, history, and delicious coffee, perfect for any coffee enthusiast.

tours.name: Into the Mountains-Hiking, Waterfalls & Coffee Shop Full Day Adventure from San Juan
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden gems with a full-day adventure: hike to waterfalls, meet a 300-year-old tree, enjoy fresh tropical fruits, visit a family-run coffee farm, and savor mountain views—an authentic island experience.

tours.name: Windsurfing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of windsurfing as you glide effortlessly over the water on a lightweight board with a sail. In just one hour, receive expert instructions and essential safety equipment, making it perfect for both beginners and enthusiasts. Don’t forget your swimwear and sunscreen for this unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Gozalandia Waterfalls Tour & Cultural Market
tours.description: Dive into Puerto Rico’s lush rainforest to swim in stunning waterfalls, then explore a vibrant local market filled with crafts, music, and culture. An adventurous, scenic day for all ages.

tours.name: Surf and Yoga
tours.description: Experience the perfect blend of adventure and tranquility at our Surf and Yoga Retreat. In just three hours, discover the transformative benefits of combining surfing with yoga, enhancing your physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. Enjoy refreshing snacks and drinks as you embrace this unique, revitalizing journey each month.

tours.name: El Yunque National Rainforest Hiking  + Natural waterslide
tours.description: Please provide the activity description you'd like me to summarize.

tours.name: Merluza
tours.description: Discover the breathtaking beauty of Puerto Rico with Merluza, a local tourism company offering unforgettable island tours. Explore stunning destinations like Icacos, Palomino, and Cayo Piñero, while immersing yourself in the vibrant culture. Each trip promises a unique adventure, tailored by the crew to ensure a safe and enriching experience.

tours.name: Puerto Rico Sightseeing Experience
tours.description: Discover the vibrant history and culture of Puerto Rico on this captivating tour of Old San Juan. Explore iconic landmarks like El Morro and San Cristóbal Fortress, savor local flavors at a seaside restaurant, and enjoy stunning views from Catano. Conclude with a refreshing swim in the beautiful Caribbean waters.

tours.name: Pon Pa' Las Sanse 2026
tours.description: Ride VIP from Bayamon to Old San Juan for Sanse 2026, with flexible departure times and return trips until 2am. Reserve your spot and enjoy a hassle-free trip to the heart of the celebration.

tours.name: Explore Culebra or Vieques - Full Day Charter
tours.description: Experience the stunning beauty of Culebra and Vieques on a private full-day charter. Spend 7 hours exploring pristine beaches and vibrant coral reefs aboard a comfortable Grady White Marlin 300. With a professional captain and snorkeling gear provided, this adventure promises relaxation and unforgettable memories in paradise.

tours.name: Explore Palominos & Icacos
tours.description: Embark on a full-day charter to the stunning islands of Palominos and Icacos, where adventure meets relaxation. Customize your journey with options for swimming, snorkeling, or beach lounging. Enjoy complimentary drinks, snacks, and grilling facilities aboard a luxurious boat, all while being guided by a professional captain. Unforgettable memories await!

tours.name: Explore Palominos or Icacos - Sunset Trip Boat Charter
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking 4-hour sunset boat charter to the stunning Palominos or serene Icacos islands. Enjoy swimming, snorkeling, and gourmet dining options while sipping complimentary drinks. With a USCG certified captain and a luxurious Grady White Marlin 300, this intimate experience promises unforgettable memories against the backdrop of a Caribbean sunset.

tours.name: Epic Full-Day Adventure - Enchanted Wet Adventure in Toro Negro
tours.description: Venture into Toro Negro’s lush jungle, swim in hidden crystal-clear pools, and leap from natural platforms. Conquer rugged trails, enjoy epic views, and embrace adrenaline in this unforgettable outdoor adventure.

tours.name: Weekend Sunset Tours
tours.description: Sail into sunset serenity on a traditional Yola Aguadillana, where calm waters and vibrant skies create a romantic scene perfect for photos and unforgettable Caribbean moments.

tours.name: Old San Juan Semi-Guided Shuttle
tours.description: Ride into Old San Juan with a friendly driver sharing lively stories. Explore vibrant streets, historic forts, and charming cafes at your own pace, then relax knowing your return is just a call away.

tours.name: Romance a Orillas del Rio
tours.description: Enjoy a 2-hour boat tour through nature, complete with a toast, charcuterie, romantic music, and personalized songs. Perfect for couples seeking connection and unforgettable memories in a beautiful setting.

tours.name: Private Sunset Sailing Excursion from San Juan
tours.description: Sail a private boat past historic forts and colorful colonial skyline, learning sailing skills and capturing stunning sunset photos. An intimate, hands-on adventure blending history, relaxation, and Caribbean charm.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Tour
tours.description: Explore El Yunque rainforest in a 4.5-hour guided tour featuring waterfalls, scenic views, and nature walks. Perfect for families, with expert guides, transportation, and a chance to connect with Puerto Rico’s stunning natural beauty.

tours.name: Magical Mystery Tour
tours.description: Venture into a hidden paradise with forest hikes, wild river trekking, swimming holes, a natural water slide, and a 40-foot waterfall for cliff jumping. End with scenic coastal views and cultural stories—an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Viejo San Juan & La Perla Magical Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore San Juan’s hidden gems on a 3-hour walk through La Perla, historic forts, and secret beaches. Savor local mountain coffee, hear captivating legends, and catch a stunning sunset in this immersive cultural adventure.

tours.name: Wyndham Grand Rio Mar Rainforest Beach & Golf Resort to SJU Airport
tours.description: Travel smoothly from Wyndham Rio Mar to San Juan Airport with shared shuttles—book for 2+ adults, bring your own car seat, and enjoy a hassle-free ride during your departure hours.

tours.name: Serenity
tours.description: Sail through Puerto Rico’s stunning reefs and beaches on a spacious 28’ boat. Snorkel up to 5 coral reefs, enjoy a cozy cabin, kitchenette, and freshwater shower. Perfect for full-day adventures or half-day escapes.

tours.name: Customized Tour and Transfer
tours.description: Skip the wait with a private, comfortable transfer or island tour. Enjoy air-conditioned rides, friendly drivers, and personalized service—perfect for exploring or getting to your destination smoothly.

tours.name: Utuado Canyon, Waterfall and River Adventure
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s central mountains with a full-day adventure: river treks, hidden waterfalls, volcanic rock canyons, and ancient petroglyphs. A physically active journey into nature’s mystical beauty awaits.

tours.name: Arenales Cave, River Trekking and Natural Spring Adventure
tours.description: Explore hidden natural springs, hike through lush forests, and swim under caves on an adventurous 8-hour tour. Perfect for active travelers seeking authentic, off-the-beaten-path experiences in Puerto Rico.

tours.name: Rainforest ATV, Swimming and Beach Adventure
tours.description: Ride through Puerto Rico’s stunning rainforest on a 1-hour ATV tour, then cool off in a natural pool, enjoy a short hike, and relax at Luquillo Beach. An adventure packed with scenic views, fun, and relaxation.

tours.name: Old San Juan & Ron Del Barrilito Rum Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s rich history and colorful streets, then visit Hacienda Santa Ana to see how Puerto Rico’s oldest rum, Ron del Barrilito, is crafted since 1880. Enjoy a guided tour, a cocktail, and learn the craft behind this iconic spirit.

tours.name: Old San Juan & Loiza Historical Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s historic forts, colorful streets, and stunning views. Then dive into Loíza’s African roots, enjoy authentic food at Piñones, meet local artists, and dance to Afro-Caribbean drums in this 7-8 hour cultural adventure.

tours.name: Old San Juan Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s rich history, colorful streets, and impressive forts on a 5-hour guided tour. Walk through UNESCO sites, learn about its defenses, enjoy stunning views, and savor authentic Puerto Rican lunch.

tours.name: Rainforest Swimming and Beach Adventure
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s outskirts with thrilling rock waterslides, natural pools, and lush hikes. Swim, jump, relax, and soak in stunning scenery on this action-packed, adventure-filled day near the rainforest.

tours.name: Summer Clinics 2025
tours.description: Join our successful Summer Clinics designed for kids ages 6-17, where they can develop and enhance their surfing skills daily. With experienced instructors who are both great surfers and CPR First Aid Certified, this program promises an exciting and safe environment for young surfers to thrive and make unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Kayaking Rental
tours.description: Paddle along Parguera’s shoreline in a two-seater kayak, perfect for solo or small child adventures. Explore ocean waters at your own pace, staying safe near shore with gear, instructions, and a sense of freedom.

tours.name: Virtual Concierge
tours.description: Need quick help? Call our Virtual Concierge at 787-354-7350 between 8 am and 5 pm AST for instant assistance whenever you need it.

tours.name: Bubblemaker for 8-10 yr. old
tours.description: Kids aged 8+ can breathe underwater and swim in a pool using scuba gear, making for a fun, safe, and memorable birthday or party activity. No experience needed—just bring your sense of adventure!

tours.name: PADI Specialty Diver Course
tours.description: Enhance your diving skills with expert-led PADI Specialty Courses like Night Diving, Fish ID, or Coral Conservation. Dive deeper, navigate better, and protect reefs—all in 4 hours with gear included.

tours.name: UTV at Forest
tours.description: Feel the thrill of Puerto Rico’s top adventure with an exhilarating UTV ride. Guided by experts, tackle rugged trails, feel the wind, and unleash your wild side in this unforgettable off-road experience.

tours.name: Old San Juan Historical & Shopping
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s rich history, colorful streets, and delicious cuisine on a 4.5-hour bus tour. Walk historic cobblestones, learn fascinating stories, and get inspired for your own adventure in this vibrant, centuries-old city.

tours.name: Vieques Boat Day Trip
tours.description: Snorkel in Vieques' pristine, crystal-clear waters, marvel at vibrant reefs and marine life, all away from crowds. Enjoy expert guidance, eco-interpretation, and local snacks on this unforgettable island adventure.

tours.name: Rum Mixology Tour
tours.description: Learn to craft elegant cocktails with top mixologists using premium rum. Impress guests at your next party with skills gained in this interactive class—perfect for home bartenders seeking a professional touch.

tours.name: River Tubing Adventure
tours.description: Venture into pristine caves and lush forests on a guided tour. Tube through a 1,000-foot underground river, swim in natural pools, hike scenic trails, and relax under waterfalls—an adventure connecting you with nature’s raw beauty.

tours.name: Rum Trails Tasting Experience
tours.description: Journey through Puerto Rico’s rum heritage with tastings of historic and innovative rums, visits to renowned distilleries, and a scenic stop in Old San Juan—an unforgettable 7-8 hour adventure.

tours.name: SJU Airport to Wyndham Grand Rio Mar Rainforest Beach & Golf Resort
tours.description: Relax after your flight with a shared shuttle from San Juan Airport to Wyndham Grand Rio Mar. Book for two adults, bring your own car seat, and enjoy a smooth, hassle-free ride into the lush Puerto Rican rainforest.

tours.name: El Conquistador Resort Sunset Sail Cruise by SALTours
tours.description: Experience a breathtaking sunset cruise exclusively for El Conquistador Resort guests. Set sail on Saturdays and indulge in delicious appetizers and refreshing drinks while enjoying stunning views of the El Yunque Mountains and the serene islands of Puerto Rico. Relax as the crew caters to your every need during this memorable evening.

tours.name: Rainforest Tour
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating full-day adventure in El Yunque Rainforest, where you’ll hike through vibrant greenery to a stunning waterfall. Enjoy swimming, diving, and rope swinging in natural pools, followed by a tasty lunch at a local eatery. Cap off your day relaxing on the picturesque Luquillo Beach.

tours.description: Sail in luxury to Culebra’s hidden gems like Cayo Luis Peña and Culebrita, explore pristine beaches, and enjoy fresh island flavors—all in a 2-day adventure aboard a 35-ft yacht with expert crew.

tours.name: Culebra • 3 Days
tours.description: Sail in style on a luxury yacht to Culebra’s hidden gems like Cayo Luis Peña and Culebrita. Enjoy island exploration, local flavors, and relaxing village strolls on this exclusive two-day adventure.

tours.name: Adventure to a Hidden Waterfall
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-6 hour adventure in Bayamon, Puerto Rico, where you'll hike upriver to uncover stunning cascades and natural pools. Experience the thrill of reaching a breathtaking waterfall, all while guided by an expert. Enjoy a comfortable ride and essential amenities for a memorable day in nature.

tours.name: Hidden Gems of the North
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-6 hour adventure along Puerto Rico's northern coast. Hike to a hidden crystal-clear spring, swim in its pristine waters, and explore the enchanting Cueva de las Golondrinas, home to swallows. Experience nature's beauty and tranquility while enjoying a unique blend of hiking, swimming, and beach exploration.

tours.name: The Old, The New and The Now; The Updated San Juan City Tour
tours.description: Experience San Juan like never before on this captivating 2 to 2.5-hour city tour. Discover historic sites like Castillo San Cristobal and the San Juan Cathedral, explore vibrant neighborhoods, and enjoy local hotspots such as La Placita de Santurce. This unique journey blends culture, history, and modern charm for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: From the Concrete Jungle to the Actual Jungle, The Complete Package Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-6 hour tour of Puerto Rico, exploring the historic Old City of San Juan, iconic landmarks, and the stunning north coast. Experience delicious local street food, delve into the rich culture of ancient caves, and immerse yourself in the lush El Yunque Rain Forest, complete with a refreshing swim.

tours.name: SCUBA Reactivate & Refresh
tours.description: Refresh your diving skills in just 3 hours with a hands-on review and open water dive in Old San Juan. Perfect for returning divers, it boosts confidence and ensures safety before your Puerto Rico adventure.

tours.name: Cave Adventure Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 5-hour adventure into the heart of the island, exploring a lush tropical forest and the stunning Morovis River. Discover ancient rock art and marvel at unique cave formations while hiking along picturesque paths. This unforgettable experience combines natural beauty with rich cultural heritage.

tours.name: Gay Beach Adventure – Queer-Friendly Getaway in Puerto Rico
tours.description: Join a unique queer-led beach adventure that invites LGBTQ+ travelers and allies to a breathtaking, secluded beach. Enjoy swimming in tide pools, relaxing on soft sand, and connecting with like-minded individuals. Guided by local LGBTQ+ experts, this inclusive experience promises fun, nature, and celebration in a tropical paradise.

tours.name: Rainforest Nature Escape: LGBTQ+ Cultural & Ecological Adventure in Puerto Rico
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 5-hour adventure through Puerto Rico's hidden rainforest, away from the crowds. Discover volcanic rock formations, vibrant wildlife, and a sacred natural pool steeped in myth. This exclusive journey promises an unforgettable exploration of nature's beauty, complete with transportation for a seamless experience.

tours.name: Camuy Cave Exploration, Sunset Salsa Class, and Bomba Dance Experience
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s underground caves, dance sunset salsa on the beach, and learn vibrant Bomba rhythms. An unforgettable mix of natural wonders and rich cultural traditions in one full-day adventure.

tours.name: Coamo Hot Springs, Ponce Tour & Lajas Bioluminescent Boat Tour
tours.description: Relax in Coamo’s mineral-rich hot springs, explore Ponce’s art and history, then marvel at glowing bioluminescent waters in Lajas. A full-day adventure blending relaxation, culture, and nature’s magic.

tours.name: Tour Guide Services
tours.description: Experience the rich history and vibrant culture of Puerto Rico through captivating storytelling with a seasoned guide. With over 25 years of expertise, you'll explore local cuisine, historical sites, and stunning trails, all while enjoying personalized insights from a renowned tour designer who has guided dignitaries and travel journalists alike.

tours.name: Get Wet with the Snorkel Crew!
tours.description: Dive into clear waters with a PADI pro, exploring vibrant marine life near Escambrón. Enhance your skills, spot colorful fish and turtles, and enjoy expert guidance—all equipment included in this 1.5-hour adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Hiking Tour from the East Coast
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 6-hour hike through El Yunque Rainforest, the only tropical rainforest in the US National Forest system. Ascend to the breathtaking Mt. Britton observation tower for stunning panoramic views, visit the majestic La Coca Falls, savor authentic Puerto Rican cuisine, and swim in the pristine Río Mameyes.

tours.name: Rainforest Night Magic!!!
tours.description: Embark on a mesmerizing night adventure in the Puerto Rican rainforest, where you'll be serenaded by Coquí frogs and enchanted by glowing fireflies. Experience a rejuvenating waterfall massage and learn from expert guide Andres as you explore this magical ecosystem. This unforgettable journey promises a unique connection with nature.

tours.name: Daily Bike Rentals
tours.description: Experience the island like never before with a bike rental! Available from 9am for up to 12 hours, this adventure allows you to explore at your own pace. Enjoy the stunning scenery while ensuring you stay hydrated and fueled, as you navigate the less-traveled roads during daylight.

tours.name: The Beach Hopping Bike Tour
tours.description: Experience the beauty of Vieques, Puerto Rico, on a thrilling 3-hour Bike Beach Hopping Tour. Cycle along scenic coastal routes, discovering five stunning beaches, each with its unique charm. Enjoy breathtaking Caribbean views and the refreshing sea breeze as you explore the island like a local.

tours.name: The North West Bike Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the North Side Bike Tour in Vieques, Puerto Rico, a four-hour guided adventure that showcases the island's stunning landscapes, historical sites, and local charm. Discover military bunkers, the picturesque Mosquito Pier, and hidden beaches along Road 200, making for an unforgettable exploration of this tropical paradise.

tours.name: The South West Bike Tour
tours.description: Experience the vibrant culture and rich history of Vieques on a captivating 3-hour South West Bike Tour. Discover stunning locations like Playa Negra and Playa Grande, while exploring charming villages and the Sugar Mill Ruins. This unique adventure combines scenic beauty with insightful storytelling, making it an unforgettable journey.

tours.name: El Yunque & Luquillo Kiosks from the East Coast
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 6-hour adventure through El Yunque rainforest, where breathtaking views from the Yokahu observation tower and stunning La Coca Falls await. Enjoy a refreshing swim in crystal-clear river waters and savor local cuisine at the famous Luquillo Kiosks. Experience the beauty of Puerto Rico, rain or shine!

tours.name: Ponce Private Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour tour to Ponce, where you'll explore the renowned Ponce Art Museum, savor delicious local ice cream, and delve into the history of Don Q Rum at the Serralles family home. This immersive experience combines culture, history, and culinary delights in one captivating journey.

tours.name: Parguera Snorkeling & Bio-Bay Private Tour
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable day exploring the vibrant towns on the way to La Parguera. Enjoy a scenic boat ride to snorkel in stunning shallow reefs, savor delicious empanadas, and marvel at the enchanting bioluminescent waters while swimming. Conclude your adventure with unique local artisan souvenirs before returning to your hotel.

tours.name: Drive to Your Guide
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 4-hour adventure through the stunning landscapes of El Yunque, exploring rivers, ravines, and lush forests. Experience the thrill of climbing rocky paths, encountering vibrant flora and fauna, and enjoying refreshing activities at Charco Frio. This immersive journey promises a unique connection with Puerto Rico's natural beauty.

tours.name: Five Day Bike Rental
tours.description: Experience the island like never before with a bike rental from 9am to 7pm on your fifth day. Explore at your own pace, but remember to return before dark. Bring water and snacks to stay energized, as stores are scarce. This adventure promises unforgettable sights and freedom on two wheels!

tours.name: Shooting Practice | Pratica de Tiro
tours.description: Enhance your shooting skills in a structured and safe environment during our two-hour practice sessions. Perfect for all levels, this experience offers personalized guidance to help you improve. Join us for an exciting opportunity to refine your technique and boost your confidence on the range.

tours.name: Women's Shooting Clinic| Clinica de Tiro para Mujeres
tours.description: Join our women's shooting clinic for a transformative day of learning and camaraderie! Designed for all skill levels, you'll gain essential knowledge in firearm safety, shooting techniques, and concealed carry, all while enjoying supervised practice. Celebrate your achievements with a special prize for the top shooter at this empowering event!

tours.name: SJU Airport to Wyndham Palmas Boutique Resort
tours.description: Experience a seamless arrival transfer from San Juan International Airport to the Wyndham Palmas Boutique Resort. This convenient shuttle service allows you to share the ride with fellow guests, making it a social start to your vacation. Enjoy hassle-free travel and relax as you begin your getaway in paradise.

tours.name: Transportation San Juan Area to Yunque - Fajardo Roundtrip
tours.description: Experience a seamless day of exploration with convenient roundtrip transportation from Old San Juan, Condado, and Isla Verde. Choose between morning or afternoon sessions, each lasting six hours, and enjoy the flexibility of a full day adventure. Perfect for groups, this service ensures a memorable journey through vibrant locales.

tours.name: Wyndham Palmas Boutique Resort to SJU Airport
tours.description: Experience a convenient one-way departure transfer from Wyndham Palmas Boutique Resort to San Juan International Airport. This shared shuttle service allows you to travel with fellow guests, making it a social experience. Enjoy hassle-free transportation for your flight, with options for infants and flexible scheduling available.

tours.name: Sunset Harbor Boat Ride in San Juan
tours.description: 3+ years old • 1.5 Hours • Join us for a captivating journey on a Sunset Boat Ride

tours.name: Scenic Horseback Riding Tour In San Juan
tours.description: 12+ years old • 2 Hours • Breathtaking adventure through the fields of a private Hacienda

tours.name: ATV Adventure Ride: Private Hacienda Experience
tours.description: 12+ years old • 2 Hours • Buckle up for an exhilarating ride!

tours.name: Kayak and Snorkel Gear Rental
tours.description: Pick up your gear at Melones Beach, Culebra, and explore independently for up to eight hours. We can arrange convenient pick-up and drop-off across Culebra and Condado—your adventure starts with a simple visit.

tours.name: Scuba Diving Certification
tours.description: Learn to dive confidently in just 2-3 days with expert guidance, mastering gear, buoyancy, and marine life respect. Enjoy personalized instruction in a supportive environment—your underwater adventure starts here.

tours.name: JetCarVIP
tours.description: Experience the thrill of JetCar VIP as you navigate luxurious, sports-car-like vessels through the stunning Caribbean waters of San Juan Bay. Marvel at historic landmarks like Old San Juan and El Morro while feeling the rush of speed. This unforgettable adventure is perfect for those aged 12 and up!

tours.name: Mixology Class
tours.description: Learn to craft elegant cocktails with top bartenders using Ron del Barrilito. Start with a free drink, then master bartending skills to impress guests—relax afterward at Hacienda Santa Ana’s beautiful grounds.

tours.name: Create a Tour
tours.description: Discover a unique adventure tailored just for you! Whether you're part of a large group or seeking a multi-day experience, choose from thrilling activities like fishing, rock climbing, ziplining, and even a Bomba dancing workshop. Create unforgettable memories with a custom tour designed to fit your group's interests.

tours.name: Rock Climbing Guided Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of outdoor climbing in a stunning setting shaped by Hurricane María. Guided by passionate experts, this adventure welcomes climbers of all ages, from toddlers to seniors. Enjoy complimentary fresh fruit smoothies while immersing yourself in a cozy mountain atmosphere, perfect for family fun and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Voy Bajando - Pon Pa' Las Sanse 2025 (Regreso solamente)
tours.description: Hop on a quick, affordable ride from Plaza Colon anytime between 8:30pm and 2:30am, with departures every hour. Enjoy a smooth, hassle-free trip until the early morning hours.

tours.name: A Walk Among The Water Lilies and Koi
tours.description: Discover the enchanting world of aquatic plants at our agro-tourism farm! Stroll through our serene Water Gardens, explore diverse flora, and immerse yourself in nature's tranquility. With no reservations needed, this is a unique chance to connect with the beauty of the natural environment at your own pace.

tours.name: Tour: The Magical World of Water Garden
tours.description: Discover the enchanting world of aquatic gardens in this express tour, where you'll swiftly explore stunning landscapes and vibrant water flora. This unique experience offers a perfect blend of beauty and knowledge, allowing you to connect with nature in a memorable way, even with limited time.

tours.name: Private Quickie Sail
tours.description: Set sail on a private boat around Old San Juan, choosing to help steer or relax as you soak in stunning views. Snorkel if weather allows, and bring your favorite drinks for a personalized, unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay Boat Tour (La Parguera)
tours.description: Glide through Puerto Rico’s glowing bay by boat, then dive into waters alive with shimmering microscopic organisms—an unforgettable, luminous adventure for all ages.

tours.name: Transportation Service
tours.description: Experience seamless travel with our top-notch transportation service, tailored to your needs. Whether for a business trip, wedding, or sports event, enjoy the luxury of skipping lines and avoiding wait times. Choose us for a reliable and customized journey that ensures your occasion is memorable and stress-free.

tours.name: Surfboard Rentals
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing at La Pared in Luquillo with our affordable surfboard and bodyboard rentals. Enjoy year-round waves in a safe, sandy beach environment, perfect for all skill levels. With on-site supervision and flexible rental options, you’ll have a memorable and supportive surfing adventure tailored just for you.

tours.name: Private Culinary Experience in San Juan, Puerto Rico
tours.description: Savor Puerto Rican flavors in an intimate, personalized dinner at your space. Melody’s warm storytelling and authentic dishes—from grilled steak to creamy flan—bring culture, connection, and delicious memories to life.

tours.name: Mezcal & Chocolate
tours.description: Savor three artisanal chocolates paired with wines or mezcals, guided by experts. Indulge your senses in a flavorful journey of perfect pairings, all in a vibrant, immersive setting.

tours.name: Glow Tour
tours.description: Experience the magic of a nighttime mangrove paddle, where the ocean comes alive with vibrant sea creatures. Encounter playful fish and possibly even spotted eagle rays in this unforgettable 1.5-hour adventure. This unique tour is a must-do for anyone visiting Culebra, offering a captivating glimpse into the underwater world.

tours.name: Hike to the top of the left peak!
tours.description: Climb to the summit of Cerro Las Tetas for stunning panoramic views, guided insights, and a brief local history—all in a 2-hour adventure with parking, facilities, and a peaceful atmosphere.

tours.name: Jet Ski Tour
tours.description: Race across Caribbean waters on a jet ski, exploring beaches or mangrove canals. Feel the thrill, enjoy stunning scenery, and create unforgettable memories in just 90 minutes of high-speed adventure.

tours.name: Old San Juan Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Old San Juan, where history comes alive at iconic stops like Capitolio and Fuerte Morro. After exploring the rich past, enjoy free time at Plaza Colón to shop and wander, making this tour a perfect blend of culture and leisure in a stunning walled city.

tours.name: Toro Pass Transportation Combo
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 8-hour adventure through Puerto Rico's stunning mountains with the Toro Pass Transportation. Experience the thrill of 8 ziplines, including "The Beast," one of the world's longest, and "The Monster," the longest in America, reaching speeds up to 95 mph. Safety and comfort are prioritized throughout this unforgettable journey.

tours.name: Hobie Getaway Coastal Sail
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating one-hour sailing adventure along the stunning coast of Rincon, Puerto Rico. Experience hands-on sailing as you and your group actively participate in the journey. Be prepared to get wet and enjoy the thrill of the ocean while surrounded by breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: Hobie Getaway Rental
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing in Rincón aboard a Hobie Getaway! Enjoy a 1-2 hour adventure tailored to wind and weather conditions, with a thorough orientation to ensure safety. Perfect for able swimmers, this unforgettable outing promises excitement and the chance to connect with nature—just remember to bring your bathing suit!

tours.name: Guided Sailing Experience
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing with the Guided Sailing Experience in Rincon! Take the helm of a Hobie Getaway while an expert guide shares tips on navigating the dynamic coastal waters. Perfect for adventurous swimmers, this unforgettable journey promises excitement and local insights as you embrace the wind and waves.

tours.name: Mexico Orcas Seafari (May 2026)
tours.description: Dive into Baja's waters to see orcas hunting mobulas, swim with blue whales, dolphins, and sea lions. A 7-day adventure filled with stunning wildlife, vibrant culture, and unforgettable ocean encounters await you.

tours.name: Meet up and follow Rainforest Adventure!! *Fajardo only* | 6:30am start | ONLY AVAILABLE DECEMBER AND MARCH
tours.description: Explore El Yunque’s lush trails, swim down natural water slides, swing on ropes, and jump into crystal-clear pools. Capture family memories, learn about wildlife, and enjoy a fun, adventurous rainforest experience.

tours.name: Paint, Walk & Sangria
tours.description: Create your own vibrant masterpiece inspired by San Juan’s iconic sights, then stroll through historic cobblestone streets filled with colorful architecture, colonial charm, and fascinating stories.

tours.name: Transporte a las Fiestas de San Sebastian 2026
tours.description: Soar above San Sebastián's lively streets or descend into Puerto Rico's vibrant festivities with a helicopter ride—an unforgettable way to see the city’s energy from the sky.

tours.name: Transport
tours.description: Travel at your own pace with a flexible, custom transport service designed to suit your unique plans and destinations. Enjoy seamless, personalized journeys wherever you want to go.

tours.name: Cave Adventure Day
tours.description: Escape the city for a day of adventure: explore caves with ancient Taino drawings, relax on beaches, visit a local market, and enjoy authentic Puerto Rican cuisine—all in six unforgettable hours.

tours.name: Private Airport Transportation
tours.description: Travel smoothly with a private van for your family, including luggage and a friendly greeter. Enjoy hassle-free roundtrip service with convenient pick-up and drop-off—skip the taxi line and relax.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest & Bio Bay Tour
tours.description: Hike through lush El Yunque rainforest with mountain views and waterfall swims, then paddle at night in glowing Bioluminescent Bay, experiencing Puerto Rico’s natural magic in one unforgettable 11-hour adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Tour
tours.description: Hike through El Yunque’s lush rainforest, listen to coqui frogs, see stunning waterfalls, and enjoy a beach stop. All gear, guides, and refreshments included—perfect for adventure-loving families ready for nature’s magic.

tours.name: Old San Juan Sunset Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s vibrant streets, stunning views, rich history, lively music, and colorful architecture on a guided walking tour—perfect for all ages to experience Puerto Rico’s heart and soul.

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay Kayak Tour
tours.description: Paddle through glowing mangrove channels at Laguna Grande, marveling at microscopic planktons in a magical bio bay adventure perfect for families. All gear, guides, and refreshments included.

tours.name: Private Boat Day Trip
tours.description: Sail along Puerto Rico’s stunning east coast on a private 31 ft. boat, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, relax on white sand beaches, and enjoy snacks and drinks—all in a carefree, family-friendly adventure.

tours.name: Rum Tasting Tour
tours.description: Savor a rare selection of Caribbean rums, from Three Stars to the exclusive Cinco Estrellas. Taste the "angel’s share" and indulge in world-class spirits with a guided tour and a complimentary cocktail.

tours.name: Horseback Riding at the Forest
tours.description: Ride through lush valleys and wetlands on horseback, soaking in stunning views and vibrant wildlife. Perfect for families, with guided tours from a private farm—adventure awaits in this unique ecosystem.

tours.name: ATV Adventure
tours.description: Feel the thrill of Puerto Rico’s most talked-about ATV rides, racing through rugged trails and stopping at Mameyes River. Perfect for all skill levels—an adrenaline-packed adventure you won’t forget.

tours.name: Forest Zipline Adventure
tours.description: Soar through Puerto Rico’s lush mountains on five thrilling ziplines, cross canopy bridges, and enjoy scenic forest hikes. Feel the wind, see stunning views, and leave worries behind on this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest - Drive Yourself & Meet your Guide
tours.description: Explore El Yunque rainforest with a thrilling 4-hour adventure: hike to a hidden water park, swing on ropes, slide into clear pools, and jump from cliffs up to 30ft. Perfect for nature lovers seeking fun and tranquility.

tours.name: Sail Catamaran Day Trip
tours.description: Sail to Puerto Rico’s pristine Icacos Island, snorkel vibrant reefs, relax on white beaches, enjoy tropical drinks, and savor delicious food. Perfect for families and solo travelers seeking sun, sea, and adventure.

tours.name: Kayaks for rent
tours.description: Glide smoothly across calm waters in a solo kayak, feeling the gentle splash of water and the breeze on your face as you explore scenic shores at your own pace.

tours.name: Explore The Mountains - Hiking and Waterfalls Puerto Rico
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden mountain trails, waterfalls, and lush forests on a challenging yet rewarding hike. Enjoy panoramic views, ancient trees, natural pools, and a tasty local meal in a private reserve.

tours.name: Camuy Caves Transportation
tours.description: Explore the awe-inspiring Rio Camuy Caves, home to ancient stalactites, stalagmites, and a rushing underground river. A ranger-led tour reveals geological wonders in Puerto Rico’s third-largest cavern system.

tours.name: CLASS DAY
tours.description: up to 6 people

tours.name: San Juan Historic Tour & Beach Combo
tours.description: Explore San Juan’s colonial charm with stunning forts, lively squares, and hidden treasures. Enjoy 5.5 hours of history, vibrant sights, and relaxing moments in this beautiful, historic city.

tours.name: River, Sand and Sun Combo ( Luquillo gems )
tours.description: Enjoy a 5.5-hour adventure through crystal-clear rivers, lush tropical scenery, and the cool ocean. Savor diverse foods at Los Kioskos de Luquillo and taste the national drink—an unforgettable island experience.

tours.name: Central Mountain Range of Puerto Rico-Hiking, Waterfalls & Coffee Shop-Full Day
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden mountain treasures with a thrilling hike, stunning waterfalls, lush forests, and a private reserve. Enjoy fresh fruits, coffee, and panoramic views in an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: San Salvador Rainforest Hiking & Rappelling
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure in Puerto Rico's Carite Rainforest, where you'll hike through stunning landscapes and experience thrilling rappelling at two breathtaking waterfalls. Enjoy fresh tropical fruits, a delicious homemade meal, and panoramic views, all while exploring the island's hidden natural beauty. Perfect for physically fit adventurers!

tours.name: Bar & Restaurants Chinchorreo
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s heart in 5.5 hours with tasty food, local drinks, lively music, and warm locals. Travel scenic roads, enjoy cultural stops, and take home authentic souvenirs—an unforgettable family adventure.

tours.name: Old San Juan & Isla Verde Beach
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s colorful streets, historic forts, and charming plazas. Visit the vibrant Convention District, dance at La Placita, and relax on Isla Verde’s stunning beaches—all in just five hours.

tours.name: Decide Where and When to Dance With US
tours.description: Join a lively Puerto Rican dance class anywhere—beach, backyard, or rooftop. Learn Salsa, Merengue, Bachata, or Reggaetón with expert instructors. No experience needed—just bring your energy and move to the island’s rhythms.

tours.name: La Parguera Keys' Hopping Tour
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable 8-hour adventure in the Caribbean Sea! Snorkel and swim in crystal-clear waters as you explore the stunning mangrove islands of Cayo Caracoles and Cayo Mata La Gata. With a knowledgeable tour guide and a private boat, this journey promises unique sights and memorable moments.

tours.name: FATHER'S DAY PROMO
tours.description: Bring a dad or father figure and choose one activity—get a second entry free. Perfect for sharing special moments, whether kayaking or another adventure, with double the fun at no extra cost.

tours.name: Foodie Tour in the Countryside, Blue Pond and Coffee Plantation
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1-hour and 15-minute tour through a stunning hacienda, featuring a scenic 20-minute hike to the mesmerizing Charco Azul Blue Pond. Enjoy a refreshing swim in its crystalline waters, followed by a delicious lunch at the renowned El Rancho Original, famous for its roasted pork and culinary acclaim.

tours.name: Mid-Day Snorkeling Private Sail
tours.description: Transform your special occasion into an unforgettable experience with our exclusive event services. Whether it's a proposal, wedding, anniversary, or graduation, we provide a tailored boat and dedicated crew to ensure your celebration is spectacular. Let us handle the details while you create lasting memories.

tours.name: Family Package Ticket
tours.description: Enjoy a thrilling day with family-friendly zipline combos, climbing towers, and roller rides. Choose your adventure, stay safe, and create unforgettable memories in just 3 or 8 hours of fun.

tours.name: Snorkeling Tour Isla Caja de Muertos
tours.description: Sail to Isla Caja de Muertos, a hidden paradise with white beaches and clear waters. Snorkel, relax, and enjoy local lunch on a safe, comfortable boat with expert guides. An unforgettable Caribbean adventure awaits.

tours.name: Hiking Patillas Tour
tours.description: Explore Patillas' stunning rivers, lakes, and waterfalls on a flexible 2- or 4-hour adventure. Hike, swim in natural pools, and enjoy scenic views—perfect for families seeking nature’s thrill and tranquility.

tours.name: 2 Tank Dives for Certified Divers - Individual Ticket Availability
tours.description: Experience exclusive scuba diving trips designed for certified divers, with a maximum of six participants for personalized attention from a PADI divemaster. Explore stunning reefs up to 85 feet deep, all while enjoying a small group atmosphere. Join us on weekends for an unforgettable underwater adventure!

tours.name: Foilboarding
tours.description: Experience the thrill of hydrofoiling with our exciting one-hour session! Whether you're SUP Foiling, Foil Surfing, or Wing Surfing, you'll discover a unique sensation that elevates your water sports adventure. Join us for an unforgettable ride that will redefine your time on the water!

tours.name: Sailing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing on a hobbie cat wave for an hour, guided by your personal skipper. Explore the stunning Isla Verdes Nature Reserve and glide through the picturesque Cangrejos bridge and Balneario de Carolina, making unforgettable memories on the water while learning the art of sailing.

tours.name: Two day bike rental
tours.description: Experience the freedom of overnight biking with a secure lock provided for your convenience. Enjoy the thrill of exploring at your own pace, knowing your bike is safe and ready for your next adventure. Make the most of your journey and create unforgettable memories on two wheels!

tours.name: Weekly Bike Rental
tours.description: Book a week in advance and enjoy a $50 discount per bike, per day, totaling $300 off! Each bike comes fully equipped with a helmet, lock, truck bag, spare tube, tire levers, and a hand pump, ensuring a safe and convenient ride for your adventure.

tours.name: Three day bike rental
tours.description: Join us for an exciting biking adventure starting at 9am in Esperanza! Enjoy the unique experience of keeping your bike overnight, allowing you to explore the area at your leisure. Return your bike by 7pm on the third day, making unforgettable memories along the way.

tours.name: Four Day Bike Rental
tours.description: Experience the freedom of exploring at your own pace with a four-day bike rental. Perfect for adventurers and casual riders alike, this opportunity allows you to discover scenic routes and hidden gems while enjoying the fresh air and exercise. Make unforgettable memories on two wheels!

tours.name: Two Week Bike Rental
tours.description: Book your bike adventure two weeks in advance and enjoy a fantastic discount of over $10 per bike, per day. Each rental includes essential gear like a helmet, lock, and trunk bag, ensuring a memorable and hassle-free ride. Experience the freedom of cycling with everything you need at your fingertips.

tours.name: Six Day Bike Rental
tours.description: Book your bike adventure six days in advance and enjoy an $80 discount per bike, per day! For just $270, each rental includes a helmet, lock, and a truck bag equipped with a spare tube, tire levers, and a hand pump, ensuring a safe and enjoyable ride.

tours.name: Ocean Club San Juan: Salsa Class + Cocktail Included
tours.description: Join a lively salsa class at a beachfront spot in Puerto Rico, then dance the night away with locals. No experience needed—just bring your energy, wear light clothes, and enjoy authentic Caribbean nightlife.

tours.name: El Yunque Half-Day Sightseeing Tour
tours.description: 12+ years old • 6 Hours • Amazing adventure into the heart of the El Yunque Rainforest!

tours.name: Pine Forest Tour
tours.description: Discover the serene beauty of a unique pine forest in the heart of Puerto Rico on this immersive 6-hour tour. Enjoy a beginner-friendly hike through lush trails, breathtaking views, and the soothing sounds of nature. Conclude your adventure with refreshing mojitos and local cuisine at a nearby bar.

tours.name: Old San Juan Historical Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Old San Juan, exploring its rich history. Visit the impressive San Felipe Fortress, the stunning San Juan Cathedral, and the grand Capitolio, while wandering along charming cobblestone streets that echo the past. This tour promises a memorable glimpse into the city's vibrant heritage.

tours.name: Skyline Sojourn Heli-tour - long
tours.description: Soar over Puerto Rico’s stunning landscapes—canyons, caves, and coastlines—where ancient ruins, towering cliffs, and lush mountains tell stories of natural beauty and rich history in a breathtaking aerial adventure.

tours.name: Puerto Rican Christmas Experience tour
tours.description: Taste Puerto Rican Christmas year-round on Pork Highway with lively music, savory lechón, sweet coquito, and artisan crafts. Immerse in vibrant traditions amid mountain scenery and festive cheer.

tours.name: Private Specialty Charters
tours.description: Set sail on a thrilling 6-hour private cruise in the Spanish Virgin Islands, with snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaks, fresh food, and drinks—perfect for custom adventures or special celebrations.

tours.name: Beach Buzz Tour
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking helicopter flight over Puerto Rico's rich history! Experience stunning views of Old San Juan, including the iconic El Morro fortress and Bacardi Rum distillery. This unique adventure offers a memorable perspective on the island's heritage, perfect for history enthusiasts and thrill-seekers alike.

tours.name: Rainforest Half Day Tour from San Juan
tours.description: Jump into Puerto Rico’s lush rainforest for a thrilling day of river swimming, waterfalls, natural waterslides, and rope swings. Enjoy fresh local fruit amid stunning scenery and peaceful nature.

tours.name: Wakeboarding
tours.description: Experience the thrill of water sports in Puerto Rico with an exhilarating hour of wakeboarding and Jet Ski fun. Under the guidance of an expert instructor, you'll learn essential techniques while enjoying the sun, wind, and stunning views. Perfect for those seeking adventure and a memorable aquatic experience!

tours.name: Kneeboarding
tours.description: Experience the thrill of kneeboarding in Puerto Rico, where both kids and adults can dive into an exciting water adventure! Enjoy personalized lessons from an experienced captain, ensuring safety and fun as you glide across the waves. This unique sport combines skill and excitement, making it perfect for all ages!

tours.name: Private Transportation Services
tours.description: Travel Puerto Rico in style with professional chauffeurs, spacious vehicles, and flexible options. Relax and enjoy the scenery while we handle navigation, tolls, and routes—your stress-free ride awaits.

tours.name: Custom Tour for Troy Barrett and Family
tours.description: Embark on a customized tour that blends history, culture, and nature in Puerto Rico. Explore the majestic San Juan National Historic Site, savor authentic local cuisine, hike to hidden waterfalls in El Yunque Rainforest, and immerse yourself in the vibrant street art of Santurce. An unforgettable adventure awaits!

tours.name: Private Prone Foiling Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of prone foiling with a personalized one-hour lesson designed just for you! Under expert guidance, learn to pop up, ride waves, and achieve flight. With tailored tips and top-notch equipment, you'll gain confidence and skill to conquer waves like never before. Ride the wave that never ends!

tours.name: Hop On Hop Off: Explore San Juan with Our Hybrid Tour
tours.description: Explore San Juan’s vibrant neighborhoods, colorful murals, historic streets, and stunning beaches on a flexible tour blending culture, cuisine, and coastal views—all in one unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: LGBTQ+ Salsa Beach Class
tours.description: Join a lively night in San Juan’s LGBTQ+ scene, with welcoming bars, dancing to Caribbean beats, and meeting locals and travelers. Celebrate freedom and community in an unforgettable, inclusive party.

tours.name: Beach Horseback Riding
tours.description: Enjoy a peaceful horseback ride through lush tropical trails or along the beach, perfect for all ages. Relax with trained horses, scenic views, and guided safety—an unforgettable adventure awaits.

tours.name: 🎭 Loíza Cultural Tour Experience
tours.description: Feel the pulse of Loíza’s Afro-Caribbean roots with lively dance, vibrant masks, and mouthwatering local bites. Dive into Puerto Rican culture through rhythm, craft, and flavor in this unforgettable tour.

tours.name: Afternoon Kayak Eco Tour
tours.description: Paddle through a tranquil lagoon fringed by mangroves, spotting sea stars, iguanas, and maybe a manatee. Enjoy fun facts, local stories, and tasty restaurant tips on this family-friendly urban adventure.

tours.name: Half day Snorkeling Tour
tours.description: Set sail from Puerto del Rey, enjoy refreshments with mountain and ocean views, then snorkel in crystal-clear waters near a deserted island. Perfect for all ages—adventure and relaxation await.

tours.name: 🍹 Barrilito Mixology Experience + San Juan at Leisure
tours.description: Create signature cocktails with aged Ron del Barrilito, fresh island ingredients, and expert techniques. Then relax in Old San Juan’s charming streets, shopping, or enjoying a café con leche by El Morro.

tours.name: 🚙 UTV Adventure Tour
tours.description: Race through El Yunque’s lush foothills on a guided UTV adventure, crossing rivers and conquering scenic trails. Feel the thrill of off-road exploration amid breathtaking views and untouched nature.

tours.name: Culebra Beach and Snorkeling Tour
tours.description: Float above vibrant coral reefs, swim alongside sea turtles, and soak up the sun on Culebra’s pristine beaches. A full day of snorkeling, turquoise waters, and tropical wildlife awaits adventure and relaxation alike.

tours.name: Afternoon Kayak Eco Tour
tours.description: Paddle through a tranquil lagoon fringed with mangroves, spotting sea stars, iguanas, and maybe a manatee. Enjoy fun facts, local stories, and tasty restaurant tips in this lively, family-friendly urban adventure.

tours.name: Half Day Charter
tours.description: Cruise the Caribbean in style aboard the Robalo 30', taking in stunning mountain and coastline views. Let our expert crew turn your day into an unforgettable adventure on sparkling waters.

tours.name: Valentine's Sunset Sail
tours.description: Sail into romance with drinks, music, and a stunning sunset view on a romantic evening cruise. Enjoy appetizers, an open bar, and a peaceful escape as the sky transforms—perfect for creating unforgettable memories.

tours.name: PRIVATE WALKING TOUR of OLD SAN JUAN
tours.description: Step into Old San Juan’s storied past with a private tour revealing historic landmarks, stunning architecture, and vibrant culture—an immersive journey through centuries of Puerto Rican history.

tours.name: Caving & Body Rafting (NT)
tours.description: Explore northwest Puerto Rico with a scenic mountain hike, water-filled limestone caves, and thrilling Body Rafting™ through canyon walls fed by underground springs—an adventure full of culture, nature, and excitement.

tours.name: Light Tackle Fishing (NT)
tours.description: Set out on a 4-hour fishing adventure from Cangrejos Yacht Club to Puerto Rico’s vibrant lagoons, targeting Tarpon, Snook, and more. Perfect for anglers seeking excitement in a low to moderate challenge.

tours.name: Old San Juan Sunset Food Tour (NT)
tours.description: Stroll through Old San Juan’s historic cobblestone streets, uncovering its rich architecture and culture. Savor authentic Puerto Rican flavors on a 3-hour walk full of sights, sounds, and delicious tastes.

tours.name: De Paseo para Arroyo, Guayama y Salinas
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure with a catamaran cruise through the stunning Bahía de Jobos, explore the historic Museo Antigua Aduana, and savor a delicious lunch at Restaurante 123 Pescao. Enjoy local culture at Guayama Fishing Club, complete with snacks and round-trip transportation from San Juan for a perfect day out.

tours.name: Eleva Tú San valentin
tours.description: Soar over historic Old San Juan, glide along the enchanting shore, or escape into lush green landscapes—all in breathtaking flights that reveal Puerto Rico’s most stunning sights from above.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Hiking Magical Adventure
tours.description: Dive into El Yunque’s lush rainforest, where waterfalls invite you to relax, ropes swing you through the trees, and a natural slide thrills with every splash. An adventure in nature’s hidden paradise.

tours.name: El Yunque National Forest (Rainforest)
tours.description: Explore El Yunque’s lush rainforest with waterfalls, trails, and stunning views. Walk through history, learn about nature, and enjoy an adventure in Puerto Rico’s most famous natural wonder.

tours.name: Chinchorro Bar / Food Experience
tours.description: Join a lively tour through Puerto Rico’s local “chinchorros,” savor authentic drinks, dance with new friends, and enjoy hassle-free bar hopping in vibrant northeastern towns. Get ready to party and experience the real local flavor.

tours.name: Rainforest & Luquillo Beach Tour
tours.description: Climb the Yocahu Tower, marvel at La Coca Waterfall, then enjoy a fun hike, river swim, base jump, and rope swing. Relax at Luquillo Beach with free time for lunch, shopping, and soaking up the sun.

tours.name: Full Day Rainforest tour
tours.description: Jump into the river for a swim, swing from a rope, and take daring base jumps into the water. After thrilling adventures, relax with lunch back at the hotel—an action-packed day in nature.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Sugarcane Estate Distillery Experience
tours.description: Discover the only Sugarcane Estate Distillery in Puerto Rico, where you’ll enjoy a refreshing cocktail made with award-winning TRESCLAVOS rum. Explore the rich history of Puerto Rican rum-making, tour the distillery and aging bodega, and indulge in a unique artisanal rum tasting experience that celebrates local flavors and traditions.

tours.name: Rum Tasting
tours.description: Experience the exquisite world of aged spirits with a unique tasting event that showcases a selection of exceptional rums. Savor the fruity notes of Dos Estrellas, the cult-favorite Tres Estrellas, and the exclusive Ron del Barrilito Cuatro Estrellas, culminating in the remarkable Cinco Estrellas. A rare chance to indulge in luxury!

tours.name: Taste Puerto Rico : Tabaco, Ron & Casita Vieja
tours.description: Dive into Caguas’ vibrant culture with a tobacco museum tour, hands-on rum mixology, and a flavorful Puerto Rican meal—an immersive journey blending tradition, taste, and island pride in one unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Old San Juan Night Glow Electric Scooter Tour
tours.description: Glide along Old San Juan’s waterfront at night on a glowing electric scooter, soaking in city lights and coastal views for a fun, relaxed adventure that creates unforgettable moments.

tours.name: Sunset Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a serene 2-hour sunset cruise aboard a luxurious Bertram 33, featuring spacious staterooms and a well-equipped kitchen. With an experienced crew at the helm, enjoy a smooth ride while soaking in breathtaking views, perfect for a memorable outing with friends or a peaceful escape into the evening sky.

tours.name: Snorkeling Tour Isla Cardona
tours.description: Embark on a snorkeling adventure to Isla Cardona, a serene gem in southern Puerto Rico. Just 1.3 nautical miles from Ponce, this uninhabited island boasts crystal-clear waters, a historic lighthouse, and vibrant marine life, making it a perfect escape for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.

tours.name: El Yunque: Rainforest and Beach Tour
tours.description: Discover the enchanting El Yunque Rainforest and unwind on Puerto Rico's pristine beaches in a single day. This full-day tour offers scenic hikes through lush greenery and cascading waterfalls, followed by relaxation on soft sands and crystal-clear waters, creating a perfect blend of adventure and tranquility.

tours.name: Mid-Day Snorkeling Public Sail
tours.description: Public Sail | Most Popular!

tours.name: 🍹 Barrilito Mixology Experience + San Juan at Leisure
tours.description: Experience the art of mixology at Hacienda Santa Ana, where Puerto Rico's oldest rum, Ron del Barrilito, meets modern cocktail techniques. Craft signature drinks with premium rums and fresh ingredients, then enjoy a relaxing afternoon exploring the charming streets of Old San Juan, complete with local shopping and stunning views.

tours.name: 🥃 Barrilito Rum Tasting + San Juan at Leisure
tours.description: Experience the rich rum heritage of Puerto Rico with a guided tasting at the historic Barrilito distillery. Sample rare blends like Ron del Barrilito Five Stars and learn about the art of rum-making. Afterward, explore San Juan’s colonial landmarks and vibrant culinary scene at your leisure, making unforgettable memories.

tours.name: ATV 2-Hour Tour
tours.description: Rev up your adventure with an off-road ATV ride through mud, forests, and open terrain. Perfect for beginners, guided support, gear included, and round-trip transport make this Puerto Rico thrill unforgettable.

tours.name: ⛵ Catamaran Sail & Snorkel Tour
tours.description: Sail into turquoise waters, snorkel vibrant coral reefs, and relax on a modern catamaran with tropical drinks and music. Enjoy a half-day of adventure, sun, and sea in stunning paradise.

tours.name: 🐎 Horseback Riding
tours.description: Enjoy a peaceful ride through tropical trails or along the beach on gentle horses, perfect for families and beginners. Relax, take in lush scenery, and let experienced guides ensure a safe, memorable adventure.

tours.name: 🌠 Bioluminescent Bay Kayak
tours.description: Paddle through a glowing lagoon after sunset, where shimmering marine life lights up the dark waters. Easy for beginners, with gear, guides, and transport included—an unforgettable night adventure.

tours.name: Zipline Adventure
tours.description: Fly above Puerto Rico’s treetops on zip lines and hanging bridges, soaking in breathtaking canopy views. Safe, thrilling, and guided—an unforgettable adventure with transport included.

tours.name: 🥃 Barrilito Rum Tasting + San Juan at Leisure
tours.description: Taste the essence of Puerto Rico’s rum heritage with a guided tour of Barrilito distillery, sampling rare blends like Ron del Barrilito Five Stars. Afterward, explore San Juan’s colonial sites, relax by the waterfront, or enjoy a sunset cocktail—transportation and a complimentary drink included for a memorable day.

tours.name: Observer
tours.description: Soar high above the water, feeling the wind and sunshine as you glide with a parasail. Enjoy breathtaking views and an adrenaline rush that will leave you craving more.

tours.name: Yunque Rainforest, Luquillo Beach & Bioluminescent Bay Trio
Discover Scuba
tours.description: Try scuba in just 4 hours! Under expert supervision, learn basic skills in a pool or open water, suitable for ages 10+. Bring your smile and dive into an unforgettable underwater adventure.

tours.name: Hacienda Horizonte Farm Tour
tours.description: Discover the enchanting Hacienda Horizonte in Utuado, Puerto Rico, a 100-acre paradise where nature thrives. Enjoy interpretative walks through lush forests, taste seasonal fruits, and soak in breathtaking views while sipping exclusive Café Horizonte. This immersive experience connects you with the land's beauty and rich history for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Tres Palmitas Snorkeling Tour
tours.description: Paddle through lush mangroves, reach a secluded beach for snorkeling, and explore stunning sea caves in the Caribbean—an exhilarating 3.5-hour kayak adventure full of natural wonders.

tours.name: Bio Bay & Rainforest Combo
tours.description: Explore El Yunque, a stunning tropical rainforest with waterfalls, rare wildlife, and mountain views. Hike to La Mina Waterfall, visit Yokahú Tower, and enjoy breathtaking cloud scenery—all in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: La Chiva Snorkeling Tour
tours.description: Dive into crystal-clear waters at La China, where vibrant marine life awaits. Choose your adventure level and snorkel in paradise, guided by experts. All gear included for a memorable 3-hour underwater escape.

tours.name: Beach and Snorkel Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling three-hour guided boat tour of Culebra's stunning beaches! Snorkel in vibrant coral reefs, unwind in crystal-clear waters, and discover the island's rich history and coral restoration efforts. This unique adventure promises unforgettable memories and a chance to connect with nature like never before.

tours.name: 1 Hour Paddle Boarding Private Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddle boarding while immersing yourself in nature! This one-hour introductory tour is perfect for beginners, featuring a quick lesson before you glide across the water. Enjoy the scenic surroundings and explore the beach, making it a memorable adventure before your ferry ride.

tours.name: C It All Tour - Coast, Canyon & Caves
tours.description: Experience the ultimate flying tour over Puerto Rico's breathtaking landscapes! Soar above lush mountains, stunning canyons, and cascading rivers, then glide along the picturesque coastline. Witness iconic sights like Los Tubos and Puerto Nuevo beaches, and the historic La Fortaleza. This unforgettable adventure promises stunning views and lasting memories.

tours.name: 2 Hour Advanced Lesson
tours.description: Boost your skills with a 2-hour session from an IKO pro, mastering jumps, kite-loops, or foil tacking. Ride top gear with radio coaching—your perfect lesson tailored to your goals.

tours.name: Culebra Tour - Camping and Snorkeling
tours.description: Join a full-day island tour to Flamenco Beach, snorkel with turtles and rays, and enjoy scenic beaches. Opt for a luxurious two-day camping experience with meals, nightlife, and starry skies. All gear and transport included.

tours.name: Vieques Tour bioluminescent bay with Camping
tours.description: Enjoy VIP treatment with guided kayak trips to the brightest bioluminescent bay, cultural food tours, and hassle-free camping. We handle all logistics—just bring your clothes and appetite for adventure.

tours.name: Tinglar Hike
tours.description: Combine gentle hiking with snorkeling in a safe, shallow natural pool. Explore beaches, forests, and mangroves while enjoying vibrant wildlife. Perfect for families, this eco-friendly 4-hour adventure is easy and educational.

tours.name: ATV Tour through Natural Reserve
tours.description: Race through lush jungle trails on an ATV, guided by experts who share fascinating flora and fauna. Capture stunning photos and videos as you zoom past vibrant scenery in this thrilling one-hour adventure.

tours.name: Snorkeling Kayak Tour
tours.description: Explore our vibrant coral reef in safe, shallow waters. See colorful fish and marine life up close. All gear provided, and kids are welcome—perfect for a fun, family-friendly underwater adventure.

tours.name: Chinchorreo Tour
tours.description: Join a fun bay tour with mangroves, sailboats, and shops. We provide gear, life jackets, and a quick lesson. Pass by scenic spots, enjoy drinks and snacks—perfect for groups seeking adventure and relaxation.

tours.name: Paddleboarding Tours
tours.description: Explore Patillas' Natural Reserve and bay in a 2-hour guided tour, then cool off with a swim in stunning natural pools carved by ancient reefs. An adventure blending nature and refreshment awaits.

tours.name: Private Biobay Tour
tours.description: Glide through Vieques' glowing bay on a 2-hour kayak tour, witnessing the aqua-blue shimmer of bioluminescent organisms under starry skies. An unforgettable blend of science and natural magic awaits you.

tours.name: Adventure Video
tours.description: Relive your adventure with a personalized video, blending your photos and videos into a lively, music-filled keepsake that captures every exciting moment with friends.

tours.name: Mangrove Kayak Tour
tours.description: Glide silently through tranquil mangrove tunnels, spotting vibrant birds, crabs, and oysters. Feel the peaceful serenity of this floating forest and uncover the secrets of these extraordinary trees with expert guides.

tours.name: Glassbottom Boat Day Tours
tours.description: All Ages • 1 Hour • Enjoy a closer look at the cays, the beautiful coral reefs

tours.name: Icacos Snorkeling & Beach Tour
tours.description: Sail aboard the East Wind to explore Puerto Rico’s stunning cays, snorkel through vibrant underwater worlds via glass windows, and enjoy fun waterslides—all in a safe, family-friendly 5.5-hour adventure.

tours.name: Banana Boat
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the Banana Boat in Puerto Rico! This exhilarating 15-minute ride tows you behind a Jet Ski, offering breathtaking views and an adrenaline rush like no other. Perfect for groups, it's an unforgettable way to celebrate special occasions while enjoying the refreshing waters. Dive in and hold on tight!

tours.name: Free Consultation
tours.description: Get expert advice on watersports gear and lessons with a free consultation—perfect for answering your questions before you dive into a full experience.

tours.name: Wild Tour
tours.description: Experience the tranquility of our bay on a kayak or paddle board, where you can explore vibrant marine life and stunning landscapes. With expert guidance and equipment instruction, this 1 to 2-hour adventure offers a unique opportunity to connect with nature during the serene morning hours.

tours.name: Sunset Tour
tours.description: Experience the tranquility of paddling in a kayak or on a paddleboard as you soak in breathtaking sunset views and explore serene landscapes. A visit to a natural pool invites a refreshing dip, all while feeling safe and supported with provided gear and guidance. Create unforgettable memories in this idyllic setting.

tours.name: Sunny Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of adventure in Patillas, PR, as you explore serene sailboat reserves, lush mangroves, and stunning beaches. Enjoy a smooth route free from strong currents, surrounded by breathtaking landscapes. With all equipment provided and expert guidance, this unique journey promises unforgettable fun in the sun.

tours.name: La Aventura Bike
tours.description: Experience a delightful group bike ride along the scenic boardwalk of Balneario de Patillas. Perfect for both children and adults, this unique tour offers stunning ocean views and vibrant kiosks, making it a memorable Sunday adventure for the whole family. Enjoy the fresh air and camaraderie as you pedal together!

tours.name: Fishing Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of fishing in a kayak or boat, exploring a vibrant bay teeming with marine life. With provided equipment and life jackets, our expert guides will accompany you, ensuring a memorable hour of learning and adventure on the water.

tours.name: Infinity Pool
tours.description: Embark on an extreme adventure filled with adrenaline as you explore a wild path leading to a hidden paradise and a refreshing dip in the "Natural Infinity Pool." Conclude your journey with a scenic drive, savoring delicious local cuisine amidst a vibrant atmosphere of live music and dancing.

tours.name: Cultural Experience Tour
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant Puerto Rican culture on this unique tour. Engage with locals in their daily lives, explore farms, savor traditional cuisine and drinks, and enjoy lively music and dances. Experience an intimate connection with the rich cultural traditions that make Puerto Rico truly special.

tours.name: Rivers / Lakes Tours
tours.description: Experience the paradise of Patillas with stunning lake views and refreshing river dips. Embark on a mountain hike that immerses you in nature, followed by a delightful tour of local culinary delights. This unique adventure promises breathtaking scenery and a memorable atmosphere, all within a convenient 5-hour journey.

tours.name: Patillas Camping Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique camping adventure where everything is provided, from tents to mattresses! Learn to set up your camp while enjoying a campfire, marshmallows, and breakfast. Perfect for ages 12 and up, this experience connects you with nature, with optional hiking or snorkeling tours available for an extra thrill.

tours.name: Adventure to the West of Puerto Rico
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour adventure in western Puerto Rico! Explore stunning sites like the Cabo Rojo Lighthouse and the unique Dirty Beach, then savor delicious local cuisine in the charming town of Boquerón. This experience promises breathtaking views and memorable moments with friends. Join us for a day of exploration!

tours.name: San Juan Tour
