tours.description: Explore the captivating capital of Puerto Rico as you stroll through its historic cobblestone streets. Discover the charm of the walled city, visit majestic castles, and relax in vibrant squares filled with shops and delightful eateries, all while immersing yourself in the rich colonial heritage of this enchanting destination.

tours.name: Adventure Trips Chinchorreo PR
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure with your group of up to 10 as you explore the stunning landscapes of Puerto Rico. Discover hidden gems along coastal and mountainous routes while indulging in local shops. Experience the vibrant culture and natural beauty that make this journey truly special.

tours.name: Pterocarpus Adventure Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable hiking adventure in Patillas' natural reserve, where you'll explore lush forests, serene beaches, and vibrant mangroves. Experience the enchanting sounds of nature, discover the Pterocarpus Forest, and take a refreshing dip in a natural pool. This eco-educational journey promises magical moments for all participants aged 12 and up.

tours.name: 3 Hour Kitesurfing Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of kiteboarding with a comprehensive 3-hour lesson at RAD Kiteboarding. Learn essential safety techniques, wind theory, and gear setup while mastering kite control and situational awareness. This unique introduction not only equips you with skills but also teaches self-rescue techniques, ensuring a fun and safe adventure on the water.

tours.name: 2 Hour Kitesurfing Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of kiteboarding with our 2-hour session focused on bodydrags and waterstarts. Master the art of controlling the kite and riding on water, while learning essential skills like upwind riding. This exciting progression will elevate your confidence and enjoyment on the water, making every moment unforgettable.

tours.name: Inactive Diver / Refresher Course
tours.description: Revitalize your diving skills with the SDI Inactive Diver/Refresher Program! This unique four-hour experience combines personalized training in small groups with an essential e-learning theory course. Perfect for instructors and divers looking to refresh their knowledge, it sets the stage for further education and unforgettable underwater adventures.

tours.name: SDI Open Water Scuba Diver
tours.description: Embark on a transformative 3-day scuba diving course, where expert instructors guide you through e-learning, pool sessions, and thrilling dives. Experience personalized training in small groups, gaining the skills to explore underwater wonders confidently. Complete your certification and become an ambassador for the ocean, ready for adventures at home or abroad.

tours.name: Half Day Fishing Trip
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating half-day fishing adventure! Start by catching live bait, then set off to target exciting species like yellowfin tuna and wahoo. Enjoy the thrill of fishing in diverse spots, concluding with a memorable tarpon catch right outside the marina. Refreshments are provided to keep you energized!

tours.name: 3/4 Day Fishing Trip
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 7-hour fishing adventure, where you'll use live bait to target pelagic species. Experience the thrill of bottom fishing for groupers, high-speed jigging for tunas, or trolling for mahi and wahoos. Enjoy complimentary snacks and drinks while creating unforgettable memories on the water!

tours.name: Sunset Cruise
tours.description: Experience a breathtaking 2.5-hour private sunset cruise along Rincon's stunning coastline. Witness the majestic humpback whales during peak season while enjoying complimentary snacks and drinks. Bring your favorite beverages and snacks to enhance this unforgettable adventure amidst Puerto Rico's picturesque mountains and ocean views.

tours.name: Wakesurfing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of wake surfing, a popular coastal sport where you ride a smaller surfboard, towed by a boat at exhilarating speeds of 12 to 15 km/h. Enjoy an hour of fun on the water, soaking up the sun and the excitement of mastering this unique aquatic adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque Night Tour
tours.description: Experience the enchanting El Yunque rainforest like never before on this afternoon and evening walking tour. Discover the vibrant nocturnal life, including the charming coqui, as you immerse yourself in the unique sounds of the night. Perfect for all ages, this adventure promises unforgettable moments and a magical atmosphere.

tours.name: Toro Pass Transportation Combo (2)
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 9-hour zipline adventure in Puerto Rico, featuring 8 thrilling ziplines that weave through stunning mountains. Experience the rush of flying on "The Beast," one of the longest ziplines globally, and conquer "The Monster," the longest in America, reaching speeds up to 95 mph.

tours.name: Old San Juan Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating two-hour walking tour through the historic walled city, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Discover 500 years of rich culture, visit iconic landmarks, and enjoy breathtaking scenic views, all while immersing yourself in the vibrant history of the Caribbean's most significant historic center.

tours.name: Aboriginal Puerto Rico Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique journey through Borikén's rich pre-colonial history, exploring archaeological sites that challenge conventional narratives. This tour offers a fresh perspective on Puerto Rico's indigenous heritage, informed by recent scientific discoveries. Engage with a decolonial approach that redefines what it means to be Puerto Rican and Caribbean.

tours.name: Fish Frenzy & Queer Monument Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3.5-hour adventure that blends natural beauty with rich history. Explore a historic beach, snorkel among vibrant marine life, and visit poignant memorials, including the tribute to Pulse's victims. Discover the remnants of a Spanish fortress while hiking and sightseeing in this unforgettable cultural excursion.

tours.name: Old San Juan Spooky Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2.5-hour journey through Old San Juan's historic center, where myths and legends intertwine with real events. As night falls, explore the eerie tales of pirates, battles, and supernatural occurrences that shaped the city. This immersive tour promises a unique blend of culture, history, and suspense.

tours.name: PROMO - 4th of July
tours.description: Celebrate Independence Day with a glowing kayak ride over Condado Lagoon, watching dazzling fireworks light up the sky. Bring friends, paddle under the stars, and make unforgettable memories this July 4th.

tours.name: Boat Scuba Tours
tours.description: Dive into Puerto Rico’s vibrant waters with top-notch scuba and snorkeling adventures. Explore coral reefs, enjoy comfortable boats, and create unforgettable memories beneath the waves. Book your aquatic escape today.

tours.name: Wedding Celebration
tours.description: Transform your wedding into a magical celebration with our unique Wedding Dance Experience. Choose between a personalized dance class that reflects your love story or an awe-inspiring performance by professional dancers. Both options promise to unite your guests and create unforgettable memories, making your special day truly remarkable.

tours.name: Christmas Mini Photo Session
tours.description: Capture the magic of the holiday season with our enchanting Christmas Mini Sessions at the Embassy Suites By Hilton Dorado del Mar Beach Resort. Gather your loved ones for a 15-minute portrait session, creating beautiful Christmas-themed photos perfect for gifts and cards, while making cherished memories together.

tours.name: Private Sail & Snorkel
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-hour sail aboard a Hobie Getaway, gliding over the stunning waters of Rincon. Discover hidden snorkel spots rich with marine life, perfect for adventurous swimmers. Experience hands-on sailing while enjoying the beauty of nature—just remember to bring your gear and prepare to get wet!

tours.name: Hyatt Regency El Yunque National Rainforest Half Day Tour
tours.description: Explore the enchanting El Yunque National Forest, a unique tropical rainforest teeming with biodiversity. Experience stunning views from the Yokahú observatory tower, visit the picturesque La Coca Waterfall, and enjoy a refreshing swim in a mountain river. Immerse yourself in nature's beauty and adventure year-round in this breathtaking paradise.

tours.name: 1.5 Hour Step-Off Surfing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Jet Ski Assisted Surfing, where you can catch more waves and enhance your skills quickly. Perfect for surfers of all levels, this unique activity combines the excitement of surfing with the adrenaline of jet skiing, making it an unforgettable way to ride the waves!

tours.name: 2 Hour Wing Foiling Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Wing Foiling, a dynamic blend of windsurfing, kiteboarding, and surfing! Our comprehensive program guides you through essential skills like wind theory, flying the wing, and mastering the hydrofoil. Feel the exhilaration of gliding above water while learning to navigate safely and efficiently. Join us for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Youth Sailing Sessions
tours.description: Join us for exciting sailing sessions tailored for youth! Whether it's a single day, a holiday break, or a week-long summer adventure, you'll enhance your skills while enjoying the thrill of being on the water. Spaces are limited, so secure your spot for an unforgettable experience!

tours.name: 2 Hour Guided Surfing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of guided surfing with RAD, where expert guidance transforms your session. Whether you seek uncrowded waves or wish to enhance your skills, enjoy a unique adventure using a jetski or local transport to reach pristine surf spots. Surfboards are provided for an unforgettable ride.

tours.name: Morning Cruise
tours.description: Set sail on a 2-hour boat cruise filled with scenic views, soothing waters, and friendly crew. Feel the luxury and relaxation as you drift through stunning landscapes on this unforgettable morning adventure.

tours.name: Afternoon Cruise
tours.description: Set sail on a 2-hour boat cruise filled with scenic views, relaxing moments, and friendly crew. Feel the luxury and tranquility as you drift through beautiful waters on this unforgettable afternoon adventure.

tours.name: Night Cruise
tours.description: Set sail for two hours of unforgettable moments on the water, perfect for celebrations, romance, or family fun. Feel the breeze, see stunning views, and create memories that will stay with you long after the cruise ends.

tours.name: Midnight Cruise
tours.description: Dive into the night waters for a mesmerizing 2-hour adventure that transforms your evening into an unforgettable, soothing escape. Perfect for ending your day with a splash of magic.

tours.name: Custom Cruise
tours.description: Sail through San Juan’s sparkling waters on a sleek Bertram 33, enjoying a safe, smooth ride. Customize your 2-hour private trip with stunning views, comfort, and fun for families or groups aboard this luxurious boat.

tours.name: The Local Cays Full Day Tour
tours.description: For all ages! • 6 Hours • Up to 12 People

tours.name: The Local Cays Half Day Tour
tours.description: Embark on a 4-hour sailing adventure to the stunning cays of Palomino or Icacos, where you can unwind on pristine beaches and soak in breathtaking views. Enhance your experience with jet ski rentals, snorkeling gear, and delicious snacks, while our team prepares a delightful lunch for you and your guests.

tours.name: Culebra Tour
tours.description: Embark on a stunning 6-hour adventure to Culebra, home to breathtaking beaches like Flamenco and Culebrita. Enjoy a delicious BBQ prepared by our team, along with snorkeling gear and relaxing amenities. Experience the beauty of this island paradise while soaking up the sun and exploring crystal-clear waters!

tours.name: Vieques Tour
tours.description: Embark on a 6-hour adventure to Vieques, exploring stunning beaches like Punta Arenas and Cayo Yayí. Enjoy a delicious BBQ prepared onboard, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, and relax with provided gear. This unique experience combines breathtaking views with the thrill of the ocean, making it truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Private One-on-One Efoil Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of efoiling with a personalized 60-minute session, featuring one-on-one instruction from a Lift Certified Partner. Learn essential skills like speed adjustments and turns while enjoying ample water time. Capture your adventure with an optional content package, ensuring unforgettable memories of this unique aquatic journey.

tours.name: Private One-on-One Surf Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing in Isabela, Puerto Rico, with a private 60-minute lesson led by an ISA-certified coach. Perfect for all ages and skill levels, you'll learn essential techniques like wave selection and paddling, ensuring you catch your own waves in this surfing paradise. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Group Surf Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of riding the waves with a 60-minute group surf lesson led by an ISA certified coach. Perfect for all skill levels, this adventure promises team bonding, family fun, or an unforgettable date. Learn essential techniques and catch your own waves while enjoying the sun and surf!

tours.name: Waterfalls Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 2.5-hour adventure in Northwest Puerto Rico, where you'll hike, swim, and swing from jungle vines at a breathtaking waterfall. Discover hidden gems and learn safe navigation techniques while enjoying stunning views and thrilling jumps into crystal-clear waters. A perfect blend of nature and excitement awaits!

tours.name: Saona Island Full Day Tour
tours.description: Explore hidden Caribbean gems on a 6-hour private tour: visit a turtle conservation community, relax on secret beaches, enjoy a Dominican buffet, and swim among starfish in natural pools—an authentic island adventure.

tours.name: Basic Rifle Course | Curso Básico de Rifle
tours.description: Join the Basic Rifle Course for an immersive 6-hour experience that teaches essential rifle safety and handling. Perfect for beginners, you'll master sight alignment, breath control, and shooting techniques through hands-on exercises. Gain confidence and knowledge in rifle maintenance, ensuring a solid foundation for your shooting journey.

tours.name: Private Transportation - Flex booking
tours.description: Experience the ease of exploring the island with our private luxury van transportation. Enjoy cold A/C and the company of friendly local guides as you travel to destinations like El Yunque or Rincon. With flexible booking options, your adventure is tailored to your needs, making your trip unforgettable.

tours.name: Private Transportation - Airport Pickup (24/7) Small Groups
tours.description: Enjoy hassle-free airport transfers anytime, anywhere on the island. We handle late-night and early-morning pickups and dropoffs, making your travel seamless and stress-free, no matter your flight schedule.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the El Yunque Waterfall Slide, where a short hike leads you to the stunning Las Tinajas waterfall. Enjoy sliding down natural rock formations or jumping off cliffs into crystal-clear waters. This family-friendly adventure includes a taste of authentic Puerto Rican cuisine and convenient transportation from San Juan.

tours.name: Panama City to Santa Catalina 5 day Liveaboard Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-day sailing adventure from Panama City to Santa Catalina. Discover the stunning Las Perlas Islands and engage in thrilling spearfishing at picturesque spots like Punta Mama and Isla Cebaco. Enjoy an all-inclusive experience with delicious food, beverages, and fishing gear provided on board.

tours.name: Sunset Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-hour coastal adventure aboard the powerful Boston Whaler Outrage, featuring triple engines with 1,050 hp. Experience stunning sunsets while enjoying complimentary Prosecco, snorkeling gear, and refreshments. With a certified captain at the helm, this unforgettable journey accommodates up to 6 passengers for an exhilarating escape.

tours.name: Sunset JetCar VIP
tours.description: Experience the thrill of JetCar VIP as you drive luxurious watercraft through the stunning Caribbean waters of San Juan Bay. Soak in breathtaking views of historical landmarks while feeling the adrenaline rush. This unforgettable adventure promises excitement and memories that will last a lifetime, perfect for ages 12 and up!

tours.name: Junior JetCarVIP
tours.description: Experience the thrill of driving a luxurious JetCar through the stunning Caribbean waters! Designed for young adults aged 17 to 20, this unique adventure includes guidance from a certified instructor as you navigate the iconic San Juan Bay. It's an unforgettable journey that promises excitement and lasting memories!

tours.name: Moorea Humpback Whales  (September 2026)
tours.description: Swim with gentle humpback whales, their calves, and other marine life in Moorea’s warm waters. Enjoy 7 days of snorkeling, cultural experiences, and stunning wildlife encounters in the South Pacific.

tours.name: Private Full Day 2 Boats East KeysTour
tours.description: Embark on a memorable beach day tour with your private group of up to 12 passengers, exploring the stunning waters of Icacos, Palomino, and Palominito. Enjoy a licensed captain, snorkeling gear, and refreshments, all while soaking up the sun and creating unforgettable memories on your exclusive boat adventure.

tours.name: Island Escape Charter Adventures - Full Day
tours.description: Sail the Caribbean on a sleek Power Catamaran, exploring pristine islands, snorkeling vibrant reefs, or relaxing on white-sand beaches. Perfect for small groups seeking a personalized, luxurious ocean escape.

tours.name: Old San Juan Electric Scooter Adventure
tours.description: Explore San Juan’s waterfront on a guided electric scooter ride that’s faster and more engaging than

tours.name: Private Punta Arenas Snorkeling Tour
tours.description: Swim in calm Caribbean waters at Punta Arenas, home to colorful fish, sea turtles, and sting rays. Easy shore access makes snorkeling fun for all skill levels—gear included for a hassle-free adventure.

tours.name: Kid's Cowboys Adventure by Hacienda Carey
tours.description: Kids get hands-on with farm animals, explore Puerto Rican nature, and learn about ecosystems—all unplugged and fun. A lively, educational outdoor adventure perfect for curious children and families.

tours.name: Snorkelling
tours.description: Experience the thrill of snorkeling, a perfect adventure for all skill levels. Dive into vibrant underwater worlds and discover the beauty of marine life, making unforgettable memories during your vacation. This one-hour activity promises excitement and exploration, awakening your adventurous spirit in a unique and accessible way.

tours.name: Kayak Trip to Monkey Island
tours.description: Paddle through Caribbean waters to Monkey Island, home to wild Rhesus macaques. Enjoy a safe, personalized eco-tour with expert guides, gear, and close-up views of playful monkeys in their natural habitat.

tours.name: Old San Juan Walk & Taste (NT)
tours.description: Stroll through Old San Juan’s historic cobblestone streets, uncovering its rich architecture and culture. Savor authentic Puerto Rican flavors on this 3-hour walking tour—perfect for curious explorers ready for adventure.

tours.name: Tropicaleo Drinking Tour (NT)
tours.description: Sip cocktails at four top bars in Old San Juan, mingle with locals, and learn about the city’s history. Enjoy delicious bites and stunning sights on a fun, guided 2-hour evening tour—perfect for a memorable night out.

tours.name: Taste of Puerto Rico
tours.description: Join a 6-hour culinary adventure in Old San Juan: make Puerto Rican waffles, craft a fresh Piña Colada, dance lively salsa, explore historic streets, and enjoy modern vibes—all with hands-on fun and vibrant rhythms.

tours.name: Rainforest & Zipline Combo
tours.description: Soar over 80 feet above the rainforest on nine zip lines, then stroll a scenic nature trail, relax in a natural pool, and explore local food stalls. An action-packed day blending adventure, nature, and Puerto Rican charm.

tours.name: Morning Kayak (All-Day) (NT)
tours.description: Paddle through calm lagoon waters at sunrise, soaking in peaceful views and the chance to see gentle manatees. Perfect for active adventurers 3+ years old, with flexible tour times and scenic, moderate difficulty.

tours.name: Glass Bottom Kayak Tour
tours.description: Paddle through tranquil lagoons at sunrise in glass-bottom kayaks, spotting marine life and learning island secrets. Calm, scenic, and perfect for all ages—an unforgettable urban adventure awaits.

tours.name: San Juan tour – In and around Old San Juan
tours.description: Stroll through Old San Juan’s charming streets, marvel at historic forts and colorful colonial buildings, and uncover hidden treasures around every corner in this 4.5-hour adventure.

tours.name: Condado Lagoon Water Cycling (NT)
tours.description: Pedal through Puerto Rico’s Condado Lagoon on a stable, eco-friendly waterbike. Glide under bridges, spot marine life, and enjoy city views in this safe, fun adventure perfect for active explorers.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Jetski Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as a modern-day captain at Luquillo Beach, with the breathtaking El Yunque National Park as your backdrop. Experience the thrill of Yamaha jet skiing, guided by professionals who ensure your safety and enjoyment. Capture stunning photos and create lasting memories on this exhilarating journey!

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay
tours.description: Paddle through glowing waters in La Parguera’s bioluminescent bay, then swim in shimmering, micro-organism-lit waters. A magical 6-hour adventure with kayaking, swimming, and stunning photo moments.

tours.name: Half Day Rainforest tour
tours.description: Climb the Yocahu Tower, marvel at La Coca Waterfall, enjoy a scenic hike, then dive into the river for a swim, base jump, and rope swing. Finish with lunch and shopping at El Portal for a perfect adventure day.

tours.name: Arrivals
tours.description: Travel smoothly from San Juan Airport to El Conquistador Resort in an exclusive shuttle, ensuring a comfortable start to your trip. Shared with fellow PCMA members, it’s a seamless, hassle-free transfer.

tours.name: Custom Private Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a personalized adventure with Mariex Adventures! Simply reach out to customize your private tour, tailored to your interests and group size. Whether it's a unique destination or a special activity, your unforgettable journey awaits, crafted just for you.

tours.name: Icacos Island & Snorkeling Excursion
tours.description: Swim in crystal-clear waters and explore vibrant coral reefs around Icacos Island. Feel the ocean’s cool embrace and discover colorful marine life on this unforgettable snorkeling adventure.

tours.name: Cayo Afuera Snorkeling Tour
tours.description: Dive into Cayo Afuera’s crystal-clear waters for a fun, educational snorkeling adventure. Choose your level, explore vibrant marine life, and enjoy all gear included on this unforgettable 2-hour tour.

tours.name: Upper Añasco River
tours.description: Enjoy a 5-hour family adventure on Puerto Rico’s Añasco River, tackling exciting rapids, exploring lush scenery, and uncovering Taino history. Safe, fun, and perfect for all ages—plus a picnic break along the way.

tours.name: LED Night Snorkeling
tours.description: Dive into a glowing underwater world at night, where vibrant corals and marine creatures light up in brilliant colors. Led by experts, this 1.5-hour snorkel reveals the reef’s magical, bioluminescent nightlife.

tours.name: Land & Sea (Bad Bunny Edition)
tours.description: Experience the vibrant essence of Puerto Rico before the concert with a unique tour that blends culture, history, and breathtaking coastal views. Explore historic landmarks, snap stunning photos, and visit iconic spots from Bad Bunny's music videos while soaking in the lively Caribbean atmosphere on a scenic bay cruise.

tours.name: Early Bird Boat Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a speedboat cruise through Puerto Rico's stunning Piñones area. Glide through open waters and serene mangrove channels, taking in breathtaking natural scenery and the vibrant local lifestyle. This unique tour promises an unforgettable blend of adventure and relaxation, showcasing the island's beauty like never before.

tours.name: Couple Pass Ticket
tours.description: Enjoy a thrilling day with two exciting combos like ziplining, climbing towers, or ToroBike, plus a restaurant coupon. Perfect for adventure lovers seeking fun, safety, and great memories in just 3 hours.

tours.name: Rum Mixology & Salsa Dancing
tours.description: Experience the vibrant culture of Puerto Rico on this unique tour that combines history, mixology, and dance. Stroll through Old San Juan, learn about rum's rich heritage, craft your own Caribbean cocktail, and enjoy delicious appetizers. Cap it off with a lively salsa dancing class. Join the fun—Salud!

tours.name: History Behind the Walls-walking tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3.5-hour historical walk through Old San Juan, guided by an expert. Discover stunning Spanish architecture, explore the monumental Castillo de San Cristobal, and learn about the island's rich culture and history. Conclude your adventure with time for refreshments and local crafts near Columbus Plaza.

tours.name: Pedal Boat
tours.description: Experience the tranquility of Patillas Bay as you pedal in a unique boat with a tent, free from waves. This 30-minute adventure for two offers a memorable way to connect with nature and enjoy the serene beauty of the bay. Perfect for a relaxing escape!

tours.name: Trampolín
tours.description: Dive into excitement with Water Jumping, a thrilling activity for children aged 5 to 10! Perfect for groups, this fun-filled experience promises laughter and splashes as kids leap into the water. Gather a minimum of 10 friends for an unforgettable day of jumping and joy!

tours.name: Gratuity
tours.description: Experience the joy of expressing gratitude with client gratuity, a meaningful way to acknowledge exceptional service. This unique opportunity not only enhances relationships but also leaves a lasting impression, making every interaction memorable and rewarding. Celebrate the dedication of those who go above and beyond in their service to you.

tours.name: Paddleboards
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddle surfing, a beloved coastal sport that combines exercise with relaxation. Spend an hour gliding across the water on a paddle board, enhancing your balance while soaking in stunning views. It's a unique way to connect with nature and enjoy the serenity of the sea.

tours.name: Personalized Tour Experience
tours.description: Embark on a personalized adventure tailored just for you! Share your interests, and together we’ll craft a unique experience that reflects your passions. Available in both English and Spanish, this is your chance to explore in a way that truly resonates with you. Let's create unforgettable memories together!

tours.name: Grady White 35
tours.description: Experience an intimate gathering with a capacity for up to 9 people, perfect for creating lasting memories. This unique setting fosters connection and engagement, making it an ideal choice for special occasions or quality time with friends and family. Enjoy a personalized atmosphere that enhances every moment shared together.

tours.name: 150' Wide Projector Screen
tours.description: Experience the thrill of projecting your favorite videos on a massive 150-foot screen! Perfect for gatherings or special events, this unique activity transforms any occasion into a cinematic adventure. Enjoy seamless pick-up at 8 am and a convenient drop-off at 10 pm on the final day of your rental.

tours.name: 62 Gallon Cooler
tours.description: Experience a full day of adventure with convenient pick-up at 8 am and drop-off at 10 pm. Enjoy the unique opportunity to keep your drinks chilled throughout your journey, ensuring refreshment and comfort as you explore. Make your day memorable with this essential rental service!

tours.name: 1.5 Hour Tow-In Foil Surfing
tours.description: Discover the thrill of Hydrofoil Surfing, our most advanced experience! Feel the exhilarating sensation of flying above the water, expertly banking curves, and gliding through waves. This unique adventure promises pure bliss as you master the art of hydrofoiling, making it an unforgettable journey on the water.

tours.name: Caribbean Yacht Private Tour
tours.description: Experience the Caribbean like never before aboard a private yacht! Spend eight hours exploring the stunning crystal-clear waters of La Parguera, Puerto Rico. Enjoy roundtrip transportation from San Juan, along with delicious snacks, refreshing water, and local Medalla beer, making this an unforgettable adventure on the open sea.

tours.name: Two boat day trips
tours.description: Two identical boats with the same amenities. Cozy cabin and bathroom/shower. Smooth ride.

tours.name: SJU Airport to Rio Mar
tours.description: Arrive smoothly at Wyndham Grand Rio Mar with our shared shuttle from San Juan Airport. Look for the greeter, identify yourself, and relax as you’re guided directly to your tropical resort.

tours.name: Rio Mar to SJU Airport
tours.description: Share a ride from Wyndham Grand Rio Mar to San Juan Airport, with flexible options for private or accessible vehicles. Relax knowing your departure is smooth, with clear instructions and shared comfort.

tours.name: Culebra Island Snorkeling Adventure
tours.description: Race across crystal-clear waters to one of the world's top beaches on a power boat. Enjoy a tasty buffet, unlimited drinks, and tropical cocktails in a fun, low-difficulty adventure perfect for swimming and sun.

tours.name: Icacos Catamaran Snorkeling
tours.description: Sail a catamaran to Icacos Island for a fun-filled day of beachcombing and snorkeling in vibrant coral reefs. Perfect for all ages with easy waters, stunning marine life, and unforgettable island adventures.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Horseback Riding at the Beach
tours.description: Ride through Puerto Rico’s lush forests and secluded beaches on a gentle horseback tour. No experience needed—just feel the breeze, see stunning scenery, and escape the crowds in this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Longest Zipline Adventure Combo
tours.description: Soar through seven thrilling ziplines, then feel the rush flying like a bird on the 1.4 km Beast Zipline at speeds up to 60 MPH. An adrenaline-packed adventure for thrill-seekers ready to conquer the sky.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Forest Zipline Adventure
tours.description: Soar through lush Puerto Rican mountains on five thrilling ziplines, cross canopy bridges, and learn about the forest. Feel the wind, enjoy scenic views, and leave worries behind in this fun, family-friendly adventure.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) LED Night Kayak Tour
tours.description: Glide through the San Juan Bay estuary in a LED kayak, spotting manatees and vibrant reefs. Enjoy stunning views, lush mangroves, and a rich ecosystem in this eco-friendly adventure for all ages.

tours.name: Blue Queen Room (bath shared with Sunflower)
tours.description: Relax in the Blue Queen room near Puerto Rico’s quiet Caribbean coast, enjoy a pool, kayaks, and beach gear, and explore lush rainforests just steps away—your off-the-beaten-path island escape awaits.

tours.name: Private Catamaran Snorkeling (up to 28 passengers)
tours.description: Set sail on a catamaran to Icacos or speed to Culebra’s stunning beaches. Swim, relax, and soak up the sun on this 6-hour adventure—an unforgettable way to enjoy Puerto Rico’s crystal-clear waters.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Old San Juan Sunset Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s vibrant streets, stunning views, rich history, lively music, and colorful architecture on a guided walking tour—perfect for families and history lovers alike.

tours.name: Sea Scooter Rental
tours.description: Gear up with top-quality snorkel gear and fins for a fun-filled boat trip. Swim safely with a lifejacket, but only if you're at least 8 years old, 60 inches tall, and comfortable in the water.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Horseback Riding at the Forest
tours.description: Ride through lush valleys and wetlands on horseback, soaking in stunning scenery and vibrant wildlife. Perfect for families, with guided tours from a private farm—adventure awaits in this unique ecosystem.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Sail Catamaran Trip
tours.description: Sail to Puerto Rico’s pristine Icacos Island, snorkel among vibrant fish in crystal-clear waters, relax on white beaches, enjoy tropical drinks, and soak up stunning scenery—an unforgettable adventure for all ages.

tours.name: Private Custom Tour/Adventure
tours.description: Escape crowds with a private, custom adventure in Puerto Rico. Swim in natural pools, swing from ropes, slide, climb steep terrain, and enjoy surprises—all tailored for families seeking an unforgettable muddy journey.

tours.name: Savor Experience Food Tour
tours.description: Embark on a flavorful journey through Puerto Rican cuisine, sampling six iconic dishes at five nearby restaurants. Guided by an expert, savor exquisite tastes from land and sea, complemented by refreshing drinks. After indulging, enjoy a voucher for bowling or pickleball to keep the excitement going!

tours.name: Icacos Half Day Snorkeling
tours.description: Relax on Icacos Island’s pristine waters, soak up the sun, and sip tropical drinks with local rum. Swim, unwind, and enjoy stunning ocean views—an unforgettable Puerto Rican beach escape in just four hours.

tours.name: Forest Buggy Adventure
tours.description: Race across 75 acres on an off-road buggy, feeling the thrill with every turn. Enjoy refreshing drinks and snacks afterward. Perfect for all skill levels—an adrenaline-packed adventure awaits you.

tours.name: Departures
tours.description: Say goodbye to your resort with a smooth, shared shuttle to San Juan Airport. Relax and enjoy the ride as fellow travelers join you, making your departure effortless and stress-free.

tours.name: Private Boat Charter
tours.description: Embark on a private 5-hour boat charter in Puerto Rico, where turquoise waters and hidden coves await! Enjoy stunning coastal views, swim in crystal-clear waters, and relax with included snacks and drinks. Perfect for groups seeking a personalized adventure, this experience blends relaxation with the thrill of exploration.

tours.name: Departures
tours.description: Travel smoothly from El Conquistador Resort to San Juan Airport in an exclusive PCMA shuttle. Share the ride with fellow members for a comfortable, hassle-free departure experience.

tours.name: Catamaran Sunset Sail with Live Music
tours.description: Sail into the sunset on a spacious catamaran, with soulful live music, delicious bites, and cocktails. Feel the ocean breeze and golden hues as you unwind in style—an unforgettable Caribbean evening awaits.

tours.name: aventura2
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating hiking adventure, where nature's beauty unfolds with every step. Experience breathtaking landscapes, fresh air, and the thrill of exploration. Whether traversing rugged trails or serene paths, this journey promises unforgettable moments and a deep connection with the great outdoors. Discover the joy of hiking today!

tours.name: Kayak/Paddle Board Rental
tours.description: Rental by hour

tours.name: El Yunque: Rainforest & Waterslide
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 7-hour adventure in El Yunque, Puerto Rico's only tropical rainforest. Explore lush trails, glide down natural waterslides, and swim in crystal-clear rivers. With expert guidance, discover the vibrant ecosystem and rich cultural history, all while soaking in breathtaking views and creating lasting memories in nature's playground.

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay Kayak Tour
tours.description: Experience the enchanting Bioluminescent Bay in Vieques on a captivating 5-hour kayaking adventure. Paddle through glowing waters as each stroke illuminates the night, revealing a magical world of bioluminescent microorganisms. Guided by experts, explore mangroves and learn about the science and legends behind this surreal natural wonder.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Tour
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking El Yunque Rainforest on a 4-hour guided adventure! Explore lush trails, discover the enchanting La Mina Falls, and swim in natural pools. Learn about the unique ecosystem and cultural history while enjoying stunning views. This tour is a perfect blend of exploration, beauty, and relaxation in paradise.

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay tour at La Parguera
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable journey through the island's southwest side in a comfortable van. Enjoy a delicious dinner, swim in a stunning bay, and explore the enchanting biobay on a captivating four-hour tour. This adventure promises a perfect blend of relaxation and excitement before returning to the metro area.

tours.name: From Cacao to the Fire: Premium Experience in Caguas
tours.description: Taste the Heart of Puerto Rico in One Signature Experience

tours.name: Rainforest Eco-Adventure Park
tours.description: Soar above Puerto Rico’s lush rainforest on a thrilling zipline adventure with 9 lines and 2 rappels. Perfect for families, it offers stunning views, gentle hikes, and an unforgettable outdoor experience.

tours.name: De Paseo para Culebra
tours.description: Embark on an all-inclusive catamaran adventure from Fajardo to the stunning beaches of Culebrita and Culebra. Enjoy snorkeling, relaxing on pristine shores, and savor delicious meals and refreshing drinks. This unforgettable journey promises breathtaking views and a perfect day of sun and sea.

tours.name: Bio Bay Kayaking Adventure
tours.description: Paddle through Puerto Rico’s glowing mangroves at Laguna Seca, where tiny dinoflagellates light up the water in a magical celestial display. An adventurous, nature-filled experience you’ll never forget—if you’re ready to paddle in the dark.

tours.name: Fajardo Scuba Diving (NT)
tours.description: Feel the thrill of weightless diving as you explore vibrant coral reefs up to 40 feet deep. Perfect for beginners with supervision, this 4-hour adventure ignites your passion for underwater exploration.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) ATV Adventure
tours.description: Feel the thrill of Puerto Rico’s rugged terrain on an ATV tour, with a scenic 20-minute stop at Mameyes River. Suitable for all skill levels, it’s an adrenaline-packed adventure you won’t forget.

tours.name: Day E-Bike Tour
tours.description: Glide effortlessly on electric bikes through vibrant Condado and historic Old San Juan, soaking up sights and sunshine on a 2-hour, 3-mile adventure—no sweat, just pure fun.

tours.name: Night E-Bike Tour
tours.description: Zoom through Condado and Old San Juan on electric bikes, soaking in lit-up forts, lively streets, and stunning scenery—all without breaking a sweat on this 2-hour, 3-mile adventure.

tours.name: SJU Airport to Hyatt Regency Grand Reserve Puerto Rico
tours.description: Relax after your flight with a shared shuttle from San Juan Airport to Hyatt Puerto Rico. Book for two or more adults, bring your own car seat, and enjoy a smooth, hassle-free start to your tropical getaway.

tours.name: Hyatt Regency Grand Reserve Puerto Rico to SJU Airport
tours.description: Share a convenient ride from Hyatt Grand Reserve to San Juan Airport, with other guests. Book for two adults, bring your own car seat, and enjoy a smooth, stress-free departure within your flight hours.

tours.name: Southwest Coast Tour & Bioluminescent Bay Tour
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s southwest in a full-day adventure: colorful towns, stunning cliffs, pink salt flats, and a magical bioluminescent bay. Perfect for families seeking unforgettable sights and experiences.

tours.name: Rainforest Canopy Zipline
tours.description: Zip through El Yunque’s lush rainforest on 11 zip-lines, then relax in a natural pool and enjoy calm Luquillo Beach. Perfect for families and first-timers, this 7-hour adventure blends thrill, nature, and relaxation.

tours.name: San Juan Historical Mini-Boat Tour (NT)
tours.description: Take the wheel of a powerboat and cruise San Juan Bay, soaking in stunning views and city history. Perfect for adventure seekers 18+, with a 1.5-hour ride full of coastal fun and unforgettable sights.

tours.name: UTV Adventure at The Rainforest
tours.description: Ride rugged 4x4 vehicles along Puerto Rico’s east coast, taking in breathtaking views. Enjoy a thrilling 2-hour adventure with swimming in crystal-clear Mameyes River waters. Perfect for adventure lovers seeking scenic excitement.

tours.name: Forest Zipline & Safari Adventure
tours.description: Soar through treetops on three thrilling ziplines, explore caves, cross canopy bridges, and enjoy a scenic off-road safari in Puerto Rico’s lush Northern Karst mountains. An adventure for all ages 11+!

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Bioluminescent Bay Kayak Tour
tours.description: Paddle through glowing mangrove channels at Laguna Grande, getting up close to shimmering planktons in a magical bio bay adventure perfect for families and nature lovers alike.

tours.name: Rainforest Off The Beaten Path
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 5-hour adventure to Las Tinajas Falls in El Yunque Rainforest! Hike through lush landscapes, savor fresh local fruit, and discover two stunning waterfalls. With guidance along the way, enjoy breathtaking views and the thrill of nature, making unforgettable memories in this tropical paradise.

tours.name: Avatar Waterfall Hike
tours.description: Hike through lush streams to reach stunning Charco Prieto Waterfalls, enjoy a refreshing swim, capture photos, and relax with lunch at a local café—all just 45 minutes from San Juan. Prepare to get muddy and wet!

tours.name: Waterfalls & Coastal Cave Tour
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s stunning Tanamá River, swim in waterfalls, and marvel at ancient petroglyphs at Cueva del Indio. A 7.5-hour adventure blending nature, archaeology, and unforgettable scenery.

tours.name: Old San Juan Historical Tour
tours.description: Walk through 500 years of history in Old San Juan’s colorful streets, passing forts, churches, and walls. Learn about its culture and secrets while soaking in stunning bay views—an unforgettable journey into the past.

tours.name: Custom Tour
tours.description: Create your perfect Puerto Rico adventure with a personalized private tour. Customize your itinerary, explore diverse locations, and enjoy a tailored experience designed just for you.

tours.name: Luxury & VIP Experiences
tours.description: Enjoy a private, customizable tour with exclusive transportation, luxurious extras, and flexible pick-up options beyond San Juan’s busy areas—perfect for your group’s personalized adventure.

tours.name: San Juan City Tour
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the rich history of Old San Juan on a captivating 5-hour walking tour. Discover iconic landmarks like the Cathedral of San Juan Bautista and Casa Blanca, while your guide shares fascinating stories from the Spanish colonial era. Experience the charm of one of the oldest cities in the Americas.

tours.name: Ziplining Adventure Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of an award-winning Ziplining Adventure Tour in Puerto Rico! Soar across 5 ziplines and traverse 5 hanging canopy bridges, all guided by certified professionals. Enjoy an educational hike and savor a homemade Puerto Rican lunch on morning tours. For more excitement, try the Cave Rappelling & Ziplining Safari!

tours.name: Horseback Ride
tours.description: Experience the beauty of the Caribbean on a guided horseback tour through lagoons, mountains, and lush vegetation. Discover the rich history of Puerto Rico's Paso Fino Horses while enjoying breathtaking coastal views. After your adventure, unwind with refreshing drinks at the Mojito Bar for a perfect ending.

tours.name: Culebra Scuba Diving (NT)
tours.description: Dive into the vibrant coral reefs of Culebra Island on a 6.5-hour guided tour. Feel weightless underwater, mastering basic skills with a PADI instructor—an unforgettable intro to scuba diving.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Snorkeling with Turtles
tours.description: Dive into an unforgettable snorkeling adventure at Escambrón Marine Park, where vibrant schools of tropical fish and majestic turtles await. Explore historic underwater ruins, including the “Fish Protection Wall” and “Atlantis,” while learning to identify Caribbean marine life. This unique experience combines natural beauty with rich history for an exhilarating outing.

tours.name: (Initial Payment) UTV at Forest
tours.description: Experience the thrill of UTV tours in Puerto Rico, where adventure awaits at every turn! Perfect for both seasoned riders and newcomers, this exhilarating journey promises an unforgettable ride through stunning landscapes. With certified instructors and all necessary gear provided, prepare for an adrenaline-packed escapade like no other!

tours.name: (Initial Payment) Private Boat Day Trip
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable private sailing adventure along Puerto Rico's stunning east coastline. Discover pristine white sand beaches and vibrant underwater life while enjoying provided snorkeling gear. Relax in paradise with a light lunch and drinks served by the attentive crew, making this a perfect day for families and friends alike.

tours.name: Underwater Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of scuba diving in the stunning northwest of Puerto Rico! Perfect for beginners, explore vibrant underwater ecosystems teeming with colorful marine life. Enjoy warm waters, included gear, transportation, and digital photos to capture your adventure. Dive into an unforgettable journey beneath the waves!

tours.name: Sailing and Snorkeling Experience With Lunch in San Juan
tours.description: 12+ years old • 6 Hours • Admire unparalleled views as you sail to your island paradise

tours.name: Six Hour Trip • Nearshore/Offshore
tours.description: Child Friendly! • 6 Hours • 7 Targeted species!

tours.name: Daytime Swordfishing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of daytime swordfishing in Puerto Rico with Captain Alberto, the only guide offering this unique adventure. Targeting the ocean's toughest fighters in deep waters, you'll enjoy an exhilarating 10-11 hour journey filled with action and expert techniques. Join Curate Fishing Charters for an unforgettable angling experience!

tours.name: 8 Hour Offshore Trip
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 8-hour offshore fishing adventure with Curate Fishing Charters, where you'll chase trophy fish like Wahoo, Yellowfin Tuna, and Marlin. Led by experienced Captain Alberto, this unique trip combines expert techniques with real-time data for an unforgettable fishing experience. Perfect for hardcore anglers seeking the ultimate catch!

tours.name: Limited offer 2 Hours on the Reef
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating fishing adventure with Curate Fishing Charters in Palmas Del Mar! Whether you're a novice or a seasoned angler, enjoy diverse techniques like trolling, jigging, and deep dropping for a variety of species. Captain Alberto's expertise ensures a thrilling day on the water, tailored to your fishing desires.

tours.name: Janzu
tours.description: Experience the transformative power of Janzu, a unique water-based healing practice that combines gentle movement and flowing techniques. In a nurturing environment, you'll be guided through a soothing process that promotes deep relaxation and emotional release, allowing for profound healing and rejuvenation. Embrace the serenity of water and restore your well-being.

tours.name: Embodiment Practice
tours.description: Experience a transformative hour of embodiment practices that deepen your connection with your body. Through movement, breathwork, and mindfulness, you'll cultivate awareness and alignment across your physical, emotional, and energetic states. Prepare for a grounding journey of self-discovery and renewal, bringing comfortable attire and an open mind.

tours.name: Private Icacos Power Boat 3in1 Snorkling, Beach, & Sunset Tour
tours.description: Set sail on a private powerboat with your crew for 4 hours of snorkeling, beach lounging, and stunning sunset views. An exclusive island escape filled with adventure, relaxation, and unforgettable Caribbean scenery.

tours.name: 🇵🇷 Sal Y Perreo Boat Party 🇵🇷
tours.description: Dance to live DJ beats on a catamaran, sip Puerto Rican rum cocktails, and soak in stunning ocean views as you sail to Icacos. Feel the island’s vibrant vibes and unforgettable sunset—an epic boat party you can't miss.

tours.name: Special Service Ticket
tours.description: Arrange personalized transportation to your event or destination with our flexible pickup and drop-off services. Just tell us your needs, and we'll handle the rest for a smooth, hassle-free experience.

tours.name: Four Track Adventure at The Rainforest
tours.description: Venture into El Yunque’s rainforest on a thrilling 2-hour ATV tour. Cross rugged terrain, splash through Mameyes River, and enjoy a refreshing swim amid lush scenery. Perfect for adventure seekers 16+ with a sense of adventure.

tours.name: Horseback Riding at The Rainforest
tours.description: Ride through El Yunque’s lush rainforest foothills, enjoy breathtaking views, and cool off by Mameyes River. Includes horseback riding lessons, scenic nature, and a refreshing swim—an adventure for nature lovers and explorers alike.

tours.name: PRIVATE CUSTOM TOUR
tours.description: Great for couples and groups up to 12 people • Call to book!

tours.name: (Initial Payment) River Tubing Adventure
tours.description: Venture into pristine caves and lush forests, kayak through a 1,000-foot underground tunnel, swim under spring waterfalls, and hike past limestone cliffs. An adventurous journey connecting nature’s wonders awaits.

tours.name: Serenity II
tours.description: Sail through Puerto Rico’s stunning beaches and reefs on a spacious boat, snorkel up to five coral reefs, and enjoy scenic views of Culebra and Vieques. Perfect for a full-day adventure or half-day escape.

tours.name: De Paseo para Caja de Muertos
tours.description: Embark on an all-inclusive catamaran adventure from Ponce to the stunning Playa Pelicano on Caja de Muertos Island. Enjoy snorkeling, kayaking, and paddle boarding, with delicious meals and refreshing drinks provided. This unforgettable experience accommodates 50 passengers, ensuring a fun-filled day of sun and sea.

tours.name: Maroon Master-Room (Private ensuite Bath)
tours.description: Relax in a private ensuite room near Puerto Rico’s calm Caribbean coast. Enjoy a pool, kayaks, and beach gear, plus cozy comforts and nature views—perfect for exploring Culebra, Vieques, and beyond.

tours.name: Sunflower Full Room (bath shared with Blue Queen)
tours.description: Relax in a spacious guestroom near Puerto Rico’s quiet Caribbean coast. Swim, kayak, or lounge by the pool, all just steps from the beach. Enjoy local nature, friendly guides, and a laid-back vibe away from the crowds.

tours.name: OLD SAN JUAN CITY WALKING TOUR
tours.description: Stroll through Old San Juan’s historic cobblestone streets and uncover its rich past as “The Gate to the Americas” in this captivating 2-hour tour.

tours.name: Luxury Private Yacht Trip
tours.description: Experience the ultimate luxury sailing adventure along Puerto Rico's stunning east coastline. Discover pristine white sand beaches and vibrant underwater life while enjoying top-notch service from our captain and crew. With floating gear provided, relax and sunbathe in paradise, making this journey truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Boat Diving
tours.description: Master boat diving skills, from safe entries to gear management, and learn to navigate different vessels. Gain the confidence to explore dive sites worldwide with expert guidance.

tours.name: Nitrox
tours.description: Unlock longer, safer dives with enriched air Nitrox. Learn to analyze tanks, plan dives, and reduce fatigue—giving you more freedom and efficiency on every underwater adventure.

tours.name: Deep Diving
tours.description: Master the art of deep diving up to 130 feet, learning to manage risks, use advanced gear, and explore wrecks and walls safely with confidence and expert skills.

tours.name: Diver Stress & Rescue
tours.description: Master stress management and rescue skills in diving with realistic scenarios, boosting confidence to handle emergencies safely and become a more capable, prepared dive buddy.

tours.name: Navigation
tours.description: Master underwater navigation with skills in compass use and natural cues. Gain confidence to plan routes, find features, and dive independently—making every dive safer and more adventurous.

tours.name: Night Diving & Limited Visibility
tours.description: Unlock the secrets of the night ocean—navigate dark waters, spot active marine life, and master low-visibility dives safely. Experience a whole new world beneath the stars and expand your diving skills beyond the daytime.

tours.name: Science of Diving
tours.description: Unlock the science behind diving with this theory-based course. Gain knowledge on physics, gases, and marine ecosystems to dive smarter, safer, and more confident—no water required.

tours.name: Perfect Buoyancy
tours.description: Refine your diving skills with perfect buoyancy control, allowing you to hover effortlessly, save air, and protect marine life. Achieve greater stability and confidence in every underwater adventure.

tours.name: Waves, Tides and Currents
tours.description: Master ocean forces with this course—learn to read waves, tides, and currents to plan safer, more confident dives. Understand water movement, avoid hazards, and explore more with expert skills in predicting ocean conditions.

tours.name: Recreational Sidemount Diving
tours.description: Master sidemount diving with better balance, streamlined movement, and easier gear handling. Learn to set up, manage gas, and enjoy safer, more comfortable dives—perfect for exploring caves, wrecks, or just upgrading your skills.

tours.name: DPV/Scooter
tours.description: Master new skills like night diving, deep waters, or scooter rides, and unlock your diving potential. Pursue SSI specialties and even become a Divemaster—your underwater adventure starts here.

tours.name: Decompression Diving
tours.description: Unlock longer, deeper dives with expert decompression skills. Learn to plan, use dive computers, manage gases, and handle emergencies—bridging recreational and technical diving for safer, extended underwater adventures.

tours.name: Equipment Techniques
tours.description: Master your scuba gear with hands-on tips to assemble, maintain, and optimize for safety and comfort. Learn to troubleshoot, customize setups, and dive confidently with equipment you control.

tours.name: React Right
tours.description: Gain vital first aid skills for water emergencies, including CPR, AED, and oxygen therapy. Hands-on training prepares you to respond confidently and save lives in diving and water-related crises.

tours.name: Transportation San Juan Area to Fajardo
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Puerto Rico with FIX A TRIP. Experience the island's breathtaking landscapes, rich culture, and vibrant history as you uncover its hidden gems. This adventure promises unique discoveries and memorable moments that will leave you enchanted by the beauty of Puerto Rico.

tours.name: De Paseo para los Cayos de Fajardo
tours.description: Discover the stunning beaches of Puerto Rico on an all-inclusive adventure aboard the Catamaran East Wind. Enjoy stops at the picturesque Cayo Icacos and an exciting snorkeling spot, complete with all the necessary gear. Experience the beauty of the ocean and create unforgettable memories in paradise.

tours.name: De Paseo para Arecibo y Hatillo
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable guided tour of Cueva Ventana and Cueva del Indio in Arecibo. Enjoy a delicious lunch at Torres Restaurant, along with snacks and round-trip transportation from San Juan. Experience the breathtaking beauty of these natural wonders while indulging in local flavors.

tours.name: De Paseo para Lajas y Guanica
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable excursion to La Parguera, Lajas, and Guanica! Experience the beauty of La Finca El Girasol and La Finca El Piñaton, and immerse yourself in the vibrant Festival de la Piña. Enjoy delicious meals, snacks, and convenient round-trip transportation from the metropolitan area.

tours.name: Single Memories - Zipline
tours.description: Soar above Hacienda Campo Rico’s treetops, capturing your zipline thrill on camera. Enjoy scenic stops at iconic spots like the lake and colonial fountain, then receive your unforgettable photos and videos in just a few days.

tours.name: Couple Memories - Zipline
tours.description: Capture every thrill as your group zips through stunning estate views, with your own action camera. Enjoy scenic photo stops and relive the adventure through videos and pictures, delivered quickly to cherish forever.

tours.name: SQUAD 3 - Zipline
tours.description: Capture your zipline thrill from your own perspective with photos and videos at stunning stops. Enjoy a mini photo session at iconic spots, then relive the adventure with quick delivery—no phones, just pure excitement.

tours.name: Iconic Photo Session
tours.description: Capture stunning, adventure-style photos at iconic scenic spots. Perfect for solo, couples, or groups, with professional editing and quick digital delivery—turn your trip into timeless memories.
